In this paper, experiments are carried out using NASA open cycle life degradation data of lithium-ion battery. The experimental results show that the model has better accuracy. The MAE and MAPE of B0005 and B0006 batteries are almost less than 0.01 and 1.

articleTitle: Optimization-Based Motion Planning for Autonomous Parking Considering Dynamic Obstacle: A Hierarchical Framework
abstract: We present a hierarchical framework based on graph search and model predictive control (MPC) for electric autonomous vehicle (EAV) parking maneuver in tight-environment. At high-level, only static obstacles are considered, and the scenario-based hybrid A* (SHA*), which is faster than the traditional hybrid A*, is designed to provide an initial guess (also known as a global path) for the parking task. To extract the velocity and acceleration profile from an initial guess, an optimal control problem (OCP) is built. In low-level, a NMPC-based strategy is used to avoid dynamic obstacles (also konwn as local planning). The efficacy of SHA* is evaluated through 148 different simulation schemes and the proposed hierarchical parking framework is demonstrated through a real-time parallel parking simulation.

articleTitle: A Calibration System of Intelligent Driving Vehicle Mounted Scene Projection Camera Based on Zhang Zhengyou Calibration Method
abstract: This paper proposes a calibration system for intelligent driving vehicle mounted scene projection camera based on Zhang Zhengyou calibration method. Among them, the key of the calibration system is to correct the side cutting angle, the pitch angle and the yaw angle between the checkerboard calibration board and the vehicle to be calibrated. First of all, this article needs to build the entire calibration system platform and obtain the internal parameter matrix of the vehicle mounted projection camera based on the Zhang Zhengyou calibration method. Second, this article realizes the correction of the side cutting angle, the pitch angle and the yaw angle between the checkerboard calibration board and the vehicle to be calibrated based on physical methods. Then, based on Zhang Zhengyou calibration method, the calculation of the rotation matrix and the translation vector between the two cameras is realized. Finally, this paper verifies the effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper from both qualitative and quantitative aspects. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper can effectively achieve the calibration of the vehicle mounted scene projection camera.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimization of a dual-fuel engine at low and medium loads based on MOEA/D
abstract: The diesel/natural gas dual-fuel engine has the problem that it is difficult to compromise and coordinate multiple goals at medium and low loads. The objective of this research is to find the optimal combination of control parameters for a dual-fuel engine that will reduce emissions while reducing fuel consumption. A regression model for predicting emissions and fuel consumption of dual-fuel engines was constructed using BP neural network, and it was verified that the R<sup>2</sup> of the output parameters were all greater than 0.9. The model has the good predictive ability. Then use a multi-objective evolutionary algorithm based on decomposition (MOEA/D) to perform multi-objective optimization on the dual-fuel engine. The algorithm uses an adaptive differential evolution operator to generate offspring solutions. Research shows that MOEA/D can be used for medium and low loads optimization of dual-fuel engines, and the obtained non-dominated solutions are evenly distributed on the Pareto front. Selecting the low-emission optimal solution on the Pareto front, the optimized NOx emissions decreased by 84%, and the fuel consumption decreased by 3.8%.

articleTitle: Physically Realizable Adversarial Attacks On 3D Point Cloud
abstract: Previous work has shown that mitigating potential vehicle control safety risks is becoming increasingly important with the development of autonomous driving systems. Although the security risks of camera-based sensors have been extensively and thoroughly researched, the vulnerability of relevant deep learning models for LiDAR-based sensors is still in the initial research stage. In this paper, we propose an attack method called Physical Point Attack (PPA) for generating perceptually 3D adversarial objects in a physical environment, which can be placed in front of the vehicle to fool LiDAR detectors. In contrast to existing work, our attack produces printable adversarial point clouds and maintains the perceptibility of the adversarial point clouds while remaining valid in real physical environments. Our code is available at https://github.com/chenxiaoyupetter/Physically-Realizable-Adversarial-Attacks-On-3D-Point-Cloud

articleTitle: CLIQUE: A Cross-layer Link Quality based Energy-efficient Routing Protocol for UWSNs
abstract: During the data transmission in underwater sensor networks, affected by the complex environment, especially when the network loads become large, data transmission collisions will be intensified, resulting in decrease in network transmission performance. Therefore, how to forward data to sink nodes with high reliability is a key issue. Link quality is one of the important factors that affect the performance of underwater communication routing. Poor transmission quality of link will lead to excessive retransmissions, leading to a low effective data packets reception rate. Hence, many routing protocols based on link quality are proposed in recent years. However less of them consider the effect of energy consumption and distance between neighbor nodes, which have the disadvantages of routing holes and uneven energy consumption. To this end, an energy-efficient routing protocol based on cross-layer link quality trust is proposed, which uses indicators at both physical layer and data link layer to comprehensively evaluate and predict the link quality between neighboring nodes from the perspective of overall network energy consumption balancing. The existing Link Quality based Routing Protocol is improved, and the routing node selection strategy is given based on the predicted value of link quality. The simulation results verify the advantages of the routing protocol in terms of data transmission success rate and energy consumption balancing performance.

articleTitle: Research on Raindrop Image Segmentation Method Based on Improved BiSeNet
abstract: With the development of intelligent vehicles, to reduce the manufacturing cost of the whole car and improve the intellectual level of the entire vehicle, the raindrop image on the windshield is collected by using the camera in the car. Then the raindrop is automatically identified in combination with the intelligent algorithm, replacing the traditional infrared equipment in the raindrop identification to save cost and improve automation and accuracy. Based on the raindrop image captured by the dashcam, this paper improves the general semantic segmentation network BiSeNet V2, introduces the structure of the lightweight network MobileNet V3 to reduce the number of model parameters and calculation, and adds the spatial attention mechanism and Squeeze-and-Excitation Network to improve the segmentation accuracy further and realize the accurate identification of raindrops; It lays a foundation for the automatic control of wiper. The simulation results show that the improved BiSeNet V2 algorithm has an Intersection over Union of 75% compared with the original algorithm. Still, the number of params is reduced by about 8.8%. The number of FLOPS is reduced by about 37.5%, which can improve operational efficiency and facilitate the use of the vehicle-bome system.

articleTitle: A Fault Diagnosis Method of Aircraft Hydraulic System Based on SSA-DBN
abstract: The hydraulic system is one of the key systems on the aircraft, with the rapid development of aviation technology, the structure of the aircraft hydraulic system is becoming more and more complex, and there are many types of faults, which make it difficult to perform effective fault diagnosis. Therefore, in order to improve the accuracy of fault diagnosis of aircraft hydraulic system, this paper proposes a fault diagnosis method of aircraft hydraulic system based on SSA-DBN. Firstly, it adopts the status monitoring data of a certain type of aircraft hydraulic system, the Deep Belief Network (DBN) fault diagnosis network is established. On this basis, the number of nodes in the hidden layer of DBN network is optimized by using Salp Swarm Algorithm (SSA). According to the obtained optimal optimization parameters, the optimal DBN fault diagnosis model of aircraft hydraulic system is established. The fault technology of aircraft hydraulic system is studied by using the established optimal DBN fault diagnosis model of aircraft hydraulic system. The results show that the diagnostic accuracy of the SSA-DBN fault diagnosis model is obviously better than that of DBN, and it has a good application prospect.

articleTitle: Review on the evolution process and key technologies of V2X-based protocol
abstract: V2X is a vital communication technology to realize Cooperative Vehicle Infrastructure System (CVIS) and autonomous driving in intelligent transportation systems. It is committed to achieving low-latency and high reliability of all-around communication connections vehicles and people, roads, and cloud platforms. This paper takes WAVE and CV2X technology as the core. Firstly the corresponding protocol evolution process of WAVE and C-V2X and its protocol stack architecture are introduced. Secondly, based on the 802.11p and 802.11bd standards in WAVE, we analyzed the principles, mechanisms and critical technologies of the physical layer and MAC layer in WAVE. Finally, we analyzed and compared access layer technologies of LTE-V2X and NR-V2X in C-V2X.

articleTitle: A Novel Feature-based PageRank Algorithm for Node Importance Ranking
abstract: Node importance ranking is one of key problems in the study of complex networks. The classical PageRank algorithm only focus on the network structure, which lead to inaccurate ranking result. By introducing the features of node attributes and user preference, a novel feature-based PageRank (FBPR) algorithm is proposed to identify the important nodes accurately and efficiently. The weight matrix and the fixed teleportation vector are redesigned by the feature similarities in the FBPR model. For different application scenarios, we can get different ranking results by adjusting the node attributes factor and the user preference factor. Finally, several simulation experiments are presented to verify the effectiveness of the FBPR algorithm.

articleTitle: Simulation and Test of Vehicle Global Routing Planning Algorithm Based on Autonomous Driving Simulator
abstract: Considering the driving scenarios of real autonomous vehicles and the simulation testing of the global routing planning algorithm, this study simulated and tested the global routing planning algorithm on structured roads and unstructured roads respectively. Under the structured road, parse the high-precision map information for autonomous driving, develop the information query interface, then use the lane connection relationship, vehicle driving intention and lane center-line sampling function to complete the global routing planning. Under the unstructured road, An improved A* algorithm based on dynamic grids, named Dynamic Lattice A* Route Planning(DLRP-A*) has been proposed, which adopts the idea of local dynamic and global dynamic grid division, and completes the global routing planning by iterative loop. Finally, this research built a simulation test link based on the autonomous driving simulator LGSVL (LG Silicon Valley Lab), and designed the communication module to implement the structured road planning algorithm to receive and send simulation message packages. Test results show that structured road planning algorithm is feasible. And under the unstructured road, the DLRP-A* algorithm proposed in this paper reduces the number of grid divisions compared to the global grid division in multiple test experiments. In addition, under the complex unstructured road, the DLRP-A* algorithm keeping the planning time while ensuring the planning routing accuracy.

articleTitle: Passive Fault Tolerant Control Allocations for Nonlinear Systems
abstract: This article presents a new fault-tolerant control scheme to achieve maneuvering control of multirotor unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) system experienced the actuator faults and failures conditions. The suggested control method consists of two independent control modules, one for virtual control and the other for control allocations. A fixed control allocation scheme is deployed as a low-level control module to distribute/redistribute virtual control signals among the available actuators in the nominal/faulty situations without acquiring actuator health information. In order to cope with uncertainty due to actuator faults and to attain fast and finite-time convergence of tracking error, a high-level control module is designed using a higher-order integral sliding mode control method. A rigorous closed-loop stability analysis is carried out to show the system’s stability. Finally, the numerical simulations are conducted on a nonlinear model of a multirotor UAV system, demonstrating the efficacy of the suggested approach.

articleTitle: A core temperature estimation method of lithium-ion battery based on electrothermal model
abstract: With the wide application of lithium-ion batteries (LIBs), its safety has attracted much attention. Due to the limitations of existing sensors and measurement technologies, the internal temperature of LIBs cannot be measured directly, which makes it impossible to monitor the core temperature of LIBs in real time. This will cause hidden hazards to the safe use of LIBs. In this paper, the accurate battery heat generation model is established by combining the heat generation model proposed by Bernardi with the heat transfer and heat dissipation model. Particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is used to identify the parameters of the lumped parameter two-state thermal model of LIBs proposed in this paper. In the experiment, after drilling the battery, the built-in temperature sensor is utilized to measure the real core temperature, and then the unscented Kalman filter (UKF) algorithm is employed to estimate the core temperature. The experimental results show that the estimation errors by the method used in this paper are small and have good adaptability and robustness, which provides a reliable method for core temperature monitoring of LIBs.

articleTitle: Self-Attention based Siamese Neural Network recognition Model
abstract: With the rapid development of machine learning neural network technology, various architectures based on neural network emerge in endlessly. Convolutional Neural Network needs a large number of data to drive to achieve target recognition. In recent years, the Siamese Neural Network model has also been evolving in the development, and has a high recognition effect in the recognition of small samples. Its function is mainly used to measure the similarity of two samples and realize the classification of samples. In order to improve the recognition effect of Siamese Neural Network, this paper will improve the traditional CNN-based Siamese Neural Network, and integrate the self-attention mechanism to achieve better recognition efficiency of the target. After the experimental test model in 4000 data set training, the recognition accuracy can reach 95.16%.

articleTitle: An Error Reduction Approach for Discrete Robust Train Tracking Control
abstract: Automatic train driving control is widely studied. Considering the uncertain disturbance during driving, robustness is fundamental in controller designs. This paper presents a method to design a robust controller, which guarantees the control error is bounded in an invariant ellipsoid range. An optimization algorithm is proposed to reduce the size of the ellipsoid. Experimental results illustrate that the size of optimized ellipsoid is smaller than non-optimal ones. An inter-station driving simulation shows that the train tracks the desired reference well. This method provides possibilities to further improve performance of railways and some potential application scenarios are also discussed here.

articleTitle: Autonomous Landing of a VTOL UAV on a Ship based on Tau Theory
abstract: The research on autonomous landing of VTOL UAVs is well established. However, the research on autonomous deck landing using visual methods is relatively not so mature and many of them require the support of ground insfrastructures. In order to reduce such dependencies, a ship landing guidance strategy based on on-board vision is studied. Considering the characteristics of the ship landing issue, we propose a three-phase landing scheme and a decision-making method to ensure landing safety is also studied. For improving the traditional 2D optical-flow method, a 3D velocity vector estimation method using image spherical optical flow is studied. Furthermore, a guidance law based on tau theory is employed by only using the visual information of the line of sight to the target. In this phase, a trajectory tracking controller is applied to generate the velocity commands of the UAV. Finally, the whole algorithm is validated by simulating different wave conditions in Unity3D. Compared with traditional trajectory planning methods, our method does not require complex optimization iterations and can meet both the real-time and accuracy requirements of deck landing.

articleTitle: A Survey of Maneuvering Target Prediction via Interactive Multiple Model
abstract: Maneuvering target prediction is a kind of methods to estimate the future state of moving target with randomness and complexity, according to the information of historical moment or current moment. During the target maneuvering, larger prediction error will be produced by single motion model. So the interactive multiple model is adapted. By this means, several models are used to match with their moving states. Then the parallel filtering is realized, and the results of filters are weighted and combined to obtain the final result. So the prediction accuracy of the proposed method for the more complex motions is higher. In this paper, considering the common states of constant velocity, constant acceleration and variable acceleration, the principle of interactive multiple model is introduced. And then its study and application in target prediction is reviewed. Finally, the development and the trends of the interactive multiple model in the target prediction is analyzed and prospected.

articleTitle: Sparse Signal Recovery via Tail-FISTA
abstract: We propose tail fast iterative shrinkage-thresholding algorithm (tail-FISTA) to solve compressed sensing problem, and it considers fast iterative shrinkage-thresholding algorithm (FISTA) method to solve tail- ℓ<inf>1</inf> minimization problem. By means of the profile method, the tail- ℓ<inf>1</inf> minimization problem is rewritten as a transformed ordinary ℓ<inf>1</inf> minimization problem, and its solution can be obtained by FISTA. FISTA is attractive due to the computational simplicity and well global rate of convergence rate O(1/n<sup>2</sup>). In simulation study, the performance of numerical examples is better than traditional compressed sensing algorithms. From the application of tail-FISTA, we can find that tail-FISTA is a potential compressed sensing algorithm.

articleTitle: Formation Control of Unmanned Surface Vehicle for Actuator Failure
abstract: This paper solves formation control problem for unmanned surface vehicle (USV) under actuator failure. Based on virtual pilot-following control strategy and adopting the guidance law, an adaptive backstepping control formation strategy based on a nonlinear disturbance observer is proposed. Taking into account the influence of external disturbances on the navigation of the USV, a nonlinear disturbance observer is designed to estimate and compensate in the control law. A robust term is designed to compensate the actuator fault parameters and effectively solve the problem of USVs formation stability control under actuator faults. Taking into account the jamming of the actuators, the formation needs to be reconstructed to change the formation to ensure the smooth progress of the formation task. The simulation proved the effective operation of the formation control strategy.

articleTitle: A Fast 3D Laser SLAM Method for Indoor Scenarios
abstract: Indoor positioning is the key technology for intelligent mobile platform, and laser SLAM is a typical high accuracy solution. Compared with 2D method, 3D laser SLAM is with higher accuracy and computational complexity. To improve the real-time performance of 3D laser SLAM, a fast 3D laser SLAM method is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the 3D laser point cloud is divided into several regions according to its height, and the point cloud of each region is projected onto the corresponding plane. Then the projection plane point cloud of each region is used as the input of 2D laser SLAM to obtain the independent positioning result set. Finally, positioning of each layer is combined to get global positioning by adaptive weight fusion. Experimental results show that the proposed method can consider both accuracy and real-time performance, and obtain relatively less time consumption within acceptable positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: Unit Circles Decomposition-based Coverage Path Planning for UAV
abstract: In this paper, a coverage path planning (CPP) scheme for an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) in coverage observation is proposed. The algorithms begin by decomposing the task region into several unit circles. The positions of the unit circles are optimized by the improved Particle-Glowworm Swarm Optimization algorithm based on the area size of the unit circle and task region. Then the connection sequence of all unit circles is solved by the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) algorithm according to the shortest path principle. Further, the cubic Bézier curve is used to fit the centers of all unit circles to get a smooth coverage path. Finally, two curvature adjustment algorithms are proposed to optimize curvature. The main contribution of the paper is to present a scheme that generates a smooth coverage path while providing coverage optimization and path length optimization. Computer simulations validate the effectiveness of the algorithms.

articleTitle: Incipient Fault Detection Based on Kolmogorov-Smironv Test
abstract: Most of the traditional data-driven fault detection methods depend on the change of mean value and the shift of variables. However, incipient faults are characterized by low amplitude and masked by unknown disturbances and noise. Incipient faults are not detected effectively by the traditional data-driven methods. If incipient faults are ignored, it will cause potential problems to the operation of industrial processes. It is of great importance to study the detection of incipient faults. In this study, a Kolmogorov-Smironv (K-S) test based incipient fault detection method is proposed. First, the sample data is divided into training data and test data; second, a principal component analysis (PCA) model is established with the training data to obtain the loading matrix; third, the principal component subspace (PCS) of the training data and the PCS of the test data are calculated with the load matrix; fourth, the empirical distribution function (EDF) of the principal components of the training data and the test data are calculated in each sliding window; finally, K-S statistics are calculated to determine whether a fault occurs. Moreover, the effectiveness of the proposed solution is verified in the continuous stirred tank heater (CSTH) process simulation models.

articleTitle: Parameter identification and SOC estimation of lithium-ion battery based on AGCOA optimization
abstract: Considering the polarization effect of lithium-ion battery, this paper establishes a second-order RC model, and proposes an adaptive global optimal guided coyote optimal identification algorithm (AGCOA). It effectively solves the problems of traditional heuristic algorithms that are easy to fall into local optima and slow convergence. The battery testing equipment NEWARE BTS-4008 is used to charge and discharge the lithium-ion battery. The parameters identified by the AGCOA are used to predict the terminal voltage, and the extended Kalman filter algorithm (EKF) is used to estimate the battery SOC. The results show that the predicted voltage obtained by the identification is basically the same as the actual voltage, and the SOC estimation error is small, which verifies the efficiency and accuracy of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Location and Capacity of Charging Station for Electric Vehicles Based on Weighted K-Means Clustering
abstract: Aiming at the uneven distribution of electric vehicles (EVs) charging load caused by the randomness of user travel, this paper proposes a location and capacity of charging station solution based on the weighted K-Means clustering algorithm by defining the "weight" of the charging load. First, analyze the EVs charging load distribution and calculate the weight according to the travel law and state of charge of EVs to form a set of EVs charging load data points to be clustered; Second establish the location and capacity model of charging station with the target of minimizing total annual cost; Then consider the influence of the service range, capacity and number of charging stations to perform weighted K-Means clustering on the charging load data points in the planning area, and select the best location and capacity of charging station for EVs based on different clustering results by calculating the contour coefficient; Finally, it is verified by a simulation example that the weighted K-Means clustering algorithm is feasible for optimizing the location and capacity of charging station for EVs.

articleTitle: Modulation and Control Strategy of Three-Phase Three-Level Four-Leg NPC Inverter
abstract: In this paper, modulation and control strategies of a three-phase three-level four-leg neutral-point-clamped(3L4L-NPC) inverter are studied. A simplified space vector PWM method is proposed. Firstly, based on the modulation for the two-level four-leg neutral-point-clamped(2L4L-NPC) inverter, the modulation for 3L4L-NPC inverter becomes easier. Three-dimension space vector modulation(3D-SVM) for 3L4L-NPC inverter can be shifted to 3D-SVM for 2L4L-NPC inverter due to the modulation space for 3L4L-NPC inverter can be divided into 12 modulation spaces for the 2L4L-NPC inverter. Secondly, based on the rational arrangement of redundant vectors, an accurate compensation method for neutral point voltage balance is proposed. Since the fourth leg provides a path for the circulation of zero-sequence current, 3L4L-NPC inverter exhibits high performance for asymmetric or nonlinear loads. This paper provides a double closed-loop PI control to maintain the topology working reliably. The advantage of the proposed modulation strategy is that vectors, needed to be synthesized for the reference vector, can be found out easily, and duty cycles for each of them can be calculated in 3D-SVM for 2L4L-NPC inverter. In addition, the DC-Link capacitance voltages can work in a dynamic balancing mode with minimal vibration. The simulation is built to verify the correctness and the feasibility of the proposed modulation and control method.

articleTitle: A blowing endpoint judgment method for converter steelmaking based on improved DenseNet
abstract: In the blowing process of converter steelmaking, it is required to make accurate judgment of the end point of converter steelmaking. In order to improve the accuracy of the end point judgment of converter steelmaking, this paper makes full use of a large amount of flame image information in the blowing process, and adopts deep learning algorithm to carry out automatic feature learning and classification of the flame image of converter steelmaking. In this paper, we propose a model algorithm based on the improved DenseNet by replacing the cross-entropy loss function with Focal-loss in the final output part, and introducing the attention mechanism based on the DenseNet model. The experimental results verified that its highest detection classification accuracy reached 98.12% and the test accuracy reached 96.55%. It effectively improves the accuracy of converter endpoint judgment, ensures the efficiency of steelmaking, and reduces the waste of labor and raw material cost, which can be applied in the actual converter steelmaking endpoint judgment.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Development Level of Smart Urban Rail Transit
abstract: Based on the perspective of wisdom and general requirements of Smart City Rail Development Outline published by general requirements of CHINA Association of Metros, this paper establishes a relatively completed evaluation system of the development level of smart urban rail transit, including 6 primary indexes and 25 secondary indexes. It establishes the entropy weight TOPSIS evaluation model and takes Beijing urban rail transit as an example to analyze. The results show that, the development level of Beijing smart urban rail transit increased from 2017 to 2020.Among them, intelligent train operation, intelligent operation and management and intelligent passenger service play an important role. Intelligent transportation organization, intelligent network management, urban rail cloud and big data platform should be strengthened in management,which can realize the balanced development of the smart urban rail transit.

articleTitle: Invariant Tensor Modeling and Functional Matrix Coding of Flight Dynamics for Nonlinear Aircraft Control
abstract: Flight trajectory consistence is an important factor influencing mission performance and safety. However, the lack of in-situ flight dynamics with high fidelity remains a challenge to enhance stability and controllability for aircraft maneuver in space, because modeling and coding of predictive system response in control synthesis is difficult to be mathematically formulated and computationally implemented. Here we generalize the invariant tensor modeling of flight dynamics so that its functional matrix coding is adapted to the multivariable nonlinear control of aircraft with augmented stability and controllability; and we verify that the nonlinear functional parameters in control synthesis with unobservable external forces and moments can improve the consistence of flight trajectory. Results demonstrate that the planned flight trajectory can be consistently fulfilled using the nonlinear control synthesized through tensor modeling and matrix coding. In conclusion, invariant tensor modeling facilitates the functional matrix coding of flight dynamics with six degrees of freedom, which can be applied to build the feedback through dimensional analysis for augmented stability and controllability, such that collaborative optimization of nonlinear functional parameters establishes the multivariable nonlinear control to improve the consistence of flight trajectory for sustained performance and continuing safety.

articleTitle: Evolutionary game of banks and enterprises in digital supply chain finance driven by blockchain
abstract: In order to explore the influence of blockchain technology on supply chain financing, this article builds an evolutionary game model of banks and enterprises, which is associated with traditional supply chain finance financing and digital supply chain finance based on blockchain technology, besides, the article also analyzes the evolutionary path of subject behavior in different situations. Our research shows that, both of the two evolutionary game models have three stable evolutionary states. Through simulation, we find that under the guarantee of blockchain technology, the role of punishment mechanism and credit incentive can be better played in supply chain financing, and the supply chain ecology will be more optimized.

articleTitle: Study on energy saving mechanism of truck platoon based on air resistance coefficient correction
abstract: This paper studies the energy-saving problem of truck platoon. Firstly, the air resistance coefficient of platoon members is modified, and then the lower controller is established. Then, the Sliding mode variable structure control (SMC) controller based on the constant spacing policy and the PID controller based on the constant time headway spacing policy are established. TruckSim is used to simulate the three working conditions of platoon starting acceleration, platoon running at constant speed and Driving cycle, Finally, the simulation results show that the designed sliding mode controller has remarkable energy-saving effect.

articleTitle: Demand response strategy for smart community considering user preferences
abstract: Residential users of smart grid have strong flexibility on energy consumption due to the variety of loads. This characteristic is very beneficial for the grid to alleviate peak demand. Smart communities are gaining widespread attention as a new category of residential demand-side entity. In this paper, a demand response strategy is proposed for the smart community, which takes the usage preferences of various users into account. The proposed strategy firstly gets the household optimal demand by maximizing the utility of individual households under the overall community load. Then it defines the preferences of various users in the community as willingness to pay so that the demand can be adaptively adjusted according to the user's willingness to pay and the electricity price. Finally, it adopts DR algorithm with heuristic scheme to schedule users' electricity appliances in the community to curtail users' electricity costs and peak load. Simulations show that the proposed demand response strategy can improve user' individual surplus during peak price hours and result in lower costs for user.

articleTitle: Finite-time prescribed performance adaptive fuzzy control for non-triangular uncertain nonlinear systems based on nonlinear command filter
abstract: In this article, the finite-time prescribed performance adaptive fuzzy control for non-triangular nonlinear systems is proposed. Firstly, the unknown functions can be identified and the algebraic-loop problem is avoided by adopting fuzzy approximation technique. Secondly, the computational burden of the controller is significantly alleviated by designing the nonlinear command filter to obtain the derivatives of intermediate command signals. Thirdly, by combining the finite-time prescribed performance function and backstepping method, a novel finite-time adaptive fuzzy controller is developed. All the solutions of the closed-loop system are proved to be finite-time convergent. Finally, a simulation example is presented to illustrate the theoretical method.

articleTitle: A two-stage pipeline defect depth estimation method based on MFL signals
abstract: Magnetic flux leakage (MFL) internal inspection is widely used in pipeline non-destructive testing (NDT) with its low cost and high efficiency. Affected by different environments, MFL signals are complex and changeable, which has brought severe challenges to the accurate estimation of defect depth. In this paper, a novel pipeline defect depth estimation method is proposed to improve the accuracy, which can extract deep features from MFL signals adaptively. First, an auto-encoder is designed to extract primary features from MFL signals in an unsupervised way. Second, a classification neural network is developed to extract secondary features in a supervised way. To make better use of the feature information, part of the weight and structure from auto-encoder is reused in this network. Third, a random forest model is constructed to study the complex nonlinear relationship between features and defect depth. Experimental results are compared with state-of-art method from seven aspects, which highlight the superiority of the proposed method in defect depth estimation.

articleTitle: Improved Linear Active Disturbance Rejection Control Strategy Based on RBF Neural Network For Main Steam Temperature Of Thermal Power Boiler
abstract: The main steam temperature is an important parameter of thermal power boiler. In view of the problem that the traditional PID control algorithm cannot meet the expectation of good control quality of the main steam temperature, an improved linear active disturbance rejection controller based on RBF neural network recognizer is designed to adjust the main steam temperature of the boiler. The control quantity formula in the linear ADRC system is improved as increment type, and add a tracking differentiator, Moreover, the Jacobian information of main steam temperature is identified online by the RBF network to realize the self-tuning of the weight coefficients of the control variables which can reduce the difficulty of parameter setting of controller. The proposed algorithm is applied to the main steam temperature control system of power boiler,and the experimental results show that this method can controls the main steam temperature fluctuation range to ± 5°C and has strong robustness and short adjusting time.

Author Keywords: Improved linear active disturbance rejection controller

articleTitle: Study on hybrid modeling of urban wastewater treatment process
abstract: In view of the complexity of the actual wastewater treatment process, it is very difficult to establish an accurate mechanism model. The simple mechanism model cannot accurately describe all the characteristics of the actual process, and moreover the complex relationship between variables is difficult to be completely included in the mechanism model. In general, the prediction accuracy of the mechanism model is not high. Therefore, the data-driven modeling method is used to model the complex relationship between the actural process data. In this paper, the hybrid model of the activated sludge system in the wastewater treatment process is established, which combines the simplified BSM1 mechanism model with the BP neural network. In the hybrid model, the BP neural network is used to compensate the predictive error between the mechanism model output and the actual output. The simulation results show that the hybrid model can overcome the shortcomings of the traditional mechanism model and improve the prediction accuracy. The predictive performance using the hybrid model is improved considerably, which validates the effectiveness and applicability of the proposed hybrid model into the urban wastewater treatment process.

articleTitle: An Online Parameter Estimation Method Based on Adaptive Unscented Kalman Filter for Unmanned Surface Vessel
abstract: In this paper, an online parameter estimation method for unmanned surface vessels (USVs) is designed. The main idea is to establish an augmented system by viewing the parameters as system states, and then estimate the full states of the augmented system by using adaptive unscented Kalman filter (AUKF). Nine parameters including the inertial effects, the damping, the thrust allocation, and the current velocity can be online estimated accurately based on the measurements from real-time kinematic (RTK) Global Positioning System (GPS) and inertial measurement unit (IMU). The trajectory tracking control is further studied in the presence of input constraints, where the model predictive control (MPC) is introduced. The simulation results of parameter estimation demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Charge Time Prediction Model of Power Battery based on Random Forest algorithm
abstract: Power battery is the core equipment of electric vehicles. The function of power battery is to realize power supply for vehicles. The charge time of power battery is the key to ensure the effectively use of vehicles. Predicting the charge time of power battery in advance can improve system operating efficiency. This paper establishes a power battery charge time prediction method for power battery based on random forest algorithm. Firstly, important fuel parameter data is collected and the influence of the associated data on the charge time of the power battery is analyzed; Secondly, a random forest regression algorithm is developed, where the training set data is used to predict and model the charge time of the power battery; Finally, test set data is used to conduct a comprehensive simulation on the established prediction model. The results show that the model prediction data can fit well with the measured data, indicating the effectiveness of the power battery charge time prediction model in this paper.

articleTitle: A Closed-loop Fast Charging Strategy Based on Core Temperature Control for Lithium-ion Battery
abstract: Fast charging is one of the main requirements and challenges for electric vehicle batteries. Currently, common charging profiles utilize an open-loop control, which relies on a priori knowledge. It's necessary to use a closed-loop charging technique, where the charging current is controlled by real-time voltage and temperature, particularly when high charging current. Moreover, the massive difference between surface and core temperature leads to thermal issues. Therefore, this paper proposes a closed-loop fast charging strategy (CFCS) based on core temperature control for lithium-ion batteries (LIBs), with an awareness of thermal safety. CFCS includes three modes, i.e., pulse current charging (PCC) mode, constant temperature (CT) mode with a proportional-integral-derivative (PID) controller, and constant voltage (CV) mode. Besides, an extended state observer (ESO) is applied for real-time core temperature estimation, combined with a two-state thermal model. Based on the core temperature control, there is a 40% reduction in charging time compared to the previous method. Meanwhile, core temperature is maintained in a safe range, which keeps the LIB from thermal runaway. The experimental results show the proposed strategy can balance rapidity and security, with a wide application range and strong robustness.

articleTitle: An Interval Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm for Solving Multimodal Optimization Problem
abstract: For the interval particle swarm optimization (IPSO) algorithm, we found that when the target of IPSO to be optimized is a multimodal function, the IPSO is easy to fall into a local optimal solution and it is difficult to find multiple optimal solutions. Therefore, this paper proposes a new IPSO for solving multimodal optimization problems, i.e., niching IPSO (NIPSO). First, the niching technology is studied and the PSO topology is analyzed. In order to improve the ability of the algorithm to jump out of the local optimal solution, the Ring topology is used to construct the particle swarm niching. Then based on the niching idea, a dual file mechanism is proposed to maintain multiple optimal solutions through individual best file PBA and neighborhood best file NBA. Finally, several multimodal functions are selected to simulate the algorithm proposed in this paper, and the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified.

articleTitle: Fixed-time lag synchronization of second-order fuzzy complex-valued neural networks with discontinuous functions
abstract: This paper is dedicated to p-norm fixed-time lag synchronization(FXTLS) of second-order fuzzy complex-valued neural networks(FCVNNs). Differential inclusion theory is utilized to deal with discontinuous systems. The first-order real-valued differential equations are obtained from the second-order FCVNNs by reduced-order transformation and dividing the real and imaginary parts of the complex-valued parameters. Based on Lyapunov stability theory and some inequality tricks, two complex-valued control schemes are designed to guarantee FXTLS. Finally, numerical simulation is presented in order to show consistency with the theoretical outcomes obtained in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Collaborative Governance and Development Countermeasures of Intelligent Elderly Care in Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Communities Driven by Blockchain Technology
abstract: China’s elderly care is facing new development trends and some new characteristics. Community intelligent elderly care collaborative governance can promote the high-quality comprehensive development of Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei. At present, blockchain is setting off an upsurge of innovation all over the world, and China has also put forward an innovative development strategy with blockchain as the core technology. In this context, it is of great significance to promote the coordinated development of Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei by building a collaborative governance mechanism for smart elderly care in Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei communities based on blockchain technology, creating a good blockchain innovation environment and promoting the high-quality development of community elderly care.

articleTitle: Development of Double Closed Loop Control based on Explicit Model Predictive Control for PMSM
abstract: This work deals with the development of double closed loop control based on explicit model predictive control (MPC) for permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) system with constraints. The aim of the proposed controller is to solve the constrained optimization problem for fast-sampling time PMSM system and improve the robustness of the system. The recreated mathematical model of PMSM is introduced at first. Then the proposed explicit MPC controller is designed based on the reformed model. The explicit controller is employed to control the mechanical speed and the q-axis current, and the proportional-integral (PI) control is employed to control d-axis current. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed double closed loop control method is effective when the working condition of PMSM changes and the performance of the speed and current is satisfactory.

articleTitle: Predictive Control of the Converter Inlet Temperature in the Flue Gas Acid-making Based on Wiener Model
abstract: In this paper, for the conversion rate of the flue gas acid-making, a predictive control strategy for the inlet temperature of the converter is studied. First, a nonlinear Wiener model is established for process control, which can well characterize the non-linear change of process temperature. Second, a model predictive control method based on the Wiener inverse model is proposed. The process theory is used to realize the effective control of the inlet temperature of the converter, thereby ensuring the conversion rate of the sulphuric acid process. Finally, the Wiener model predictive control (WMPC) is evaluated experimentally and compared with proportional integral derivative (PID) strategy. The simulation results show that the WMPC outperforms the PID controller.

articleTitle: Ring-pendulum Double-sided Polisher with Improved Super Twisting Sliding Mode Active Disturbance Rejection Control
abstract: To achieve fast, accurate, and stable rotation speed control for the ring-pendulum double-sided polisher (RDP), this paper proposes an improved super twisting sliding mode active disturbance rejection control (ISTSMADRC) method for RDP. This method increases the disturbance rejection ability of the system through the extended state observer of the ADRC. Meanwhile, the super twisting sliding mode (STSM) control is improved by the boundary layer method, and the ISTSM control law replaces the error feedback control law of the ADRC controller, then the response speed of system is enhanced. The performance of controller is analyzed by step response test, tracking performance test, and robustness test. The results show that the ISTSMADRC controller has fast response speed, high control accuracy, good tracking performance, and strong robustness.

articleTitle: Enhanced Wi-Fi indoor positioning real application based on access points optimization ensemble model
abstract: When designing a Wi-Fi indoor positioning system in large, real-world environments, the problem we have to face is that available access points of indoor location scenes are very extensive, and the signal interference is very serious, leading to weak positioning accuracy. Besides, too many access points also increase the computation complexity and the storage size of the fingerprint database. To remedy those problems, we propose a new ensemble model consisting of Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) region classifier and Random Forest feature learner using best-discriminating access points optimization to enhance Wi-Fi indoor positioning real application. The GMM classifier is applied to get better regional classification, and for the same area, the Random Forest feature learner is trained to obtain best-discriminating access points optimization. To fully reflect the performance of the proposed method, experiments have been carried out in the real environment of indoor parking lots and the performance of the proposed algorithm was compared with the other three existing access points optimization methods. The results show that the proposed access points optimization ensemble model successfully enhances Wi-Fi indoor positioning real application of indoor parking lots.

articleTitle: Research on uvms control method based on disturbance observation
abstract: As an important tool to explore and develop marine resources, underwater robot manipulator system is widely used in offshore oil engineering, underwater fishing and other industries at home and abroad. But in the complex underwater environment, the anti-interference ability of uvms(Underwater Vehicle Manipulator System) system has always been the focus of current research. This paper aims to start with the commonly used PID control method, design and simulate the active disturbance rejection controller, and compare with the traditional control method. Finally, experiments are carried out on the uvms system in pool and field lake. The experimental results show that the uvms system has stable motion and good maneuverability, and the underwater manipulator can grasp the underwater target quickly and accurately.

articleTitle: A Research Review of Pest Identification and Detection Based on Deep Learning
abstract: Efficient and accurate identification of pests will effectively help solve agricultural pest problems, promote the intelligence, professional and greening of crop pest control. Traditional pest identification and control methods are inefficient, and the use of artificial intelligence technologies such as deep learning and computer vision can significantly reduce human costs and largely improve the efficiency and accuracy of the pest identification process. A review is conducted on deep learning-based pest identification methods, introducing the application and development of different deep learning networks, analyzing the latest research progress of domestic and international scholars in the field, and comparing the performance and characteristics with each other. Existing pest recognition datasets are summarized to provide a reference for in-depth research on the application of pest recognition and detection.

articleTitle: Multi-objective day-ahead optimal scheduling of wind-solar microgrid considering V2G technology
abstract: Although adding V2G economic dispatch to the wind-solar load-storage microgrid has higher economic benefits, it may lead to “peaks on top of peaks”. In order to solve this problem, this paper establishes a three-objective day-ahead optimal scheduling model that comprehensively considers economics, grid-connected power mean square error and grid-connected power peak-to-valley difference. The multi-objective gray wolf algorithm with multi-period cosine convergence factor is used to solve the transfer tram load mode and V2G mode respectively, which effectively compensates for the disadvantage that the gray wolf algorithm is easy to fall into local optimum. Finally, the numerical example analysis shows that the established optimal scheduling model is correct and effective.

articleTitle: A Visual Identification Method of Analog Instrument Panel Based on Faster R-CNN
abstract: Intelligent inspection robots are being widely used in unmanned gas stations. However, the complicated background environment is a disturbance for most of the current visual identification method of analog instrument panel. It is challenging to extract pointer centerline and surface area. The existing methods cannot satisfy the actual demand of gas stations to get the current problems solved. In this work, we presents an object detection algorithm based on faster R-CNN method and designed a two-stage automatic identification method of analog instrument panel combined with conventional computer vision algorithms. First, the improved faster R-CNN is utilized for the detection of the target dashboard area. Then, the image is preprocessed based on some image processing methods. Moreover, the pointer’s centerline is detected by the algorithm based on Hough transformation. Finally, the meter identification is calculated by the angle calculation method. The performance verification and analysis of the algorithm demonstrates that the method proposed in this work is reliable and efficient for automatic identification of instrument panel in the working condition of gas stations and provides a quite practical method for target detection and identification of instrument panel.

articleTitle: A Variable Attention-Based Gated GRU Approach for Soft Sensor Models
abstract: The actual industrial process is dynamic and nonlinear, so the collected data of the industrial process is a complex series of time series. Soft sensor modeling of nonlinear processes’ dynamic inputs and outputs is necessary for production processes. Gated neural networks with long-term memory can handle nonlinear time series data well and are suitable as a basic network model for soft sensor modeling. However, the simple Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) does not consider the correlation between input and output variables nor the contribution of feature representation. A variable attention-based gated GRU (VAGGRU) network is proposed in this paper to solve the above problems. In this network, an attention mechanism is used to assign weights to different input variables according to the relevance of the inputs and outputs. Then, the contribution of the features proposed by each layer of the GRU is calculated by gated neurons to obtain further a feature representation that is highly relevant to the prediction target. Improving the model’s prediction accuracy is achieved by continuously extracting the feature representations related to the prediction target. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed model was verified by applying it to the penicillin fermentation process and the actual industrial process through simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Driving Evaluation System in Specific Scene
abstract: Test evaluation is an important procedure in development process of autonomous vehicle, and efficient evaluation system can greatly improve the development efficiency of autonomous driving system. Currently, autonomous driving in specific scenes has become the primary application scenes. To satisfy the requirement of autonomous driving in specific scenes, a scenario-specific autonomous driving simulation evaluation system is proposed. Firstly, the framework of scenario-specific autonomous driving evaluation system is put forward based on the entropy value model and sequential relationship analysis. The elements of tasks performed by autonomous vehicles are extracted and their weights are calculated. Then the task elements are ranked and combined weight of the task is calculated based on the weight of each element. Finally, the evaluation results are calculated based on the completion of each task element. Experimental results show that the proposed method can evaluate the completion quality of autonomous vehicle tasks for specific scenarios comprehensively and accurately, and greatly reduce the development cost of autonomous driving system for specific scenarios.

articleTitle: A Novel Garbage Images Classification Method Based on Improved VGG
abstract: In recent years, garbages classification have became a hot topic in environmental protection and social livelihood. The traditional method for garbages classification has a higher cost and lower accuracy. In order to reduce the cost of garbages classification and improve the efficiency of garbages classification, a new garbages image classification method is proposed based on improved VGG16 migration learning model. First, we collected and sorted out many garbages images including common recyclable garbages, hazardous garbages, kitchen waste and other garbages. Then fine-tune the network structure of VGG16, and add a convolutional layer with selu as the activation function after the first 5 blocks of VGG16, and replace the fully connected layer with a global average pooling layer to reduce the over-fitting phenomenon. Finally, the data set after data enhancement is used to train the model and check the accuracy of the model. Comparative experiments show that the accuracy of the improved model on the test set is increased to 96.21%, the loss is reduced to 0.1203, and the training time is the shortest. It has certain advantages in the field of garbages image classification, also, the garbages sorting device is designed based on our method.

articleTitle: Finite time switching optimal control for tilt-rotor aircrafts based on novel time scaling method
abstract: In this paper, the optimal control of tilt-rotor aircraft with finite time switching based on time scale method is investigated. By using the switching approach, the longitudinal dynamics model of the transition section of the tilt-rotor aircraft is established and an improved control parameterization method is presented to optimize control. Considering the transition process of the aircraft rotor switching, the finite time control is investigated. Existing methods use a time period as the optimization parameter, which may cause the gradient to be discontinuous at switching instants. To deal with it, a novel time-variable-based time scaling method is proposed. On the basis, the unknown switching instant can be expressed as a known instant, which ensures the continuity of the switching instants, and the optimal switching control problem can be transformed to a parameter selection issue. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by a simulation.

articleTitle: Skip reentry trajectory planning based on multi-phase Gauss pseudospectral method
Sliding mode torque control for switched reluctance motor
abstract: The advantages of switched reluctance motor(SRM) are obvious, and it applies to more and more industries. However, the torque ripple is more serious than other kinds of motors, so the control strategy of SRM is very important. As a kind of variable structure nonlinear control, sliding mode control is widely used. In this paper, the torque controller in indirect torque control(ITC) strategy is implemented with sliding mode control. Through the stability analysis of ideal conditions and parameter perturbation, the selection of controller parameters is given. Finally, the controller is verified by simulation and experiment. The simulation and experiment show that the controller can effectively track the real-time changing torque instruction, and the tracking effect is good.

articleTitle: Pre-trained Bert for Natural Language Guided Reinforcement Learning in Atari Game
abstract: Inspired by the dream of using natural language to guide an Agent, we propose a language understanding model that links natural language commands with particular target states, so that the agent can better understand the tasks expressed in natural language. The agent performs exploration in the environment according to human intentions through the decision-making method of reinforcement learning, which will improve the performance and efficiency of exploration. By using the most advanced text-based pre-trained language model Bert, the language understanding model is robust to human commands.

articleTitle: Multi-person interaction action recognition based on co-occurrence graph convolutional network
abstract: Skeleton-based human action recognition has attracted more and more attention with the accessibility of depth sensors and the development of pose estimation technology. The recognition of multi-person interaction behavior with skeleton data has wide applications in real life. However, the existing skeleton-based action recognition methods mainly focus on single-person actions, and lack the research on the semantic information of the skeleton co-occurrence relationship in the spatial dimension. Here, a two-stream co-occurrence graph convolutional network (2s-CGCN) is proposed for multi-person interactive action recognition. The topological connection structure of the proposed model establishes connections between the human limbs and the head to capture the co-occurrence feature. In addition, the coordinates and co-occurrence information of the joints are simultaneously input into the model. The experiments of mutual actions in the NTU-RGB+D dataset show the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Analysis and Application of Weighted-Median Hegselmann-Krause Opinion Dynamics Model on Social Networks
abstract: In the classic Hegselmann-Krause (H-K) model, the greater the difference in individual opinions, the stronger the attractiveness, this is the unrealistic social phenomenon. In this paper, we propose a weighted-median H-K opinion dynamics model to capture the realistic social phenomenon. It is revealed that the proposed weighted-median H-K model is not affected by the stubborn individual. Furthermore, we apply our established weighted-median H-K model to the fake news claimed by US President Trump, it is shown that people do not believe the statement by Trump, which is in accord with the real situation. A numerical example is provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed the weighted-median H-K opinion dynamics model.

articleTitle: Couple-group consensus of heterogeneous fractional Multi-Agent Systems with pinning and self-adaptive controller
abstract: In this paper, the couple-group consensus for a kind of heterogeneous fractional multi-agent systems (HFMASs) with time-varying delay has been investigated. Based on cooperative-competitive interactions, a novel consensus protocol has been proposed for this kind of HFMASs. Furthermore, the pinning controller and self-adaptive controller have been introduced into this control protocol. By using Lyapunov function and linear matrix inequality (LMI) technology, some sufficient conditions have been obtained for the couple-group consensus of this system. Finally, some simulation examples have been given to prove the validity of these conclusions.

articleTitle: Hegselmann-Krause Opinion Model on High-order Network
abstract: Individuals’ opinions are influenced not only by the pairwise interactions, but by the private groups for the complicated social environment. In this study, we take the high-order structure into consideration of opinion dynamics, which can be regarded as the relationship of small groups in private. A modified high-order model based on the Hegselmann-Krause model is proposed, and also, conditions for this model to reach a consensus is given. According to the simulation results, we find the intervention of private groups makes the diversity of eventual opinion decrease and weaken the requirements of Hegselmann-Krause’s confidence bound for consensus, when the groups’ influence is not much intensive compared with the pairwise interactions. However, if the intensity of private groups’ influence becomes extremely large, individual’s opinions can hardly reach a consensus, and the opinion diversity is even larger than the eventual opinions of original Hegselmann-Krause model. Meanwhile, smaller confidence bound is needed for the population to reach consensus, but the time to reach consensus becomes longer, and the increase of confidence interval helps to decrease the time needed.

articleTitle: Prediction of PMV of Body Thermal Comfort in Office Based on PSO-GRNN
abstract: Because the prediction of thermal comfort is a complex, nonlinear process, which is not convenient for the application of real-time control of air conditioning, neural network can quickly establish the nonlinear mapping between the input and output of PMV index, which becomes a new research direction of PMV index solution. PSO is used to optimize GRNN parameters and build a prediction model, which can find the optimal smooth factor of GRNN network in the shortest time, so that the trained network can meet the requirements of both learning ability and learning speed. The results show that the generalized regression neural network inherits all the advantages of RBF network, and is superior in approximation ability and learning speed. From the experiment, when the SPREAD value is the same, the prediction accuracy of GRNN network is slightly better than that of RBF network. The prediction accuracy of GRNN network can also be improved obviously after PSO optimization.

articleTitle: L2-Gain Disturbance Attenuation-Based Decentralized Secondary Frequency Control in Autonomous Microgrids
abstract: This paper proposes an L<inf>2</inf>-gain disturbance attenuation-based decentralized secondary control for frequency regulation and accurate active power sharing in autonomous microgrids. Such as the randomness of distributed generations (DGs) and uncertainty in load behaviors, the proposed decentralized secondary control can effectively suppress a kind of disturbance of the outside world, so that robustness and asymptotical stability of the microgrid can be achieved. Unlike most of the existing works, a systematic approach of secondary control design is introduced based on the L<inf>2</inf>- gain disturbance attenuation theory by translating the microgrid system to the Port-controlled Kuramoto-Hamiltonian system. Only needing to be implemented using purely local information, the proposed decentralized secondary control can restore the frequency immediately following the disturbance in the microgrid without the need for event-detection and time-dependent protocol. Finally, the stability analysis is provided and the simulation results are presented to verify control performance under rapid load changes and flexibility during plug-and-play operations.

Author Keywords: frequency control and L2-gain disturbance attenuation control

articleTitle: Gas Ash Microscopic Image Segmentation with SLIC and Mean Shift
abstract: For the problems of long processing time, fragmentary clustering regions and poor segmentation accuracy of gas ash microscopic image segmentation with traditional mean shift algorithm, this paper proposes an improved image segmentation method combining simple linear iterative clustering (SLIC) and mean shift. Firstly, SLIC algorithm is employed to generate a certain number of superpixels of gas ash microscopic images. Then, color, texture, and position information of each superpixel are extracted, and mapped into feature space for mean shift clustering. Finally, an adaptive region merging algorithm is used to further merge similar regions. The experimental results indicate that as a sample mode, the generated superpixels are more effective than original pixels in mean shift clustering, that is, the processing time is greatly shorten and clustering regions are more complete. Owing to the addition of texture features, the generated target areas are more accurate, especially for mosaic structure. This study can offer a support for further automatic component recognition, which is the foundation of industrial robot in analysis of gas ash.

articleTitle: A Sliding Mode Control Scheme for Quadrotor Based on Fixed-time Extended State Observer
abstract: A tracking trajectory problem for a quadrotor via second order sliding mode is concerned. Traditional sliding mode controller exists chattering phenomenon among control input when the state variables stayed in sliding surfaced. This phenomenon that is caused by sign function which is used for anti-disturbing might stimulate the unmodeled dynamics. In past articles and essays, using deceased coefficients of sign or replaced that sign function with saturation function are to restrain chattering phenomenon. In this paper, considering using sign function to suppress internal unmatched coefficients and external disturbances during quadrotor operating, by employing sliding mode combined with fixed-time observers to handle the chattering phenomenon. The significance of utilizing fixed-time observers in control scheme is to observe state variables and disturbances of system in fixed-time. Thereby, the sign function is substituted by observation value, which means anti-disturbing term changed from sign function to observation value. Sequentially, under the control scheme the chattering phenomenon is minished or even eliminated. Finally, a comparative simulation demonstrates that the presented scheme can improve control performance and restrict chattering phenomenon.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control of Load Transportation System for Multiple Quadrotor UAVs
abstract: This paper focuses on the modeling and a generalized control framework for load transportation system with multiple quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicles(UAVs). At first, the dynamics models of quadrotor UAVs are established under the suspension point offset and uncertain disturbance, considering the carried load’s effects on each quadrotor UAV. And in order to transport the load smoothly and safely, the desired flight path of the leading UAV and the ideal formation among multiple UAVs are designed appropriately. Next, a coordinated control strategy based on the incremental double-closed PID method is developed to ensure the position and attitude tracking performance of each aircraft. The simulation results are exhibited to prove the effectiveness of the proposed control approach for the UAVs-Load systems.

articleTitle: Optimization control for CCS of coal-fired power unit based on reinforcement learning using process data
Coordinated Control Model of Oversaturated Critical Intersection Group Based on Associated Path
abstract: With the rapid development of economy, the demand of urban traffic and the pressure of management is also increasing. To alleviate traffic congestion and improve the overall traffic state of the road network, a coordinated control model of oversaturated critical intersection group based on associated path is proposed in this paper. It comprehensively considers all associated traffic flows, and the capacity demand model of each path is established. A Multi-Associated Path Coordinated Control Strategy (MAPCCS) is proposed to obtain the best signal timing results, which also makes the algorithm adapted to different situations of saturation. The simulation based on actual environment verifies that the model has significant advantages over traditional control methods.

articleTitle: MPC Simulation of Dual-Channel delay Closed-loop Supply Chain with Third-Party Reverse Logistics
abstract: With the emergence of e-commerce, the online and offline dual channel sales mode increases the complexity of the supply chain. The random delay of each link in the system increases the uncertainty of the network, which makes it more difficult to suppress the bullwhip effect. As an important link in the closed-loop supply chain, the third-party recycling logistics has a significant impact on the bullwhip effect in the supply chain system. Model predictive control (MPC) method is used to control the dual channel delay of the third party reverse logistics of closed-loop supply chain inventory status, as a result of the existence of random time delay, a single model cannot be a good description of system dynamic, so the first thing to establish a set of contains all the delay of the third party recycling channels of double closed-loop supply chain inventory balance equations, based on this through the state restructuring augmented state space model is established to solve the time delay caused by the network complexity; Secondly, the structure diagram is constructed in the environment of Simulink, and the prediction model, state estimation and objective function are given. Thirdly, the solution method of Kwik quadratic programming is deduced, and the solution steps of this method are given; Fourth, the switching process of MPC is clarified. The MPC controller corresponding to the time delay sequence is selected to work. At k time, the inactive MPC controller still calculates or estimates the state to ensure the seamless connection with k + 1 time; Finally, random demand, sinusoidal demand and ARMA prediction demand are used as input for simulation to verify the effectiveness of the method. The results show that this method can effectively restrain the bullwhip effect and smooth the production, order and inventory.

articleTitle: A Method for Contour Descriptor based on Enhanced Scale Space of the Main Projection Map
abstract: Contour information description is an essential and challenging section in image retrieval. Because contour-based image processing algorithms can achieve a high retrieval rate without the influence of illumination and color, a large number of feature description approaches based on closed contour are proposed, but the existing methods are still facing the challenges of accuracy and computational efficiency, and misjudge the image category when the images are taken from different angles. Scale-Space-based descriptor is regarded as a promising contour description method because it has a solid theoretical foundation and at the same time possesses the strength of appealing invariance properties. In this paper, a descriptor based on enhanced scale space and main projections (ESSMP) is proposed for image retrieval. The characteristics of a closed contour are effectively captured by the proposed descriptor. Meanwhile, the proposed descriptor has good properties, such as the invariance of the geometric transformation and the starting point of an object. We evaluated this descriptor on two popular benchmarking datasets, including The Princeton Shape Benchmark and MPEG-7. The experimental results confirm that our method is better than comparable complexity approaches and performs a competitive retrieval rate with respect to more complex and state-of-the-art descriptors. In addition, our method shows brilliant robustness to distortion and occlusion, which is better than other existing similar algorithms.

articleTitle: A Spatio-Temporal Traffic Flow Prediction Method Based on Dynamic Graph Convolution Network
abstract: A spatio-temporal traffic flow prediction model based on dynamic graph convolution network (DGCN) is proposed to solve the problem that using a fixed Laplacian matrix to model the spatial features of the road network in the existing traffic flow prediction process, which is unable to fully utilize the traffic data and leads to poor prediction performance. The model using global Laplacian matrix learning layer, spatial attention layer and gated cyclic unit layer to form a matrix learning module, extracts spatio-temporal features from the given traffic flow data and predicts the future Laplacian matrix, and then applies it to the spatio-temporal prediction module consisting of graph convolutional network (GCN), gated cyclic unit and Transformer layers. The experimental results show that the proposed model is not only capable of modeling spatial features in real time according to the given data, but also can effectively improve the accuracy of traffic flow prediction.

articleTitle: Time-Optimal Trajectory Planning of Hoisting Manipulator
abstract: Aiming at the problem of time-optimal trajectory planning for hoisting manipulator, the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to optimize the trajectory of 3-5-3 polynomial interpolation planning. First, based on the established kinematics model of hoisting manipulator, reducing the track running time, polynomial interpolation is used to plan the joint space trajectory. Secondly, the improved particle swam optimization algorithm with dynamically changing learning factor is used to optimize the joint space trajectory, which improves the work efficiency while meeting the joint angular velocity and acceleration constraints. Finally, Matlab simulation experiments are carried out, and the results verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the optimization algorithm.

articleTitle: A Neural Component Analysis Aided Extreme Learning Machine Method for Power System Transient Stability Assessment
abstract: In recent years, the transient stability assessment (TSA) of power systems has attracted more and more scholars’ attention. However, the scale of the power system is gradually increasing and the corresponding characteristics are gradually increasing, which makes the accuracy of TSA greatly compromised. Therefore, it is not appropriate to directly use the obtained original data for the assessment. Considering that there are generally nonlinear characteristics in the data of the power systems, this paper adopts a recent neural network dimension reduction method to process the data first, and then performing extreme learning machine (ELM) on reconstructed data to realize TSA. The proposed TSA model can remove redundant and noisy information in the original data, thereby improving the accuracy of evaluation. Finally, the IEEE 10-machine, 39-bus New England simulation system is adopted to demonstrate the validity and superiority of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Order Sequencing Problem in a Robotic Mobile Fulfillment System
abstract: With rapid development of Business-to-Customer (B2C) e-commerce, enormous goods assortment and fluctuated demand are presented in customer orders. Traditional manual warehouses have the demerits of low picking efficiency and high human cost, which misfit B2C e-commerce. To resolve the difficulties, a Robotic Mobile Fulfillment System (RMFS) is introduced and implemented. This paper studies the order sequencing problem in an RMFS with the situation that a rack can be reused among multiple picking stations in one rack schedule. In order to solve the problem, a Q-learning-based differential evolution algorithm is proposed. Compared with the existent algorithms, numerical experiments show that the proposed algorithm makes an evident improvement on order picking efficiency.

articleTitle: BRB-based distributed fault diagnosis for leader-following consensus of multi-agent systems under noisy measurement
abstract: In this paper, the belief rule base (BRB) based distributed fault diagnosis problem is studied for leader-following multi-agent systems (MASs) with measurement noises, where each agent can only measure the outputs of its neighbors in a noisy environment. A novel distributed protocol based on the relative measurement outputs is developed to achieve leader-following output consensus of MASs without fault in stochastic sense.
