The advantages and validity of the proposed scheme are verified on an actual hot strip mill process.

articleTitle: Spatially-varying Warping for Panoramic Image Stitching
abstract: Panoramic image stitching is widely implemented to many application scenarios, such as satellite remote sensing detection, street view mapping and medical image generation. In this paper, we study two processes that have great impact on the visual effects of the stitched images and are the most concerned by researchers, namely image registration and stitching seam removal. In contrast to the traditional panoramic image stitching algorithms that use only one global projection transformation matrix for image alignment, this paper proposes a spatially-varying deformation method that uses multiple local transformation matrices, including the APAP (As-Projective-As-Possible) method that can effectively reduce the image alignment error and geometric transformation distortion, the SPHP (Shape-Preserving Half-Projective) method that can combine good alignment accuracy and reduced projection distortion, and the AANAP (Adaptive As-Natural-As-Possible) method that can improve the perspective of non-overlapping regions of the stitched image and good accuracy. The image stitching performance can be well improved.

articleTitle: Traffic Signal Control with Deep Q-Learning Network (DQN) Algorithm at Isolated Intersection
abstract: As traffic congestion in cities becomes severe, Intelligent Traffic Signal Control (ITSC) at the isolated intersection has been actively researched and proven to be an effective solution to it. At present, most of the isolated intersections’ signals in cities use fixed-time control or actuated control, while the former method cannot dynamically adjust the signal timing scheme according to the real-time conditions of intersections, causing great traffic congestion. Although the latter one can dynamically adjust the signal timing scheme, it is local optimization and cannot obtain the optimal timing scheme. To improve them, this paper extracts the scenario model and implements signal timing optimization with an improved DQN algorithm, which takes a variety of traffic parameters as input and outputs a strategy for changing the signal phase. We refer to a typical intersection in Xi'an to build a virtual simulation platform and verify our proposed method on it. Experimental results show that the traffic signal control method based on Deep Q-Learning Network (DQN) Algorithm is superior to other methods. It reduces the average waiting time of vehicles by 26.7% and decreases the queue length, which greatly improves the road efficiency of the intersection. Further, the traffic signal control method based on Deep Q-Learning Network (DQN) Algorithm also can be extended to the regional coordination control of road networks.

articleTitle: Review of Research on Robot Visual Slam
abstract: SLAM technology, which is called simultaneous localization and mapping technology, is to make the robot running in the environment self-locate according to the estimation of its position and posture and the existing map, and at the same time build the map incrementally on this basis, and finally achieve the purpose of building the map and positioning for the whole environment. Firstly, this paper summarizes the history and development of SLAM technology. Secondly, it introduces monocular vision SLAM and RGB_D SLAM through two kinds of vision SLAM algorithms. Finally, it expounds the content of cooperation between vision technology and single robot, and finds related problems, and looks forward to the future.

articleTitle: Application of Deep Reinforcement Learning in UAVs: A Review
abstract: Deep reinforcement learning is one of the most important branches in the field of artificial intelligence. It has strong high-latitude data processing capabilities and is mainly used to solve control and decision-making problems. Many problems in the field of unmanned aerial vehicle(UAV) involve control and decision-making, so deep reinforcement learning has a wide range of applications in the field of UAVs. First, this article introduces the principles of classic reinforcement learning and extends to the principles of deep reinforcement learning. Secondly, this article describes the control and decision-making problems in the field of UAVs, and further introduces the application of deep reinforcement learning to these problems. Finally, this article looks forward to the future development direction of deep reinforcement learning in this field, and provides references for future related research.

articleTitle: Rough K-prototypes Clustering Algorithm Based on OTC Similarity and Between-Cluster Information for Mixed Data
abstract: In the iterative updating process of cluster center and partition matrix, most of the clustering algorithms for mixed data mainly consider the impact of the information within the cluster, but ignore the information between clusters, which results in low cluster separation. A rough clustering algorithm for mixed data based on the frequency division information between clusters is proposed. In the process of measuring the similarity between data objects and clusters, the unified object-cluster (OTC) similarity of mixed attribute data is used to avoid the transformation of classification attributes and numerical attributes and the parameter adjustment in the traditional clustering algorithms for mixed attribute data. The inter-cluster frequency division information is added in the iteration process of algorithm to ensure that the clustering result has high intra-cluster compactness and inter-cluster separation. Several groups of comparative experiments verified the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Self-healing control method combining model predictive control and restart strategy for 4WD mobile robot
abstract: This paper presents a self-healing control strategy based on the restart method and model predictive control (MPC) for four-wheel-drive (4WD) mobile robot. Self-healing control is a difficult and hot spot in the current control field. When a system fault occurs, appropriate control methods can be adopted to maintain the basic operation of the system in the fault stage. At the same time, the system eliminates faults on the premise of using manpower as little as possible. Solving it, the system returns to normal state. This method can improve the work efficiency of the system and reduce the waste of resources. However, it is difficult to maintain the normal operation of the system during the fault stage, and eliminating faults is filled with challenges. The proposed method effectively solves these two problems. The passive accidental fault causes actuator failure and reduces the number of control inputs. MPC adjusts other inputs to ensure that the 4WD mobile robot tracks the reference trajectory and eliminates passive accidental faults through restart method. The optimal the restart time is obtained by optimizing the objective function, ensuring the maximum probability of eliminating the fault in the shortest time. In the end, the simulation experiment is performed through Matrix Laboratory. Compared with the non restart scheme, the tracking trajectory of the proposed control scheme is improved.

articleTitle: A Novel Version of Sampling-based Motion Planner for Manipulation with Faster Initial Solution and Convergence
abstract: This paper presents, Anytime Fast-BIT* (AFBIT*), a sampling based, asymptotically optimal manipulation motion planner which quickly finds an initial feasible path and rapidly improves the path quality toward optimality. AFBIT* is guided by modified heuristics in task space for faster first solution. A local optimization method is adopted at the end of every round to optimize the current best path and generate the next vertex and edge for the global path while a new round begins to improve the quality of the remaining path. Simulation results suggest AFBIT* is more efficient and effective on manipulation problems than BIT* and Fast-BIT*.

articleTitle: Accurate Output Tracking Control for Nonminimum Phase Systems via An Iterative Redefinition-based Method with Aircraft Application
abstract: This paper provides an insight into the accurate output tracking control for non-minimum phase (NMP) systems. A novel iterative redefinition-based approach is proposed to overcome the inherent drawbacks of classic output-redefinition methods. Specifically, a feasible minimum phase (MP) output is first identified by the output redefinition. Then the desired output trajectory is iteratively redefined such that the state references for the new MP system could approximate those for the original NMP system within arbitrarily small errors. With the redefined reference signals, a controller in a "feedforward + feedback" configuration is employed to simultaneously achieve the accurate tracking of output trajectory and the stabilizing of internal dynamics. An application of this control framework to F-16 aircraft is presented, which is further verified by numerical simulations, showing significant performance improvement by the proposed output reference iterative redefinition algorithm.

articleTitle: A Self-healing Method of Distribution Network with Distributed Power Sources Based on Chaotic Adaptive Artificial Fish Swarm Algorithm
abstract: In view of the volatility and randomness of distributed power sources in the distribution network, a self-healing optimization method of distribution network based on chaotic adaptive artificial fish swarm algorithm is proposed in this paper. Based on the mathematical modeling and node division of wind power, photovoltaics and household energy storage, with the minimum active power loss of the system as the objective function, a self-healing distribution network structure optimization model of distribution network including distributed generation and household energy storage is established. The chaotic adaptive artificial fish swarm algorithm is used to realize the optimization of the self-healing distribution network structure of distribution network through adaptively and dynamically adjusting the step parameters. According to the output characteristics of the household energy storage system, the self-healing distribution network structure is divided into two typical work scenarios. The effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper is verified by a simulation example of an IEEE33 node test system with distributed generation. The simulation results show that the method proposed in this paper provides a theoretical basis for the development of intelligent active distribution network and self-healing test technology.

Author Keywords: chaotic adaptive artificial fish swarm algorithm

articleTitle: Prediction of head thickness of hot-rolled strip based on deep neural network
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low precision of hot-rolled strip head thickness, a prediction model based on deep neural network (DNN) was presented. Considering the root mean square error (RMSE), mean absolute error (MAE), mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) and Pearson correlation coefficient (R), the data of 2,005 coils collected from a hot rolling production line were used to establish the model. Hybrid particle swarm optimization and genetic algorithm (HPSO-GA) was used to optimize the prediction performance of DNN model. Parameters setting of DNN model and HPSO-GA, including learning rate, hidden neurons, selection of optimizer, population size and crossover probability were investigated to obtain the optimal model. Prediction performance comparisons of support vector regression (SVR), random forest (RF), DNN and HPSO-GA-DNN were presented. HPSO-GA-DNN had the smallest error and the highest R value, in which RMSE, MAE, MAPE and R value were 0.0197mm, 0.0151mm, 0.499% and 0.989, respectively. And 96.74% of the prediction data had an absolute error of less than 0.05 mm. The results showed that HPSO-GA-DNN had strong learning ability and good generalization performance, and could be well applied to hot rolling production.

articleTitle: Predefined-Time Robust Synchronization for Complex Networks with External Disturbance via Sliding Mode Control
abstract: This paper is concerned with the predefined-time synchronization problem for complex networks in the presence of parameter uncertainty and external disturbance, where the nonlinear function involved is general that satisfies the sector-bounded constraint instead of the usual Lipschitz condition adopted. Firstly, an integral sliding mode surface is constructed, by using the predefined-time stability criterion and the Kronecker product, sufficient conditions in the form of linear matrix inequalities are derived to guarantee the predefined-time stability of the synchronization error system during the sliding mode phase. Then, the sliding mode control law is explicitly designed such that the error system can be driven onto the specified sliding mode surface within the predefined-time. Finally, a numerical example is presented to illustrate feasibility of the obtained results.

articleTitle: Integrated Multi-Objective Optimization for Reheating Furnace Scheduling and Rolling Plan in Hot Rolling Process of Steel Industry
abstract: As one of the most important process, hot rolling that consists of several procedures exhibits as both a primary production period and an intensive energy-consuming consumer, of which the production efficiency and energy consumption is of great significance for the enterprises. Although existed methods have proposed some solutions, most of them are mainly based on single-objective optimization toward separate procedure rather than multi-objective alternative considering the practical connections between the consecutive stages. For this purpose, an integrated optimization method based on unified modeling and multi-stage evolutionary algorithm is proposed in this study. More specifically, a mathematical model for this Constrained Multi-Objective Problem (CMOP) is formulated at first, where the objectives and constraints for the scheduling of reheating furnace and rolling is ensemble considered. Furthermore, an improved Multi-Stage Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithm framework (MSMOEA) is proposed, which performs a sequential Pareto Front based optimization according to the flow of production procedures, so that a scheduling plan for both the reheating furnace and rolling is finally obtained. To evaluate the performance for both the modeling and optimization, the proposed unified model and MSMOEA framework are compared with single-objective model and commonly deployed optimization methods using real data from a steel plant in China, respectively. The results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method, which can be beneficial for efficiency increasement and energy costs reduction on site.

articleTitle: Lightweight High-precision Map for Specific Scenes
abstract: High precision map is important data foundation and supporting condition for autonomous driving. Currently the research and application of high-precision maps mainly focus on urban roads and highways, and cannot provide effective support for autonomous driving in specific scenes which has become the primary application scenes of autonomous driving. In order to meet the requirement of autonomous driving in specific scenes, a lightweight high-precision map generation method is proposed. Firstly, the lightweight element set are put forward according to the characteristics of autonomous vehicle’s task in specific scenes. Then a high-precision map generation method based on multi-sensor data fusion is presented. By the method, the point cloud data is collected, preprocessed and spliced to generate a high-precision base map. According to the road network structure and road geometric information of high-precision base map, combined with the vehicle driving route, the vector map for autonomous vehicle is generated. The experiment results show that the proposed method can satisfy the demand of autonomous driving in specific scenes, simplify high-precision map format, reduce redundancy of map data, and improve the development efficiency of autonomous driving system in specific scenes.

articleTitle: A data preprocessing method based on a relevance vector machine and a radial basis function network
abstract: The presence of outliers in the dataset and a too concentrated data distribution affects the performance of the data-driven model. In this paper, the relevance vector machine (RVM) and the radial basis function (RBF) network are used for data preprocessing. First, by gradually reducing the width of the kernel function, the RVM regression model gradually approaches the input sample to be tested, and the outlier is identified by the 3σ criterion; second, the attribute value of the abnormal probability is introduced to reduce the interference of the abnormal value upon determining the normal value; Finally, the RBF network is used to fill in the deleted outliers, and a certain number of virtual samples are generated in the small sample interval. The comparative experiment shows that this method can effectively improve data quality.

articleTitle: Research on Ant Colony Optimization of Oversampling Problem Based on Bootstrap and Maximum Entropy Principle
abstract: Classification of imbalanced data is an important research topic in machine learning. In unbalanced data, the minority class has significantly fewer training samples than the majority class, resulting in classification results favoring the majority class. Therefore, we propose a new algorithm for the classification of imbalanced data. The new algorithm is divided into the following three main parts. Firstly, by using the bootstrap method and the maximum entropy principle the new equilibrium data is obtained, which is compared with other oversampling algorithms. Secondly, the obtained equilibrium data are filtered by using the ant colony algorithm. The training set conducive to improving the classifier’s performance is selected. Finally, by using the filtered training set, the classifier is classified and compared with the previously proposed oversampling algorithm. By selecting eight sets of data from the UCI and KEEL databases for classification experiments, the experimental results show that the new algorithm proposed in this study outperforms existing algorithms in various evaluation metrics such as Auc, F<inf>1</inf> and Acc.

articleTitle: Instrumental variable-based parameter estimation for nonlinear systems with scarce measurements
abstract: This paper considers the identification problems of nonlinear systems with scarce measurements by using the instrumental variable technique. When the product of the instrumental matrix and the information matrix is a nonsingular matrix and the weak persistent excitation condition about the instrumental vector is true, the obtained parameter estimates can be unbiased consistent estimates. The key is how to choose the instrumental variables. Difficulty arises in that the system outputs are unavailable. By applying the negative gradient search, a recursive instrumental variable-based gradient algorithm is derived to estimate the parameters of the nonlinear systems with missing observed data. Moreover, the multi-innovation identification theory is introduced to further improve the parameter estimation accuracy. The simulation results illustrate that the proposed methods are effective.

articleTitle: An Improved Active Disturbance Rejection Control Method for Crane System
abstract: In order to improve the dynamic performance of the underdriven crane system, an improved linear active disturbance rejection controller (LADRC) based on the new error was proposed. The improved LADRC takes the error value between the disturbance and its observed value multiplied by a coefficient as the basis for adjusting the linear extended state observer (LESO). The improved method has two advantages. Firstly, the new error can prevent the traditional LESO from choosing larger parameter adjustment disturbances, which will limit the performance of the observer. Secondly, the pole can be configured by adjusting the coefficient to obtain better dynamic characteristics. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation and experiment. The proposed method can effectively restrain the swing of the payload and it is robust to system parameters perturbation as well.

articleTitle: A Novel Adaptive Maximum Correntropy Criterion Kalman Filter Based on Variational Bayesian
abstract: To better handle unknown constant or varying measurement and process noise covariance matrix, a novel variational Bayesian-based adaptive maximum correntropy criterion Kalman filter (VB-AMCCKF) is presented. Firstly, maximum correntropy criterion Kalman filter and variational Bayesian Kalman filter are combined to improve the accuracy of the algorithm. Next, a new kernel bandwidth is designed to adaptively adjust the correntropy gain of maximum correntropy criterion Kalman filter. Finally, a threshold is introduced to correct the predicted error covariance matrix. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed VB-AMCCKF has better robustness to resist the uncertainties of measurement and process noise than the existing filters.

articleTitle: Multi-cycle steel energy planning optimization based on improved NSGA-II algorithm
abstract: With a low energy efficiency, the iron and steel industry need a lot of materials and energy in the production process, which causes a lot of waste. In order to achieve sustainable steelmaking, a reasonable energy plan is made for the entire steel process to meet the needs of energy saving and consumption reduction. According to the characteristics of energy flow network in iron and steel industry, a mixed integer nonlinear programming (MINLP) model is established. Considering the time of use electricity price and the energy medium conversion balance, the objective functions are set up to minimize economic operation costs and net energy consumption. In addition, the improved non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm-II (NSGA-II) is designed to improve the quality of the solution. The case study shows that the energy plan optimization achieves the energy saving and reduction of economic costs of the enterprise.

articleTitle: Design of Android remote monitoring system for multi-channel fatigue test bench
abstract: As a comprehensive fatigue life testing equipment in the testing machine industry, the multi-channel fatigue test bench is mainly used for the durability test of various types of complete machines and components. Due to the long duration of the fatigue test and various unexpected conditions accompanying the test, the monitoring task of test is heavy. In view of this situation, this paper designs an Android-based IoT remote monitoring system with the multi-channel fatigue test bench as the monitoring object, and develops the client monitoring software RMCmp under the Android system. Adopting TCP protocol of Socket mechanism and using cloud server as communication relay, the mobile remote monitoring of fatigue test bench by Android client is realized. After the completion of the design, functional trials were conducted on the system, and the trials results showed that the system performed stably and well and achieved the expected results.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of multi-billionpixel imaging system
abstract: Aiming at the high cost and complex imaging system faced by current billion-pixel imaging systems, a low-cost and easy-to-use billion-pixel imaging system based on SIFT algorithm is proposed. The system first uses Zhang Zhengyou's camera calibration method to calculate the camera's internal and external parameters and distortion coefficients, and geometrically corrects the image; then uses the SIFT algorithm to match the same feature points of the same group of photos, and further uses image stitching to image the image based on the extracted feature points Carry out stitching, and finally apply the beam adjustment method to smoothly optimize the stitched image and eliminate the re-projection error; the imaging effect of hundreds of millions of pixels is realized.

articleTitle: The algorithm of coordinate calibration for multiple millimeter wave radars system
abstract: Localization and tracking of single millimeter wave radar usually make mistakes when outliers and virtual tracks are generated by multipath effect. Cooperation of multiple millimeter can effectively filter outliers and virtual tracks. However, each radar has its own coordinate system, they are different. The basis for cooperation of multiple radars is coordinate calibration. Thus, this paper proposed an algorithm to acquire the translation matrix and rotation angle which are used for coordinate calibration of multiple millimeter wave radars. Finally, numerical experiments validate that tracks generated by real target will coincide together after the optimal translation and rotation angle. On the contrary, if tracks are not generated by real target, they cannot coincide. This method can be used to filter tracks generated by multipath effect effectively.

articleTitle: Multi-USV Formation Reconfiguration Based on Guiding Vector Fields and Control Barrier Functions
abstract: This paper presents a formation reconfiguration controller design method for a fleet of unmanned surface vehicles (USVs) subject to static and dynamic obstacles. The controller design follows two steps. At the first step, based on a guiding vector field, a desired yaw angle is designed to avoid the static obstacles in the sea environment. At the second step, control barrier function is introduced to avoid collision between each USV with its neighbors and dynamic obstacles, and an optimal surge speed is obtained by solving a quadratic program (QP) problem. A hardware-in-loop simulation is given to substantiate the efficacy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Temperature Control and Energy Saving System for Communication Base Station Based on Fuzzy PID Algorithm
abstract: Reducing the energy cost of communication base stations is a crucial factor in wireless communication industries, and cut the power consumption of in-base air conditioners is a simple but efficient way to lower the cost of energy. There are several options focused on the energy conservation of air conditioners available, but most of them lack the suitability to various kinds of communication base stations in the field. In this paper, we introduced a temperature control system based on fuzzy Proportion Integral Differential(PID) control algorithm and loaded it on a microcontroller unit(MCU). The fuzzy PID control system automatically adjusts itself to a non-linear and time-invariant environment, reduced the excessive cooling of the air conditioner which results energy waste.The system ensured the basse station is meeting regulator’s standards. Software simulation and experimental data conducted in the communication base station shows that this system, combined with the ventilation system the base stations already have, can help them achieve a good energy efficiency effect by reducing the energy consumption by air conditioners.

articleTitle: Model Identification and Control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Control System
abstract: In this paper, a type of H<inf>∞</inf> control based on mixed sensitivity function for permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) is proposed. Firstly, the parameters and input position of excitation signal is determined based on the analysis of PMSM control system. Secondly, the order of PMSM control system model is identified using the Hankel matrix identification method. Finally, the H<inf>∞</inf> speed controller is designed according to the requirements of tracking and robustness. Compared with PID controller on the experimental platform, the designed H<inf>∞</inf> controller has shorter speed adjustment time, smaller overshoot response and stronger robustness.

articleTitle: Pharmacodynamic model of antiepileptic components of Cynanchum otophyllum with regression analysis and SVM method
abstract: In this paper, the pharmacodynamic (PD) model of antiepileptic components of Cynanchum otophyllum (Co) was investigated with pharmacokinetic (PK). We put forward two models, single-compartment model and multi-compartment model, to analyze the antiepileptic effects of components of Co. In the research strategy of single-compartment, PD model convoluted with general PK model to obtain the relationship between drug effect and concentration. For the accurate mathematical model could not be determined in multi-compartment, machine learning method was proposed. And then 128 Rats were subjected to the maximal electroshock (MES) experiment to induce seizures, and given Phenobarbital (PHB) or PHB combined with Co components. The data of drug concentration in plasma and anticonvulsant responses of rats were collected. Combined with logistic regression, the anticonvulsant effects of the two administrations were calculated. The monte carlo algorithm was used to evaluate the efficacy of the two administrations to obtain the PD model in single-compartment. Support vector machines (SVM) algorithm was used to predict the metabolite concentrations for the two administrations in multi-compartment. The general indexes of PK and PD, area under the curve (AUC), peak concentration (C<inf>max</inf>) and so on, were calculated and compared in single and multi-compartment respectively. The results showed components of Co had shown significant effects in inhibition of epilepsy.

articleTitle: Time-Varying Barrier Lyapunov Functions Based Adaptive Backstepping Control for Active Magnetic Bearings with State Constraints
abstract: In this manuscript, the rotor displacement control problem of active magnetic bearings system is considered and resolved. Especially, this paper considers the constraint of rotor displacement to avoid the damage and safety accidents of AMB systems due to excessive rotor displacement deviation. Time-varying barrier Lyapunov function is introduced and utilized to make the rotor displacement in a specific range. According to different operating characteristics and requirements at different times, the limitation of the rotor displacement also changes. Additionally, adaptive backstepping technique is presented to design the rotor displacement controller with time-varying state constraints, the stability analysis is provided as well. Finally, simulation examples have verified the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Robot Grasping Detection in Object Overlapping Scenes Based on Multi-Stage ROI Extraction
abstract: In multi-object stacking scenes, it is difficult for robots to detect and grasp objects. We propose a new robot grasp detection algorithm Multi-Stage ROI Grasp Detection(MSROI-GD). MSROI-GD uses multi-stage extracted ROI features to detect objects and grasp. Our algorithm can effectively filter and utilize ROI. Experimental results show that the improved MSROI-GD improves the accuracy of the original ROI-GD algorithm by 4.3%, and exceeds the current state-of-the-art algorithm by 0.5% in the overlapping scenes of objects in the VMRD dataset. At the same time, using our grasp detection algorithm on the Cornell grasp dataset still has good results. Robot experiments show that MSROI-GD can help robots grasp object in multi-object scenes with a success rate of 85%.

articleTitle: Hand Position Tracking based on Optimized Consistent Extended Kalman Filter
abstract: This paper proposes a hand position tracking algorithm based on optimized consistent extended Kalman filter (CEKF). By introducing the previous work of the authors and analyzing the parameter of the original CEKF algorithm, the key parameter that is negatively correlated with the degree of the estimation of uncertain dynamics is determined. Then, two metaheuristic methods, the Genetic Algorithm (GA) and the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) are used to optimize the original CEKF algorithm. To quantify the performance of the algorithms, the root-mean-square error (RMSE) is employed as the performance index. Finally, the numerical simulation and practical experiment of the hand position tracking are carried out, and the optimized algorithm achieves 9.52% and 10.94% improvements of the performance, respectively.

articleTitle: Robust H∞ Filtering for Nonlinear Systems With Sensor Saturation, Multiple Communication Delays and Packet Losses
abstract: In this paper, the robust H<inf>∞</inf> filtering problem is concerned for nonlinear systems with sensor saturation, multiple communication delays and packet losses. The phenomenon of communication delays satisfies the Bernoulli distributions and the packet losses occur in a random way. The sensor saturation in the system is handled by a decomposition approach. The purpose of this work is to design a full-order filter such that in the presence of above conditions, the filtering error system is exponentially mean-square stable, and the H<inf>∞</inf> performance index is achieved. By means of linear matrix inequalities, the explicit expression of the desired filters is also derived. Finally, a numerical example is provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Reduced Attitude Control Method for Satellites with Pointing Constraints and Disturbance
abstract: In this paper, the attitude control problem of satellites with dynamic pointing constraints, angular velocity constraints and disturbance is studied. Firstly, the attitude kinematics and dynamic pointing constraints are based on the reduced attitude description. Since the reduced attitude contains only two degrees of freedom, singularity and redundancy description are avoided. The artificial potential function is introduced to ensure that the satellite attitude meets the requirement of dynamic pointing constraints. At the same time, the barrier Lyapunov function is introduced to ensure that the angular velocity constraints are not violated during the maneuver process. The disturbance observer is used to estimate the disturbance torque, which enhances the system’s ability to suppress the external disturbance. Stability analysis shows that the proposed control law ensures the asymptotic convergence of the system. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed control method is verified by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: An optimized internal heating strategy based on bidirectional pulsed current for lithium-ion battery at low temperature
abstract: The low-temperature characteristics of lithium-ion batteries limit the performance of electric vehicles in cold weather, and the internal heating of lithium-ion batteries is a promising method. Unlike the existing constant-amplitude AC heating method, this paper proposes an optimized two-way pulse battery internal heating method based on a genetic algorithm. First, perform an EIS test on the battery based on the Thevenin model, and use Zview software to fit the test results to obtain impedance spectra at different temperatures and frequencies. Based on the Bernardi formula, describe the heat generated during the heating process of the battery. Then the thermos-electric coupling model of the battery is established to reflect the electric heating characteristics of the battery heating process. Through the analysis of the thermoelectric coupling model, the factors affecting the heating of the battery during the self-heating process are obtained. The heating current is limited according to the battery voltage's upper and lower safety thresholds. The genetic algorithm optimization process takes the current frequency as the solution set and the heat generation as the target. The method can achieve the maximum heat generation rate during the heating process at -20°C to 10°C and reduce battery loss, which greatly increases the battery's cycle life.

articleTitle: Decentralized Annular Domain Finite-Time Platoon Control of Linear Heterogeneous Vehicles
abstract: This paper investigates a decentralized control issue of heterogeneous vehicular systems. The platoon model is regarded as an interconnected system instead of overlapping form, which makes the controller design simpler. Furthermore, the decentralized feedback control laws are designed to guarantee the system is annular domain finite-time stable (ADFTS). Further, a sufficient condition is proposed to achieve ADFTS. In the following, the corresponding stability conditions are given based on linear matrix inequality (LMI). Finally, simulation experiments are given to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research of an Algorithm Combining Vision with Robotic Arm Grabbing
abstract: To solve the problem that the traditional robot arm usually moves according to a fixed process and cannot perceive external information, this system combines the robot arm with the vision to improve the intelligence of the service robot. This article uses Zhang’s calibration method to clarify the internal parameters of the D435 camera, and determine the hand-eye calibration method and external parameters to achieve coordinate transformation. The LINEMOD algorithm is used to combine color information and depth information for template matching to achieve target positioning. According to the D-H parameter method, determine the mechanical arm structure parameters and analyze its forward and inverse kinematics. Based on the RTT algorithm, a two-way exploration tree method, namely the RTT-connect algorithm, is used to improve efficiency and perform motion planning. Finally, the design of the robotic arm system and the use of CAN bus technology to simplify the wiring of the steering gear, the verification of the gripping effect of the robotic arm in the simulation platform and the real environment, and the completion of the vision-based robotic arm to the target through the test of each part for object grasping, the measured grasping success rate is 82.5%. The reliability of the grasping system is verified through experimental analysis and it is found that the grasping effect of the robotic arm is relatively good.

articleTitle: Image Servo Control using a Two-Dimensional Deflection Mirror for Sun Tracking
abstract: To evaluate the influence about the climate change and environmental pollution induced by the greenhouse gases, a Fourier Transform Infrared Spectrometer(FTIRS) instrument is used to detect the composition of the atmosphere. To track the position of the sun and reflect the sun lights into FTIRS as the background light, an image servo control system is designed to track the sun and keep the sun image in the center of the focal plane, the servo system is composed of a CMOS detector, a two-axis deflection mirror and a control unit. The detector provides the image bias on the focal plane, and the deflection mirror(DM) is driven by the voice-coil-motors(VCMs) for each axis with angular feedback measured by high resolution resolver. Due to the nonlinearity induced by the optics model of the two-axis deflection mirror, the whole control system is divided into two parts, one is the inner loop for angular position control, and another is the outer loop for image servo. Finally, the simulation and experiment results are presented to illustrate the effectiveness and performance of the proposed servo control system.

articleTitle: Boundary Stabilization of the Time Fractional Korteweg-de Vries-Burgers Equation
abstract: In this paper, we consider boundary stabilization for the time fractional Korteweg-de Vries-Burgers equation under a sector feedback control. Under the nonlinear controller satisfying a sector condition, the Mittag-Leffler stability of the closed-loop system is established by the fractional Lyapunov method.

articleTitle: ℓ0 NHT V : A Non-convex Hybrid Total Variation Regularization Method for Image Restoration
abstract: Image restoration is a serious inverse problem, and the regularization method is recognized as an effective method. In this paper, a ℓ<inf>0</inf> non-convex hybrid total variation(NHTV) regularization method is proposed, and the TV-based restoration problem is solved by using ℓ<inf>0</inf> norm data fidelity. In order to effectively tackle the proposed non-convex and non-smooth optimization problem, we first express this problem as a Mathematical Program with Equilibrium Constraints(MPEC), and then a proximal Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers(PADMM) is adopted to solve this problem. Numerical simulations verify the effectiveness of our proposed method. The comparations with other convex TV-based regularization methods are also conducted, which clearly show that this method can achieve better suppression of the staircase effect, effectively preserve the edge information and therefore obtain a higher signal-to-noise ratio.

articleTitle: A navigation path and high-definition map matching scheme based on improved hidden Markov model
abstract: In order to realize the autopilot function with the navigation path, it is necessary to match the navigation path output from the navigation module with the road (road center line) of the high-definition map. Generally speaking, the absolute position accuracy of the high-definition map is at the centimeter level, and the absolute position accuracy of the navigation map is at the meter level, while the navigation path is generated on the navigation map, so the navigation path and the road of the high-definition map cannot be matched directly by the position information. In this paper, we propose a scheme for matching navigation paths and high-definition maps based on an improved Hidden Markov Model. Combining the global longitude and latitude positions of navigation path points and the attribute information on the path for initial matching, the navigation path is matched with the center line of the road of the high- definition map. And during the vehicle navigation, the initial matching results are checked using the navigation events within two kilometers ahead sent by the navigation, and the matching errors and missed matching roads are corrected to further improve the matching effect. Finally, this paper proves the effectiveness of this scheme by analyzing the typical evaluation results of initial matching.

articleTitle: Research on the Model of Photovoltaic Array Output Electrical Characteristics Based on the Multi-inclination Condition
abstract: The traditional model was proposed under uniform lighting conditions on PV arrays. However, for PV arrays along the surface of BIPV buildings, with multiple included angle between the solar panels and incident light, the traditional model appeared to have inevitable limitation. Irradiance is considered to be the main factor in modeling the output electrical characteristics of PV arrays. Conventional models are presented for uniform illumination conditions of PV arrays. However, for PV arrays along BIPV building surfaces with multiple included angles between solar panels and incident light, the conventional model seems to have unavoidable limitations. Therefore, in this paper, we simulate PV modules connected in series with different irradiance and model the characteristics of series PV arrays under complex lighting conditions, and compare the power generation of PV modules under optimal illumination conditions with complex lighting conditions using Jinan, China as the target region The result indicated that, under complex lighting conditions, the power generated by PV arrays has dropped significantly, so that the traditional MPPT algorithm is no longer applicable to the maximum power point tracking, which provides a theoretical analysis basis for subsequent MPPT algorithm upgrade and PV array design.

articleTitle: Observer-Based Robust Fault Diagnosis Scheme for Actuators in Flexible Joint Robot Manipulators
abstract: With the increasing requirements for the reliability of the manipulator, an observer-based robust fault diagnosis scheme is proposed to diagnose actuators in flexible joint robot manipulators. Specifically, the original system is decoupled into two reduced-order subsystems using linear non-singular transformation method. Then, a robust fault diagnosis scheme based on sliding mode observer is designed to detect and further estimate actuator faults in nonlinear systems. Finally, the effectiveness of the fault diagnosis scheme is demonstrated via a simulation of the single-link flexible joint manipulator and application prospects of the scheme are also provided.

articleTitle: An improved MUSIC damage diagnose algorithm with transmitter beamforming for composite structures
abstract: Guided waves attenuate seriously on some structures, such as carbon fiber composite structures. Specially, the low signal to noise radio (SNR) of guided waves, resulting from high attenuation, limits the accuracy of guided waves based methods. Among them, sensor array based imaging methods have been gradually studied to synthetic guided waves from different excitation-sensing paths, which could improve the SNR of guided waves to some degree. However, these methods usually synthetic guided waves on only the excitation or sensing side, which are still not enough for high attenuation structures. To solve this problem, an improved MUSIC damage localization method with transmitter beamforming is proposed in this paper. Transmitter beamforming is carried out to make the excitation guided waves focused on special positions and MUSIC algorithm is used to synthetic the received guided waves, scattered from damage, to further improve the damage imaging accuracy. At last, an experiment on the carbon fiber composite plate is carried out to verify this proposed method. Experimental results show that the proposed method can realize accurate damage imaging with the angle errors less than 2° and the distance errors less than 30mm.

articleTitle: A Fault Diagnosis Method Based on GWO-DELM for Aeroengine Gas Path
abstract: Aiming at the problem of complex working mechanism of aeroengine gas path system and difficulty in effective fault diagnosis in actual work, a new fault diagnosis method of aeroengine gas path based on Gray Wolf Optimization Deep Extreme Learning Machine (GWO-DELM) is proposed. Firstly, analyze a large amount of monitoring data of a certain type of aeroengine gas path components, and sort out the health data and fault sample data sets. Secondly, create the DELM fault diagnosis model by the health data and fault sample data set of the aeroengine gas circuit system. To reduce the influence of artificially setting network parameters on the diagnosis results, the Gray Wolf Optimization algorithm (GWO) is used to optimize the DELM network parameters, and the optimal DELM fault diagnosis model GWO-DELM is created. Finally, the GWO-DELM fault diagnosis model is used to study the fault diagnosis verification technology of the aeroengine air circuit system, and the diagnosis results of the ELM, DELM and Multilayer Kernel Extreme Learning Machine (ML-KELM) fault diagnosis models are compared. The result shows that the fault diagnosis accuracy of the proposed GWO-DELM fault diagnosis model is 96.0%, which is significantly higher than that of the ELM model of 88.0%, the DELM model of 92.0% and the ML-KELM model of 94.0%, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified, and it has a good application prospect.

articleTitle: Exponential p-stability of stochastic impulsive fuzzy reaction-diffusion Cohen-Grossberg neural networks with mixed delays
abstract: In this paper, the pth moment exponential stability of a class of stochastic impulsive fuzzy reaction-diffusion Cohen-Grossberg neural networks (CGNNs) with mixed delays is studied. By means of the property of "M-cone", Lyapunov functional, Itô formula and Hanalay inequality techniques, sufficient conditions for exponential p-stability of our model are obtained. Finally, a simulation example is given to verify the validity of our result.

articleTitle: Modeling and Control of Irrational Fractional-Order System and Its Block Diagram Simulation
abstract: The use of fractional-order to describe an actual system can better reveal its essential characteristics and its behavior. The description and analysis of an irrational fractional-order system are more complicated than that of a rational fractional-order system. To solve this difficulty, this paper studies its system identification and controller design for the characteristics of such systems. Firstly, based on the frequency domain response data of these systems, combined with the optimization algorithm to realize the rationalization of them, the curves fitting are used to illustrate the correctness and effectiveness of the identification algorithm. Then, based on the identified rational models, the optimum controllers are designed. Step response comparison shows that the performance of fractional-order controllers is superior to that of traditional integer-order controllers. Finally, through the block diagram implementation, the effectiveness and correctness of the fractional-order controller design are explained.

articleTitle: Subjective weight determination method of evaluation index based on intuitionistic fuzzy set theory
abstract: The evaluation index weight is the key factor to determine the reasonable evaluation result. In order to effectively overcome the ambiguity and uncertainty of the analytic hierarchy process in the index importance scoring comparison, this paper combines the intuitionistic fuzzy set and the analytic hierarchy process to propose a new subjective weight determination method. This method uses the characteristics that intuitionistic fuzzy set can express the three states of support, opposition and hesitation at the same time, fully reflects the fuzziness and uncertainty of human judgment in the scoring comparison process, and can determine the evaluation index weight more reasonably and accurately. The feasibility and effectiveness of the method are verified by a simulation case.

articleTitle: An Early Fault Detection Method of the Induced Draft Fan Based on Long-Short Term Memory Network and Double Warning Thresholds
abstract: The induced draft (ID) fan is a significant piece of auxiliary equipment in thermal power plants. An early detection of possible faults in the ID fan may be used for effective predictive maintenance, thereby reducing the overall maintenance cost and improving the reliability and availability of thermal power plants. This paper proposed a genetic algorithm and long-short term memory network (GA-LSTM)-based condition monitoring approach using normal operation data of the ID fan. Furthermore, the LSTM network and the sliding window technique were introduced to construct double thresholds, which contains a dynamic threshold and a static threshold. The GA-LSTM-double thresholds method was applied to a coal-fired power plant to achieve early fault detection and diagnosis. The results demonstrates that the proposed method is capable of detecting minor anomalies in advance.

articleTitle: The Research on Incentive Strategies in Green and Low Carbon Supply Chains
abstract: In green and low carbon supply chains, howto choose the incentive strategies is an important question. Based on this, by building a game model in the supply chain consisting of an upstream green and low carbon product supplier and a downstream dominated retailer, we investigate the incentive strategies based on the low carbon technology investment cost-sharing contract and the green quality investment cost-sharing contract. The equilibrium results show that, (1) No matter what incentive strategies the retailer chooses, the proportions of the low carbon technology investment cost the retailer shares with the supplier are exogenous and remain unchanged, in addition, the proportion of the green quality investment cost-sharing the retailer decides is still exogenous; (2) The retailer and the consumer prefer more the incentive strategy that the retailer shares both the low carbon technology investment cost and the green quality investment cost with the supplier, but both the supplier and the total supply chain system will not benefit from this incentive strategy and in contrast suffer a profit loss.

articleTitle: Variable Order Fractional Gradient Descent Method and Its Application in Neural Networks Optimization
abstract: In this paper, a novel variable order fractional gradient descent optimization algorithm is proposed, which generalizes the classical gradient descent method by introducing a kind of variable order fractional derivative. The derivative order is adjusted with the number of iterations. The convergence of the algorithm is analyzed. And the proposed method is also applied to the training of the full connected back propagation neural networks. Finally, numerical experiments are carried out to illustrate the effectiveness and practicability of proposed method. Results show that the proposed method has a faster learning rate and higher accuracy both in the training and validation sets.

articleTitle: A Method of Geographic Vector Data Collection Based on Web Map
abstract: Web map can provide huge amounts of present spatial data promptly, and users can embed the web map into web applications through APIs easily. However, current mainstream web maps as Google Maps, Gaode Maps, Baidu Maps, etc, are incompatible of spatial data service publish standard that are published by most GIS desktop systems, so they cannot be integrated by GIS desktop systems directly. This paper raised a web map integration mode based on web embed, which integrated web map into GIS desktop systems as reference map layer. By means of the development of vector data acquisition tool, we added geographic information data that collected by web maps into vector data layers of GIS desktop system and conduct a study of the interaction between web map and GIS system. Because most web maps encrypted their position coordinates, so the data collected by web maps has accuracy errors. This paper rectified the coordinate errors through position rectification method, and improved the accuracy of collected vector data position. Finally, based on the geographic information vector data collection system, we implemented the vector data collection tool based on web map, and collected the settlement place data of Nai Dong county in Shan Nan area by the tool, which verified the view and method raised in this paper.

articleTitle: AKAZE Feature-Based Map Merging for Multi-Robot SLAM with Unknown Initial Pose
abstract: Map merging is an important issue of multi-robot SLAM system, especially in the case of unknown initial pose. This paper presents an efficient algorithm that enables teams of robots to build occupancy grid maps without initial pose. The relative pose transformation between pairs of robots are estimated by the AKAZE features of the overlapping area, which are descripted by Modified Local Difference Binary (MLDB) descriptor. The proposed algorithm reduces the computational complexity and improves the robustness of the search process. The experimental results obtained from two robots under the simulation environment and real environment validated the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Operation Performance Evaluation of Circulating Cooling Water System in Metallurgical Industry
abstract: In the metallurgical industry, the circulating cooling water system is an important auxiliary system for the main process production, and it is also a high-energy-consuming subsystem. It is of great significance to study the operation optimization of this system. To this end, this paper constructs a comprehensive evaluation model for the operating performance of the circulating cooling water system, which lays the foundation for the optimization of the system. Based on the idea of maximizing the sum of squared deviations, the weights of each indicator obtained by the AHP method and the CRITIC method are combined to obtain the final impact weight. Based on the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, all aspects of the system's operating performance are comprehensively considered to achieve a comprehensive evaluation of the system's operating performance. Finally, the model is applied to the operation optimization process of the actual system to verify the rationality and effectiveness of the evaluation model.

articleTitle: Control Strategy Design of PV Grid-Connected System Based on Equivalent Input Disturbance
Global Practical Tracking via Adaptive Output-Feedback for A Class of Uncertain Nonlinear Systems With Polynomial Output Depending Growth Rate
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of global practical tracking by adaptive output-feedback for a class of uncertain nonlinear systems. Unlike closely related works, the systems have unmeasured states of growth with a growth rate polynomial of output-input multiplying an unknown constant. Mainly because of the presence of unknown polynomial function of the input, this kind of tracking problem is very different from the previous research. Inspired by the related stabilization problem, an observer is constructed by introducing two novel dynamic gains, and an adaptive output-feedback controller is designed to make all the states of the closed-loop system globally bounded, as well as the tracking error will be prescribed arbitrarily small after a finite time. A numerical example is provided to illustrate the effectiveness of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: A new diffusion sparse equal-scale adaptive RLS algorithm
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new diffusion sparse equal-scale adaptive RLS algorithm for distributed learning problem in the diffusion network. This algorithm makes two improvements to the traditional diffusion RLS algorithm. One is adding a sparse perception factor to the cost function of the RLS algorithm, which makes it perform better when identifying sparse systems. The second, we use an adaptive coefficient in the iterative equation, this improvement can speed the convergence rate of the algorithm. Meanwhile, the theoretical analysis shows the proposed algorithm has the first-order and second-order convergence rate. A simulation is given and it shows that the algorithm is better than the compared existing algorithms in terms of convergence rate and steady-state super mean square error.

articleTitle: Considering Two Factors in Low-carbon supply chain Pricing Decisions: Sense of Fairness and Green Effort Behavior
abstract: As global warming, ecological environment imbalance and other adverse problems continue to ferment, people begin to realize the importance of environmental protection. The promulgation of low carbon policy enterprises try to improve the environmental performance of products, and Consumers increasingly favor low-carbon and environmentally friendly products. Environmental sustainability, product greening, and other issues have attracted extensive attention from low-carbon supply chain management researchers. However, enterprises pay particular attention to the fairness of profit distribution in the supply chain. When profits are not matched with efforts, enterprises can generate psychological tendencies towards unfairness. At present, it has been confirmed that green effort behavior and sense of fairness play key roles in promoting the sustainability of low-carbon products. A Stackelberg game decision model of two level low-carbon supply chain is constructed which consists of a retailer as a leader and a manufacturer as a follower. The impacts of sense of fairness and green effort behavior on the optimal decision in the low-carbon supply chain are comparatively analyzed.

articleTitle: A Composite Disturbance Observer Design for High-Order Nonlinear System
abstract: This paper investigates the problem with regard to disturbance estimation for the high-order nonlinear systems subject to time-varying bounded matched and mismatched disturbances. To estimate the unknown disturbances, a composite disturbance observer (CDO) focusing on employing a series of auxiliary variables is designed. It is proved with the Lyapunov analysis that the rigorously exponential stability of the observer error can be ensured by CDO. By means of two simulation examples, the proposed observer achieving satisfactory performance in disturbance estimation for the high-order nonlinear systems is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Design Of PID Parameter Self-tuning Thermostat Temperature Controller Based On Step Sesponse
abstract: The industrial large-scale production of high precision thermostat requires manual setting of complex parameters of temperature control system, which consumes a lot of labor costs and is low in efficiency. A PID parameter self-tuning thermostat temperature control algorithm based on step response identification is designed.According to the dynamic characteristic parameters of the step response curve of the prototype and the PID parameters, the linear regression analysis was carried out to obtain the parameter self-tuning model, and the auxiliary compensation rule table was used to control the power.Experiments on a real computer show that the algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Research on Data Construction and Classification of Deformable Objects Grasped by Soft Hand with Multi-source Information Fusion
abstract: The grasping of deformable objects poses a challenge to traditional rigid robots. Meanwhile, soft robots have advantages in robust grasping due to their inherent compliance. Data-driven methods have attracted the attention of many researchers, but the number of tactile time series datasets for soft robots is currently scarce. This paper utilizes a gripper containing three soft fingers controlled by 6 motors to grasp 8 deformable objects with different shapes, textures and softness. The tactile sensor array embedded in each finger can change the output voltage according to the deformation of the object and the finger which provide 8-channel tactile information, and finally obtain 24-channel tactile data of three fingers. At the same time, the position and torque data of the motors are collected. Finally, a soft-hand grasping deformable object dataset TAM (Tactile and Motor) is constituted. TAM has 37 channels in total, including time stamp, 24 haptic data channels and 12 motor data channels. The classification results of deep learning algorithms and other classic machine learning algorithms are compared on this dataset. Different sources of data are segmented and discussed to study the impact of haptic data and motor data on classification accuracy. Finally, we also put forward a vision for future work. The dataset will be open on a public platform for researchers to facilitate subsequent tasks such as object recognition of soft robots.

articleTitle: Transportation robot based on multi-sensor fusion and machine vision
abstract: In recent years, the explosion of IoT technology, especially with the development of 5G, edge computing and other technologies, has enabled the application of artificial intelligence technology at the edge, which can be used in more and more industrial use scenarios. The algorithm of vision sensing based on target detection, tracking and ranging has the advantages of accuracy, efficiency and intelligence, which will greatly improve the intelligent sensing capability of mobile robots when applied to mobile robots, and further improve the robot's adaptability to the environment by realizing real-time map building and navigation based on LiDAR. In this paper, we have studied the transport mobile robot and built a ROS-based target following and navigation system. The visual perception and simple following tasks of this transportation robot for surrounding pedestrian targets and unmanned transportation tasks for materials are completed.

articleTitle: Terminal sliding mode guidance design under impact angle and time constraints in three-dimensional space
abstract: Aiming at the problem of interceptor intercepting target under impact angle and time constraints, the nonsingular terminal sliding mode method is used to design the guidance law. This paper considers the moving target with constant acceleration in 3-D space. The design of guidance law is mainly divided into two parts. Firstly, the sliding mode guidance law satisfying the impact angle constraint is designed, and then the sliding mode guidance law satisfying the impact time constraint is designed. For the designed sliding surface, two Lyapunov functions are analyzed and the stability conditions are obtained. Different from the previous guidance laws, the guidance law designed in this paper does not need to switch under the constraints of impact angle and impact time. Finally, the simulation results show that the guidance law proposed in this paper has good performance under the conditions of impact angle and time constraints.

articleTitle: Quadratic ℒ2 Performance of Switched Linear Uncertain Stochastic Systems
abstract: We study global quadratic ℒ<inf>2</inf> performance in probability (quadratic stability and ℒ<inf>2</inf> gain γ in probability: abbreviated as GQℒ<inf>2</inf>(γ)-P) for switched systems which are composed of a finite set of linear stochastic subsystems with norm bounded uncertainties. Assuming that no single subsystem achieves GQ ℒ<inf>2</inf>(γ)-P, we show that if a convex combination of subsystems achieves GQℒ<inf>2</inf>(γ)-P, then we can design a state-dependent switching law, based on the convex combination of subsystems, such that the entire switched system achieves GQℒ<inf>2</inf>(γ)-P. A numerical example is provided to show effectiveness of the proposed approach.

Author Keywords: global quadratic ℒ2 performance γ in probability (GQℒ2(γ)-P)

articleTitle: Core Temperature Estimation Method of Lithium-ion Battery Based on An Improved Recurrent Neural Network Algorithm
abstract: Estimating the core temperature of the battery is not only an important task of the battery management system, but also a key means to ensure the safety and reliability of the battery for other important purposes. The core temperature of the battery cannot be observed directly, but it has a certain correlation with other battery measurable parameters (current, voltage, ambient temperature, surface temperature). Therefore, this paper proposes an iteration method based on an improved recurrent neural network algorithm (RNN) whose name is simple recurrent units (SRU) to calculate this correlation, and then estimates the core temperature of the battery under high dynamic driving condition. The experimental results show that this method can accurately estimate the temperature of lithium-ion battery cell of electric vehicle under wide ambient temperature, and mean square error is than 0.604566.

articleTitle: Convergence Analysis of Interval Feedforward Neural Networks
abstract: In practical application of neural networks, we often try to change some factors to make the algorithm perform better, but the convergence analysis of the algorithm cannot keep up with it in time. This paper studies the convergence of interval feedforward neural network (IFNN). First the convergence of the IFNN is derived theoretically based on gradient descent algorithm, where the IFNN possesses the interval input and output but the point weights; Then, by means of numerical analysis, the relationship between the convergence of general IFNN and interval weights is discussed. In the numerical analysis, the coverage of interval output is taken as the objective function, and the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is used for optimizing to ensure the interval network output approaching the interval width range of the weight and threshold of the point output. Studying the convergence of interval neural networks (INNs) can effectively promote the application range of INNs, making INNs better used in uncertain systems, reducing the impact of fluctuations, noise and measurement errors, and improving the objectivity and robustness of industrial process modeling.

articleTitle: Conservativeness Reduction for Tube-based Robust Model Predictive Control
abstract: In this work, a less conservative robust model predictive control (RMPC) algorithm for linear systems with additive disturbance is proposed based on the tube technique. The key idea is that the tube cross sections are minimized in the RMPC objective, which make the description of the additive disturbance less conservative. A case study and several numerical experiments are provided to show the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Distributed Event-triggered Secondary Coordinated Control of Microgrid Based on Disturbance Observer
abstract: Distributed secondary control strategy of microgrid has high reliability and is easy to realize "plug and play", but its structure is complex, and it is easy to be affected by power supply, load and environment. At present, many scholars introduce multi-agent consistency control method into the secondary control of isolated island microgrid. Through the information interaction between adjacent distributed generators, the voltage and frequency can be accurately tracked and the power can be reasonably distributed. However, there is no microgrid central control (MGCC) in the secondary control, the global information of the system cannot be obtained, and the anti-interference performance of the system is poor. In this paper, a disturbance observer is designed for the matching disturbance in the secondary control of microgrid, such as harmonic disturbance and disturbance caused by the change of system parameters. The observed values are used to compensate the interference of the system. At the same time, in order to improve the computing speed and save communication resources, the event-triggered mechanism is introduced. Finally, the microgrid model is built in MATLAB/ SIMULINK and the method is verified.

articleTitle: Trajectory Tracking of Underactuated VTOL Vehicles Using Double Filtered Signals
abstract: A state feedback control strategy for underactuated vertical take-off and landing vehicles is proposed to track the desired position and attitude trajectory. To achieve exponential convergence in all state variables of 6 degrees-of-freedom nonlinear dynamical model, double filtered signals (DFS) for translational and rotational dynamics are introduced, then the thrust force controller and torque controller are designed respectively. DFS based control design takes the advantage of reducing the requirement of the desired trajectory and it is strictly proved that all signals of the original system are bounded and the tracking errors can be made arbitrarily small by tuning controller gains. The effectiveness of the obtained results is demonstrated by means of simulations.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of automatic test system for multi-cabin joint test of space station
abstract: In order to solve the problems of information interaction, instruction transmission and joint interpretation in the multi-cabin configuration of space station, an automatic test system supporting multi-cabin joint test is designed. The general design of automatic test system is given. To standardize the interface and protocol for information transmission in each cabin. Design multi-dimensional interpretation platform to realize multi-cabin data comparison and interpretation. Developing comprehensive analysis platform to realize multi-cabin information association analysis. The application results show that the multi-cabin joint test of the space station is realized automatically and intelligently through the test case design, test program execution, data interpretation, test result analysis and report generation. It supports the ground test and verification work under various configurations of the space station, and has high engineering application value.

articleTitle: Rolling bearing fault diagnosis based on the combination of improved deep convolution network and gated recurrent unit
abstract: Aiming at the problems of traditional fault diagnosis relying on expert experience, poor generalization ability and complex model training parameters, a new intelligent fault diagnosis model that combines an Improved Deep Convolution Neural Network (IDCNN) and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) is proposed. In the process of model building, the original data is expanded by overlapping sampling method to balance the number of different fault signals. Use IDCNN to directly extract features of bearing vibration signals and introduce GRU to mine the timing information hidden in the original signals. At the same time, Global Average Pooling (GAP) is used to replace the fully connected layer to reduce model parameters. Finally, the fault classification is performed through the Softmax layer. The fault recognition accuracy under different working conditions and different SNRs are compared with other three machine learning methods including MLP, FCN and LSTM. The experimental results shows that the proposed method outperforms other three existing methods. Confusion matrix and T-SNE features are also visualized to show the effectiveness ofthe proposed method.

articleTitle: Consensus-based Frequency Control of a Cyber-physical Power System under Two Types of DDoS Attacks
abstract: The consensus-based frequency control relying on a communication system is used to restore the frequency deviations introduced by the primary droop control in an islanded AC microgrid, a typical cyber-physical power system(CPPS). This paper firstly studies the performance of the CPPS under two types of Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS ) attacks, finds that the intelligent attacks may cause more damage than the brute force attacks, and analyzes some potential defense strategies of the CPPS from two points of view. Some simulation results are also given to show the performance of both the physical and cyber system of the CPPS under different operation conditions.

articleTitle: Blast Furnace Ironmaking Process Fault Detection Using Canonical Variate Analysis and Support Vector Data Description
abstract: Anomalies detection plays a vital role in ensuring the stability and smoothness of the blast furnace ironmaking process. Due to its complexity, data-driven fault detection has become a hot topic for the blast furnace ironmaking process. To monitor the process of the blast furnace, this paper proposes a fault detection method based on Canonical Variate Analysis and Support Vector Data Description (CVA-SVDD). CVA is a state space-based monitoring tool that is effective in dealing with process dynamics. SVDD is a data domain description method, also known as a one-classification method, which can be used for outlier detection and has the advantage of solving the problem of describing nonlinear and non-Gaussian distributed data. Specifically, a CVA model is first constructed for the process variables to generate a series of feature vectors, and then the features are further monitored using SVDD, which is used to fit the data into a hypersphere so that its radius can be used as a health indicator in fault detection. A real blast furnace ironmaking process is employed to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A surrogate-assisted multi-objective optimization method for preliminary design of horizontal tail control system
abstract: The decision of a multi-disciplinary preliminary design scheme based on engineering experience requires multi-departmental designers to spend a long time for calculation, verification, discussion, and consensus-building. This article proposes a surrogate-assisted multi-objective optimization method for efficient horizontal tail control system preliminary design. A multi-objective optimization model for horizontal tail control system is established, and the surrogate-assisted methods and BP neural networks are used to construct the implicit objective function. The recommended preliminary design scheme is derived from the Pareto solution set of the optimization model. And a collaborative optimal solution evaluation principle is proposed to select the scheme concisely. A horizontal tail control simulation model is built to examine the performance of the preliminary design scheme. The results show that the recommended scheme has an excellent performance in terms of the design goals.

articleTitle: A Prediction Method for CO Utilization Rate Based on KPCA Contribution Plots and ELM Algorithm
abstract: CO utilization rate is an important indicator reflecting the operating state and energy consumption of blast furnace (BF). To this end, a CO utilization rate prediction method based on KPCA and ELM is proposed. Due to the non-linear characteristics of blast furnace data, the KPCA contribution map method is used to filter 49 input variables, and 37 variables with large contributions such as hot air pressure are obtained as input variables, which solves the variable redundancy problem that the ELM algorithm cannot solve. Then, the ELM method was used to establish a prediction model for the utilization rate of CO in a blast furnace. According to the actual data on site, the mean square error and coefficient of determination are used to evaluate the validity of the prediction results of the ELM model and the ELM model. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper has stronger model generalization ability, and can more accurately predict the blast furnace CO utilization rate, and provide timely and effective decision support for subsequent blast furnace operation optimization and energy saving and emission reduction.

articleTitle: Attitude Control of Quadrotor UAV Based on Adaptive Sliding Mode Control
abstract: As a typical non-linear and under-actuated system for a quadrotor, it is difficult to achieve flight control that meets performance in various natural scenarios. Therefore, this paper focuses on the adaptive sliding mode control algorithm of the quad-rotor aircraft. The main research results are as follows: a complete nonlinear mathematical model including internal parameter perturbation and external disturbance is established, then an adaptive sliding modebased aircraft control algorithm is designed, and which stability is proved by Lyapunov function. The MATLAB numerical simulation compares and verifies the adaptive sliding mode control algorithm, sliding mode control algorithm and PID control algorithm in two scenarios of tracking fixed point and trajectory tracking. Finally, it is concluded from experiments that the speed and robustness of the adaptive sliding mode control algorithm is far better than that of the PID control algorithm.

articleTitle: Simulation experiment of CCM-SLAM based on ROS
abstract: With multi-robot collaborative SLAM has gradually become the current development trend of SLAM, some multi-robot collaborative SLAM algorithms have been proposed one after another. However, it is expensive and time-consuming to deploy and debug a multi-robot collaborative SLAM algorithm in a real environment. Based on ROS, Gazebo and PX4 platforms, build a multi-robot collaborative SLAM simulation platform. Since ROS and PX4 were originally designed for embedded systems, the collaborative SLAM algorithm debugged in a simulation environment can be directly deployed on real robots.
