The proposed method is compared with three algorithms, and the experiment results have demonstrated that ADER-DMOEA is competitive in dealing with dynamic environments.

articleTitle: Last-Mile Delivery Route Planning for Unmanned Vehicles Based on Improved Sparrow Search Algorithm
abstract: For the route planning of unmanned distribution in the last kilometer of the city, the matching between distribution and customer time is considered. Based on CVRP and constrained by narrow and soft time windows, the new model CVRP-NTW is proposed to optimize the multi-objective of minimizing total cost of distribution, minimizing total time spent, maximizing customer satisfaction and minimizing energy consumption. A new improved SSA algorithm is designed to solve the model, applying a reverse elite strategy in initializing the population and designing a sequence optimization strategy in decoding. Five different sizes of customer point instances are constructed for testing. GA and DQPSO are chosen as the comparison algorithms for ISSA. The experimental results show that ISSA can significantly improve the solution quality and solution speed.

articleTitle: Global output feedback stabilization for a class of nonlinear systems subjected to both multiple time-varying delays and zero dynamics
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of global output feedback stabilization for a class of time-delay nonlinear systems simultaneously subjected to dynamic uncertainties and an unknown output function. Compared with related celebrated works, the considered systems allow the existence of parameter uncertainties in the output function and nonlinearities, dynamic uncertainties of the unmeasurable state, and continuous external disturbances. A new systematic methodology is established by revamping the double-domination technique with the utilization of a dynamic-gain strategy, an output feedback controller together with a delicate state observer is established successfully, which guarantees the convergence of the states of the closed-loop systems. Finally, a simulation example is given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Exploring Cancer Biomarker Genes from Gene Expression Data via Natureinspired Multiobjective Optimization
abstract: The identification of high-dimensional cancer genesis particularly important for cancer detection and early prevention. Many studies have been proposed to address cancer sub-type diagnosis, however, these methods often suffer from low diagnostic power and poor generalization performance. In this paper, we investigate a TLBO-based multi-objective hybrid algorithm (MOTLBO) to optimize six objectives including the number of features, the accuracy, the precision, two entropy based measures: sensitivity, specificity and comprehensive index Kappa index. First, the data are dimensionalzed by a mutual information-based approach, and then we employ a fractional encoding mapping to select a subset of informative genes to optimize these target functions. Secondly, different TF values are used based on the roles in the evolutionary process to seek Pareto solutions. Finally, a perturbation-based local search method is proposed to explore neighborhood regions with sparse high-quality solutions. To demonstrate the effectiveness of the algorithm, we apply it on cancer gene expression data and compare it ten classification algorithms.

articleTitle: Stochastic stability and stabilization of Markov jump linear systems with fixed dwell time and unknown transition rates
abstract: This paper investigates the stochastic stability and stabilization of Markov jump linear systems(MJLSs) with fixed dwell time (FDT) and partially known or completely unknown transition rates. By constructing an auxiliary system that originated from the initial system with state jumps, some stochastic stability criteria in terms of LMIs for MJLSs with FDT are established with both partially known or completely unknown transition rates. Based on multiple piecewise quadratic Lyapunov functions (MPQLFs) and vertex method, state feedback controllers are designed to stabilize the MJLSs with FDT and unknown transition rates by solving LMIs. Finally, a numerical example is given to illustrate the viability of our results.

articleTitle: Event-Triggered Integration of Fault Estimation and Fault-Tolerant Control for Nonlinear Multi-agent Systems
abstract: In this paper, the event-triggered fault-tolerant leader-follower consensus problem is studied for a group of heterogeneous uncertain nonlinear multi-agent systems with actuator faults and external disturbances. An event-triggered integrated fault estimation and fault-tolerant cooperative control strategy is proposed. Firstly, an observer is designed for each agent to estimate the size of the fault. Then, an output feedback fault-tolerant control protocol and an event-triggered mechanism are proposed. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy is illustrated by a numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Sparse Gaussian Feature Learning for Nonlinear Industrial Fault Diagnosis
abstract: With the increasing complexity of modern industrial processes, the high-dimensional industrial data exhibits strong nonlinearity, bringing considerable challenges to the fault diagnosis of processes. To efficiently extract deep meaningful features that are crucial for fault diagnosis, a sparse Gaussian feature extractor(SGFE) is designed to learn a nonlinear mapping that projects the raw data into the feature space with the fault label dimension. The feature space is described by the one-hot encoding of the fault category label as an orthogonal basis. In this way, the sparse Gaussian features related to fault categories can be gradually learned from the raw data by SGFE. In the feature space, the sparse Gaussian (SG) loss function is designed to constrain the distribution of features to multiple sparse multivariate Gaussian distributions. The sparse Gaussian features are linearly separable in the feature space, which can improve the accuracy of the downstream fault classification task. The effectiveness of the proposed SGFE is verified by the Tennessee–Eastman (TE) benchmark process.

articleTitle: A DEA-RA Model with Restrain Cone for Efficiency Estimation and Evaluation
abstract: Data envelopment analysis (DEA) is a technique to measure relative efficiency. Regression analysis (RA) is a statistical process for estimating the relationships among variables based on the model of averaged images. Based on the continuity of human thinking, it is feasible to establish an intermediate evaluation model via combining DEA and RA. Besides, a cone-ratio DEA model C<sup>2</sup>WH can reflect decision makers’ preference for sample indexes or decision-making units (DMU). Thus, DEA-RA model is established based on restraint cone by combining C2WH model and RA model, and a generalized DEA-RA model is proposed on condition that restraint cone is a polyhedral convex cone. Then, the performances of 16 Chinese logistics companies are analyzed using generalized DEA-RA model, indicating that the model can reflect preferences of decision maker during judgment and analysis, and consequently a subjective and objective comprehensive evaluation method is formed.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the impact of grid-connected energy storage on short-circuit current in systems with a high proportion of renewable energy
abstract: Energy storage technology breaks the asynchrony between energy production and consumption, makes energy convertible in time and space, and realizes the premise of energy complementarity and sharing. In modern power grid, energy storage, especially electrochemical battery energy storage technology, has become an important support for the access and utilization of large-scale centralized and distributed renewable energy generation. In the context of the development of energy Internet, the role and status of energy storage will change significantly. Based on the application of energy storage in power system, the function of energy storage will be further expanded, and energy storage technology will obtain new development opportunities. With the rapid development of the application of battery energy storage technology, its impact on the power grid is far-reaching. However, the research on the short-circuit current contributed by battery energy storage after AC short-circuit and its influence on power grid stability is still blank at home and abroad. In addition, the existing short-circuit current calculation standards and methods do not involve the influence of energy storage system on short-circuit current in case of AC short-circuit fault. At present, the International Electrotechnical Commission IEC 60909 and American National Standards Association short-circuit current calculation standards do not involve the contribution of battery energy storage to the short-circuit current of AC system during short circuit. Circuit and connected to the grid. In the planning, design and operation control of power system, the selection of system equipment capacity parameters, the setting of protection devices and the arrangement of operation mode all need to calculate the short-circuit current. With the increasing proportion of energy storage system capacity, the impact on AC system short-circuit current can not be ignored.

articleTitle: Adaptive Neural Network Dynamic Surface Control of Uncertain Nonlinear Systems with Unknown Control Direction and Unknown Actuator Fault
abstract: This paper investigated the tracking control problem of a class of uncertain nonlinear systems with unknown control direction and unknown actuator fault. By using the neural network control approach and dynamic surface control technique, an adaptive neural network dynamic surface control (NNDSC) law is designed. Based on the neural network approximator, the uncertain nonlinear dynamics are approximated. To solve the unknown control direction problem and deal with the unknown actuator fault, a type of Nussbaum gain function is incorporated into the recursive design of dynamic surface control. Under the designed adaptive control law, it can be proved that all of the signals in the closed-loop system are semiglobal bounded and the tracking error can be guaranteed to converge to the specified small neighborhood of the origin by adjusting the designing parameters. The effectiveness of the designed control law is proved by a given numerical example.

Author Keywords: Adaptive Neural Network Dynamic Surface Control

articleTitle: Research on Regional Traffic Speed Prediction Based on Capsule Network and Attention Mechanism
abstract: Accurate and efficient prediction of the traffic conditions of complex road networks is critical to the management and control of today’s traffic, especially for the regional traffic speed prediction in the complex road connection, Because of its non-linear time-varying and complex temporal-spatial correlation, it is extremely challenging to predict traffic speed. So, this paper proposes a capsule network model based on attention mechanism(A-CapsNet), which converts traffic speed data into images for learning, and then predicts regional traffic speed. This research extracts the spatial correlation of the complex traffic road network through the capsule network, and embeds the attention mechanism into the capsule network to enhance the importance of the key node information of the convolutional layer in the capsule network. Validated on 12 months of traffic speed data set of the Santander city center road network in Spain, shows that A-CapsNet has superior performance in terms of prediction accuracy and interpretability.

articleTitle: Front Matter
Robust Stabilization for Fuzzy Systems via Event-Triggered Integral Sliding Mode Control Method
abstract: An event-triggered integral sliding mode control method is presented to investigate the stabilization problem for a class of single-input T-S fuzzy systems. Different from the related results, two kinds of sliding mode switching functions are proposed to analyze the reachability of the sliding surface and design the controller. In order to reduce the burden of information transmission, the triggering state is used to construct the integral sliding mode switching function. Using the triggering-state-dependent switching function, the event-triggered integral sliding mode control law is designed, which can guarantee that the system trajectories can reach the sliding surface. Furthermore, a time-varying triggering threshold is used in the event-triggered condition to guarantee that the system trajectories can exponentially converge to a bounded region. Moreover, a sufficient condition of ultimate boundedness for sliding motion is given to solve the controller gain. Meanwhile, the proposed method does not require that the assumption that the inter execution time has a uniform upper bound. Finally, an example is presented to show the effectiveness of obtained theoretical results.

articleTitle: State Estimation for 2-D Roesser Model with Multiple Network Induced Phenomena
abstract: This paper is concerned with the state estimation problem for a class of 2-D Roesser model, where the multiply network induced phenomena including time delay, sensor saturation and missing measurement are simultaneously considered under the network environment. By introducing a 2-D stochastic variable, these network induced phenomena are successfully described by an uniform measurement model. The time delay in the measurement and the probability of the stochastic binary sequence characterizing the time delay are all assumed to be time-varying. With help of the obtained measurement, the gain-scheduling state estimator for the 2-D Roesser model is constructed. In order to enhance the adaptability to the stochastic factors in network environment, the gains are designed to be two portions of constant and variation, which thus make the state estimator can be scheduled on line. By resorting to a sequence of mathematical operations, the error dynamics related to the original 2-D system and the state estimator is established. The mean-square asymptotical stability of the estimation error system is analyzed on basis of the Lyapunov stability theorem and the stochastic analysis techniques. The acquired stability criteria in terms of time-varying form are effectively converted to a finite number of line matrix inequalities (LMIs). Feasibility of the studied state estimation technique is confirmed by its good performance on the numerical example.

articleTitle: Research on Pump Reliability Based on Weibull Proportional Hazards Model
abstract: Aiming at the problem of safe operation of pump equipment and preventing over maintenance, a proportional hazards model was established based on the historical failure interval and historical operation data of pump equipment to carry out preventive maintenance and reliability analysis. In this paper, the failure intervals of pump equipment basically conform to the Weibull distribution characteristics, and the Weibull proportional hazards model is established based on the failure intervals and vibration state operation data of a certain type of pump equipment in a refinery in a historical period of time. The maximum likelihood method is used to estimate the parameters of the model and establish the reliability model. The results show that the validation data are verified by the model, and the results basically accord with the engineering practice, and the reliability analysis of the pump equipment is effectively realized.

articleTitle: An Initial Alignment Method of Mobile Robot Rotational Strapdown Inertial Navigation System Based on RWNN Observer
abstract: The positioning performance of intelligent mobile robot is directly affected by the performance of inertial navigation system (INS). In order to improve the long-term performance of low precision MEMS level navigation system, an initial alignment method of mobile robot rotating strapdown inertial navigation system based on RWNN observer is studied. In this method, the non random errors in gyroscope and accelerometer are eliminated through the integration operation of strapdown inertial navigation algorithm in rotational base, and the platform error angle is quickly estimated based on the filtering method of the RWNN (Recurrent Wavelet Neural Network) observer, so as to complete the initial alignment of INS. This paper discusses the error dynamics state space model of RSINS, as well as the construction process of the RWNN observer, and verifies the performance of INS based on a certain type of fiber-optic gyro and MEMS accelerometer. The result of experiment result shows that the initial alignment method proposed in this paper has high alignment performance, and can be widely used in new energy power inspection robot, automatic driving positioning and other relative fields.

articleTitle: Faster yolov5 based modeling and control of acoustic manipulate on a Chladni Plate
abstract: The motion of particles on a Chladni plate can be applied to research the influence of the acoustics on tiny objects. It is traditionally believed that given a sound wave frequency, the particles on a Chladni plate will form a pattern, so called Chaldni figure. However, since the Chladni figure of a single vibration frequency is fixed, if the particle is vibrating at a constant frequency, the particle will finally stabilize at a certain point on the Chladni plate. Thus, the dynamic control of the particle cannot be achieved. Thus, it is necessary to continually select different frequencies, that is, to change the Chladni figure for manipulating the motion of the particles. In this paper, first, we use the YOLOV5 algorithm for analyzing the influence of the acoustics and building the model. Then, during the experiment, it also used to obtain the real-time position of the multiple particles on the plate. With the constantly feedback of the position information, the difference between the real-time position and the target point can be obtained to accurately select the sound wave frequency for controlling the particles motion. Compared with traditional methods, we adopt the method YOLOV5 of object detection in deep learning to recognize Chladni figure in real time. Successfully demonstrated the effect of sound waves on particles and achieved precise control.

articleTitle: Evolution analysis of the time-varying trust Hegselmann-Krause models
abstract: As a typical state-dependent model in opinion dynamics, bounded confidence model has attracted many scholars to study its evolution characteristics and phenomena. In order to describe the "Similarity Effect" in psychology, we introduce the sensitivity of opinion difference into the classical Hegselmann-Krause (HK) model. In this paper, a new time-varying trust Hegselmann-Krause (Trust Hegselmann-Krause, THK) model is proposed, and the opinion evolution phenomena in homogeneous THK model and heterogeneous THK model are studied respectively. Simulation analyses show that in homogenous THK model, the more sensitive the group is, the slower the opinion evolution speed is, and it is more difficult to achieve consensus. While in heterogenous THK model, it is necessary to choose a proper sensitivity parameter for open-minded group to promote the opinion consensus.

articleTitle: Research on Startup Control Strategy of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor for In-Vehicle Compressor
abstract: In the startup process of the permanent magnet synchronous motor of the in-vehicle compressor, the blocked motor and the large fluctuation of starting torque and nonuniform change in velocity keep recurring, which will lead to the failure of the refrigeration and heating control of the compressor. By analyzing the startup process of permanent magnet synchronous motor, the motor control model of compressor is established based on rotational inertia and friction coefficient,etc, and a starting control strategy will proposed based on speed subsection method. When the compressor is started, the control strategy reduces the electromagnetic torque ripple by 75% and the speed fluctuation converges to less than 10%, which effectively improves reliability of startup and stability of operation of the in-vehicle compressor.

articleTitle: Evaluation of National Defense Science and Technology Venture Capital Project based on FAHP-FPP-TOPSIS model
abstract: Project evaluation is an important link in the operation process of the defense technology venture capital fund. Based on previous studies, this paper proposes a method for evaluating national defense science and technology venture capital projects based on the FAHP-FPP-TOPSIS hybrid model, using fuzzy analytic hierarchy process to construct a fuzzy decision matrix, using fuzzy priority programming method for planning and solving, and using approximation Based on the ideal solution method to evaluate the specific implementation processes of the project ranking in which a detailed analysis is carried out. The project selection case analysis is carried out in combination with the investment practice of GD Capital, which verifies the feasibility of the proposed method and model.

Author Keywords: National Defense Science and Technology Venture Capital

articleTitle: Multiple-Interval Pseudospectral Method for Optimal Control Problem with Application to Trajectory Planning
abstract: In this paper, a class of optimal control problems with control input under constraints of multiple intervals is considered. The multiple interval pseudospectral based algorithm is proposed to obtain numerical solution. It is shown that the KKT conditions and continuous first order conditions are closely linked by discrete parameters. Moreover, we prove that the error between the discrete solution of NLP problem and continuous solution of an optimal control problem can be tuned by discrete parameters. The proposed method is applied to solve the typical aircraft trajectory planning problem. In order to conform to the actual operation instructions, the entire trajectory is divided into multiple intervals and control variables keep constant in every phase. The simulations demonstrate the effectiveness of proposed multiple-interval pseudospectral method.

articleTitle: Aero-engine model modification method based on intelligent correction mechanism
abstract: Model-based aero-engine control is greatly affected by the accuracy of the model. Aiming at this problem, an aero-engine model parameter correction method based on intelligent algorithms is proposed. The method uses intelligent algorithm modules to correct the deviation between the model output and the actual output of the aero engine caused by unmodeled dynamics, performance degradation and other factors. The intelligent algorithms is trained through the output of mechanism models and aero-engine output data. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified through simulation cases. The simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively correct model deviations and has strong generalization ability for different model deviations.

articleTitle: A Fractional Order Control Method of Electromechanical Actuator Based on PSO-SA Optimization
abstract: In this paper, to improve the dynamic performance of the electromechanical actuator, a fractional-order PID controller is proposed and its parameters is optimized by particle swarm optimization-simulated annealing algorithm. Firstly, based on dynamic model of electromechanical actuator servo system, a fractional order controller is designed. Then, using particle swarm optimization-simulated annealing algorithm, five parameters in the proposed fractional-order PID controller is tuned. The performance comparisons of the servo system under the proposed fractional-order PID and conventional integral-order PID controllers are given. The simulation results show that the proposed fractional-order PID controller can greatly improve the dynamic performance of the electromechanical actuator control system.

articleTitle: Research on price and effort decision of green travel companies under competition
abstract: This paper studies the price and effort decision of green travel companies under competition. Considering the cross-effect of prices and efforts on demand of green travel companies, the optimal strategies under the centralized decision-making scenario and the decentralized decision-making scenario are obtained respectively. After analyzing the optimal results, we can get the following observations. Both the travel price and the green effort of green companies under the centralized decision-making scenario are higher than that under the decentralized decision-making scenario. A large effort cost coefficient puts green travel companies at a disadvantage in the competition. For green travel companies, the demand under the cross-effect of travel prices is greater than that under the cross-effect of green efforts.

articleTitle: Adaptive tracking control of the quadrotor with state constraints and bounded disturbances
abstract: For quadrotor system with state constraints, unknown mass and bounded disturbances, the problem of tracking control is considered in this paper. To overcome the underactuated, the system is first divided into position loop and attitude loop by introducing internal variables. Barrier Lyapunov Functions are introduced to maintain state constraints. Different from usual controller design, a tuning adaptive state feedback tracking controller in vector from is skillfully designed such that tracking error can be made small enough, while keeping all signals in closed-loop system bounded. The simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the control scheme.

articleTitle: Optimization of Signal Timing Coordination at Short-spaced Intersections
abstract: On urban roads, short-spaced intersections often cause vehicle queue overflow and deadlock at intersections because of the short distance between two adjacent intersections. For short-spaced intersections, this paper aims to propose a novel signal timing optimization method to reduce vehicle delay, combined with the idea of green wave coordinated control. At the same time, considering the road distance of adjacent intersections, the traffic phase sequence and timing scheme are designed. This paper takes the short-line intersection of Zhonghua Road in Nanjing as the research object, analyzes the traffic situation of this section, and puts forward the traffic phase sequence scheme and timing optimization scheme. Compared with the existing timing schemes, the effectiveness of the scheme is verified.

articleTitle: Design of Cement 3D Printing Servo System Based on DSP28335
abstract: This paper presents a design of cement 3D printing servo system based on DSP28335, and gives the software and hardware design scheme of the control system. The high-speed digital signal processor DSP28335 is used as the main control unit to control the moving speed and path of the printing nozzle of the cement 3D printing system.

articleTitle: EKF-based data-driven backstepping control of continuous stirred tank reactor
abstract: This paper proposes a data-driven backstepping control (DDBC) method based on Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) for a class of nonlinear chemical process with Gaussian noise. Firstly, the states are observed by EKF to reduce the influence of stochastic interference such as Gaussian noise. Secondly, DDBC framework is designed. In this framework, nonlinear terms of system without model dynamic are estimated from states for solving the influence of model uncertainty. Then, based on Lyapunov theory, the controller is designed recursively. Finally, EKF-based DDBC is used to continuous stirred tank reactor (CSTR) with Gaussian noise and the effectiveness of this design is verified through simulation.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis in chemical process systems via Meta-Learning
abstract: In the field of chemical process fault diagnosis, there is a common objective problem of less effective fault samples. In many practical chemical process fault application scenarios, the acquisition cost of fault samples is usually very high, and it may be time-consuming and unsafe to collect enough data samples for each fault class. This paper introduces the idea of meta-learning into the field of chemical process systems, and propose few-shot fault diagnosis model based on Meta-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML). By realizing the method of automatic learning inner-loop learning rate, the model is optimized to make it converge faster and reduce over-fitting. Finally, the Tennessee Eastman Process (TEP) experiment verifies the performance of the model. The experimental results show that this MAML-LR model has better generalization ability and convergence speed than the MAML-Based model, and it has a good effect on few-shot fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Online Robust RVFLN for Quality Prediction of Blast Furnace Ironmaking
abstract: In this paper, a new robust online regression prediction algorithm based on random vector functional-link network (RVFLN) is proposed for multivariate molten iron quality indexes modeling in blast furnace ironmaking process. Firstly, aiming at the multicollinearity problem of blast furnace ironmaking process data, the output weight of RVFLN is calculated by partial least squares regression. Secondly, in the actual ironmaking process, there are a wide range of abnormal values due to various reasons. Considering that these outliers exist in the direction of input and output samples at the same time, Mallows Generalized M-estimation is used to improve the robustness of the model. In addition, in order to realize online modeling, this paper combines online learning to improve the adaptability of the algorithm. Finally, the proposed online robust modeling algorithm is tested in the actual blast furnace ironmaking process data. The results show that this method has strong robustness and high prediction accuracy for abnormal data modeling.

articleTitle: Multi-channel Separated Encoder Based Convolutional Neural Network for Locomotion Intention Recognition
abstract: Wearable robots have become increasingly popular in the field of rehabilitation and medical care in recent years. Human motion intent recognition is gaining traction as a key component of wearable robot operation. Existing approaches include traditional methods and convolutional neural network (CNN)-based approaches. Traditional approaches suffer from manual feature selection, which require expert knowledge thus are tedious work. CNN-based approaches treat the input data as a whole, which are unable to fully decouple the inner feature within each channel. This paper proposes a CNN based motion intent prediction network, which utilizes a multi-channel separated encoder to make full use of the data from different axes in the sensor for feature extraction and to decouple data with different degrees of freedom. Experimental results show that the method can successfully recognize motion intent, improve recognition accuracy over existing methods, and reduce recognition errors during the modal transition.

articleTitle: Robust Frequency Control of Microgrid Containing Electric Vehicles
abstract: With the increase of renewable energy resources (RESs) and electric vehicles (EVs) integrated into microgrid (MG), frequency instability caused by disturbances and uncertainties will affect the stable operation of MG. Existing studies of frequency control mainly focus on the design of an appropriate controller. However, due to low inertia caused by the lack of traditional generation and unpredictable load fluctuation brought by EVs, the requirements on frequency controller need to improve. To deal with this challenge, an H∞ robust controller is designed to stabilize MG frequency in this paper. By controlling the output power of micro-turbine (MT), proposed controller balances the difference between active power and load. Three cases which include the fluctuation of RESs output power, the variation of user load and the process of EVs connected to MG are considered to verify the performance on proposed controller. The comparison between H∞ robust controller and classical proportional-integral (PI) controller is also presented. Simulation results validate that the designed H∞ robust controller provides reliable frequency support successfully to an islanded MG under the disturbances of RESs and EVs.

articleTitle: Leader-Following Consensus of Multiagent Systems with Non-Differentiable Time Delay via Event-Triggered Control
abstract: This paper investigates the consensus tracking problem of multiagent systems with non-differentiable delay. Unlike most of the existing works, the differentiability of the time-varying delay is removed and, thus, a wide range of delay patterns is possible. To begin with, the property of the useful differential inequality with non-differentiable delay is proved and some sufficient conditions are established to guarantee the exponential convergence of the multiagent systems. Then, an event-triggered control protocol with time-varying control gain is developed to achieve the tracking consensus, which covers many existing combinatorial control protocols and provides good flexibility in applications. Furthermore, the Zeno behavior can be avoided. Finally, a simulation example is provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Robust Control of Static Var Generator Based on Loop Forming
abstract: The static var generator has the advantages of good reactive power compensation performance, small size and low loss, and has been widely used in power systems. Aiming at the problems of poor anti-interference ability and low accuracy of regulation of static var generator controlled by traditional proportional-integral control, we propose a control strategy of static var generator based on loop forming robust controller. First, the mathematical model of SVG is established, and the uncertainty of its parameters is considered in the current inner loop control to model. A robust controller for loop forming is designed. Finally, the reactive power compensation effect of the static reactive power generator control is tested in MATLAB/Simulink with resistive inductive and resistive capacitive loads respectively, and the results verify the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Passivity-Based Online Reinforcement Learning for Real Time Model-Free Overhead Crane System Control
abstract: In this paper, a novel model-free online Reinforcement Learning (RL) control method is proposed for the real-time overhead crane control problem. The crane control problem is first formulated as an optimal regulation problem with a user-specified objective function. Two neural-networks, namely Actor-Critic networks, are employed to approximate the objective function and the optimal control policy respectively. Then, an improved network updating rule with an additional passivity-based stabilization term is developed to remove the requirement of the initial stabilizing control policy. Unlike other crane control approaches, the proposed online RL algorithm does not rely on prior knowledge of the overhead crane mathematical model. Finally, simulation studies are carried out to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in the presence of system parameter variations when compared to LQR control.

articleTitle: Formation control design of Multiple Underwater Vehicles based on LADRC
abstract: Aiming at the problem of small ocean detection range and low efficiency, this paper applied the cooperative formation mode of multiple autonomous underwater vehicles to study the control effect of traditional PID control and linear active disturbance rejection controller (LADRC) on the formation control problem. Simulation results show that under a certain external disturbance, the PID controller and the LADRC can achieve good control for multiple autonomous underwater vehicles formation, but LADRC algorithm in terms of the performance of disturbance resistance and the quickness of the response of the system is superior to the classical PID control. It can estimate and compensate the total disturbance of the system, so as to improve the anti-interference ability and robustness of the system.

articleTitle: Robust Localization Based on LiDAR Inertial fusion for Plant Logistics
abstract: With the gradual development of LiDAR inertial fusion localization algorithm, the technology of autonomous tractor for plant logistics has become more mature. Due to the complex and changeable characteristics of the plant environment, it is difficult to provide stable localization for autonomous tractor through single map matching localization or LiDAR inertial odometry localization method. On the one hand, the plant environment is full of dynamic interference, and the long-term map will change significantly, which will lead to jump and instability in map matching and localization. On the other hand, the LiDAR inertial odometry localization will drift seriously for a long time, which is unacceptable for the further trajectory planning. Therefore, this paper considers the integration of map matching localization and LiDAR inertial odometry localization between key frames, so as to adapt to the impact of environmental changes and odometry drift and increase the robustness and accuracy of localization.

articleTitle: Research on multi-channel adaptive fuzzy temperature control method for warplane skin
abstract: To meet the engineering requirements of ground testing, a particle swarm optimization adaptive fuzzy PID multi-channel temperature controller for warplane skin is proposed in this paper. Based on the STM32 processor, multichannel temperature control loops of the warplane skin are built. The controller uses thermal resistances to measure the surface temperature of the skin areas. Meanwhile, by using PWM signals and solid-state relays to drive the heating elements, the closed-loop feedback of skin surface temperature control is achieved. Then, a class of the fuzzy rules is proposed, and fuzzy vectors of the temperature error signal and error differential signal are established. The maximum membership method is used to solve the variation of the three adjustment parameters of the PID algorithm. When the particle swarm optimization algorithm optimizes the adjustment parameters of the fuzzy PID controller, a method of changing the inertia coefficient using a linear decreasing method is given, which enhances the optimization ability and convergence speed of the adaptive algorithm. Finally, the superiority and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by numerical simulation and physical testing.

articleTitle: Flow patterns identification of horizontal oil-water two-phase flow based on multivariate variational mode decomposition-Hilbert Huang Transform
abstract: Aiming to the problem of low identification in dealing with multivariate time series of oil-water two-phase flow by traditional time-frequency analysis technology, we propose a time-frequency analysis method of oil-water two-phase flow based on multivariate variational mode decomposition (MVMD) - Hilbert Huang transform (HHT). Decomposing the multi-channel time series that containing hydrodynamic information by multivariate variational mode, and further determine the inherent mode functions (IMFs) through spectrum analysis. Then, we perform HHT on IMFs and select the time-frequency characteristics of the signals to distinguish the flow patterns. The experimental results show that by selecting the Hilbert spectrum and marginal spectrum as the time-frequency characteristics, it can recognize the oil-water two-phase flow patterns under different flow velocities and map the nonlinear variation of fluid effectively, which has certain guiding significance for multivariate time series analysis of relative complex systems.

articleTitle: Distributed Energy Management for Port Microgrid with We-Energy
abstract: In this paper, for the port microgrid with large-scale integration of renewable energy and clean energy, the energy management problem considering we-energies is investigated. Firstly, except the distributed generators and storage devices, we also regard green ships as we-energies, and obtain the cost function of various resources according to the port microgrid structure. Then considering the characteristic of two-way energy transmission between we-energies, the cost of the we-energies is analyzed and the energy management model of the whole port microgrid is established. Furthermore, a distributed energy management strategy is proposed to solve this problem. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed model and the effectiveness of the algorithm are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Intelligent optimization of process parameters to corn straw pretreatment
abstract: For the optimization of pretreatment process parameters of corn straw, an intelligent optimization method is used, which combines the prediction model and the optimization algorithm. The support vector machine (SVM) prediction model for biogas production is constructed. And the optimal process parameters are obtained by grasshopper optimization algorithm (GOA) on the prediction model. Due to the difficulty of obtaining experimental data, the problem of small samples during the model training exists. So, the virtual samples are generated by uniform interpolation combined with GOA to improve the model prediction accuracy. Through the experiment of dual-frequency ultrasound combined with alkali pretreatment of corn stover fermentation, the effectiveness of virtual sample generation and the feasibility of intelligent process parameter search are verified.

articleTitle: A Real-time 3D Shape Sensing Algorithm Based on Self-Organizing Map
abstract: Due to the complex motion structure, it is often difficult to achieve precise control of the soft manipulator. An important part of this is the real-time feedback of the shape of the target. In this paper, a real-time 3D shape sensing algorithm based on stereo vision and Self-Organizing Map (SOM) network without marking points is proposed. The algorithm extracts the edge data of the target for each frame, and uses SOM to cluster the key points at the center line, and then reconstructs the key points in three dimensions to obtain the shape and position information of the target. Experiments is carried out to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm and errors are analyzed.

articleTitle: Global Exponential Stability for Clifford-Valued Coupled Neural Networks with Mixed Time-Varying Delays
abstract: In this paper, the global exponential stability for a class of Clifford-valued coupled neural networks with mixed time-varying delays is studied. Firstly, the existence and uniqueness of the equilibrium point of Clifford-valued coupled neural networks are proved by using the properties of M-matrix and inequality techniques, and then, the sufficient condition of global exponential stability of Clifford-valued coupled neural networks is proposed. Finally, the effectiveness of the results is verified by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: An improved Image Inpainting Algorithm Based on Attention Fusion Module
abstract: When we try to reproduce existing inpainting algorithms, our performances are often not stable, and the results are not up to expectations. In this paper, we devise an improved image inpainting algorithm mainly constructed by an attention fusion module (AFM) and a refined inpainting module. The AFM evaluates the existing methods' results pixel-wise, similar to humans judging the quality of the inpainting results with naked eyes. The evaluations make a quantitative judgment on the inpainting quality and fused with pre-inpainted images. The refined inpainting module focuses on the areas with poor quality and improves them. This method address the shortcomings of other models like smoothness and texture sharpening. The experimental results on multiple datasets show significant improvements based on existing methods.

articleTitle: THz Super-Resolution Imaging Based on Complex Fast Deconvolution with Incomplete Boundaries
abstract: The method of deconvolution is proved to be an effective method to solve the Low-Resolution (LR) problem of THz imaging. Nevertheless, in the case of unknown boundaries, there are problems of incomplete observations in Terahertz (THz) images. These problems may lead to slow speed for standard deconvolution methods or the occurrence of artifacts for fast deconvolution. In this paper, we proposed a new fast deconvolution algorithm for incomplete boundary THz images with FFT to speed up and iteratively alternate the estimation of the unknown pixels to deal with artifacts. The Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) is used for optimization. The reference evaluation indicators illustrate the efficiency and effectiveness of the proposed method. Super-Resolution (SR) results show that the proposed method has good performance in suppressing artifacts and, the convergence of the presented algorithm is verified. The proposed method is believed to address the LR problems for THz imaging and will be applied in many fields.

articleTitle: Load Demand Response Value Evaluation and Analysis Based on Source-load Similarity
abstract: Under the background of a high proportion of renewable energy being connected to power grid, the uncertainty of the power generation side and the demand side has increased, and it is difficult to support the regulation demand of power grid by relying on the power generation side alone to respond to load changes. Demand response (DR) is an effective means to improve the flexibility of power grid by taking advantage of the adjustability of the load side. In order to quantitatively evaluate the effect and value of DR of load, a median dynamic time warping (M-DTW) index which is used to describe the similarity between the load and renewable energy generation curve is proposed. It is verified by comparative analysis that more renewable energy generation can be absorbed with load regulation based on the proposed index. After that, the M-DTW index is used to describe the static and dynamic DR value of the user load curve, and the agglomeration effect and value of the load cluster in DR are simulated and analyzed. It is shown that the M-DTW index can provide a quantitative method and theoretical support for guiding and evaluating the contribution of DR.

articleTitle: An Improved Feature Pyramid based Two-Stage Haze Removal Network for Marine Ships
abstract: The marine ship image is affected by special weather such as sea fog, which leads to low image contrast and color distortion. In this paper, RDFP-Net which is a modified feature pyramid based two-stage dehazing network is proposed for marine ship images. Considering the loss of details and color distortion of the original image caused by deeper features, a Feature Pyramid Network (FPN) is introduced to retain detailed multi-scale information while a Residual Dense Block (RDB) is combined further to better extract detail feature maps for haze image in the first stage. In addition, the Channel Attention Mechanism (CAM) is employed in the fusion of low-level and high-level feature maps. Thus, more attention is focused on the representative channels by assigning different weight. Finally, more image details are recovered through the second stage. Experimental results demonstrated that RDFP-Net achieves better qualitative visual effects and quantitative indicators with other the state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Differential Wheel Robot Fixed Posture Positioning Control
abstract: This paper focuses on the closed-loop fixed posture positioning control of a differential wheeled robot. First, a new posture error function is proposed based on the existing kinematics model, and the state transformation is used to apply it to the existing dynamic model, and the ability of the robot to move backwards is improved by stabilizing the transformed system model. Subsequently, based on proportional-differential control, a new control law related to speed and angle is proposed to ensure that the robot first achieves the correct operating posture and maintains a relatively stable operating process when starting. Secondly, by designing the barrier Lyapunov function, the stability of the proposed control law is verified. Finally, MATLAB simulation are used to prove the effectiveness of the proposed control law.

articleTitle: Computationally Efficient Model Predictive Current Control for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machines Based Two-Level Inverter
abstract: The model predictive current control (MPCC) for permanent magnet synchronous machines (PMSM) considers all admissible voltage vectors to select best voltage vector, causing long computational time. In order to decrease computational burden, firstly, the mathematic model of PMSM is built in aft coordinate instead of dq coordinate to avoid the transformation of coordinates. Secondly, the predictive model of PMSM is analyzed in detail to get the principle of selecting most suitable voltage vector instead of calculation. Finally, the participating voltage vectors increase from 8tol8 and the novel voltage vector modulation principle is proposed to further improve the performance of PMSM with less computational burden, meanwhile, the delay is analyzed and compensated, causing by calculation time. The simulation and experimental results validate the effectiveness of the proposed schemes in this paper.

articleTitle: Multi-robot task allocation for airport runway inspection
abstract: Airport runway safety inspections and timely Foreign Object Debris (FOD) removal can effectively guarantee the safe take-off and landing of flights. At present, the number of flights taking off and landing on the airport runway is large, and the runway inspection time window is short, so there are problems such as safety inspection and FOD removal in time, which affect the safety of flight takeoff and landing. The use of multiple inspection robots for inspection and the use of multiple FOD removal robots for FOD removal can effectively shorten the inspection and FOD removal operation time. In order to solve the problem of multi-robot task allocation in airport runway safety inspection and FOD removal, this paper proposes a "inspection-removal" model and an extended Consensus Based Bundle Algorithm (CBBA) based on time window constraints, which are used for multi-robot task allocation. This algorithm effectively solves the problem of cooperative allocation between inspection robots and FOD removal robots. The algorithm has achieved good experimental results in a simulation environment, and can be used in airport runway safety inspections.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Successive Compensation Method for Plant-Wide Production Index Based on Industrial Data
abstract: Due to the complexities of high-dimensionality, nonlinearity, many constraints, and process model mismatch, the plant-wide production index needs to be compensated when the production index is applied to the actual production process. This paper proposes a nonlinear successive compensation method for the plant-wide production index based on industrial data. Based on the set point of the production index obtained from the plant-wide optimization, the method uses the large amount of industrial data stored in the industrial process to establish the relationship between production index compensation and the increase of economic benefit, optimizing the solution value of the production index compensation that maximizes the economic benefit increment. Through iterative compensation, the method gradually improved the economic benefit of the production process. The proposed method was applied to the hydrometallurgical production process of a refinery. The results verified the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Parameter Adaptive SEIRD model for Epidemic Prediction
abstract: The classical infectious disease diffusion model has a deficiency of static parameters, which will lead to server prediction error. Therefore, this article used three different parameter fitting methods to construct a dynamic update mechanism of outbreak spread parameters and reversed fitting through the actual data of the epidemic. The best epidemic transmission parameters can effectively predict the growth of the outbreak in the next cycle. Then, we take the second wave of the outbreak in India as an example, the dynamic update mechanism of the epidemic spread parameters can effectively improve the accuracy of the prediction of the evolution of the novel coronavirus epidemic. According to the test results,we believe it can help the government make correct decisions, implement effective control and realize the reasonable allocation of emergency resources.

articleTitle: Dynamic "optimistic" characteristic function in the game with spanning tree
abstract: Consider a two-stage n-person stochastic game with spanning tree. The cooperative action of the players is defined. In the first stage, players construct the associated cost matrix on a complete graph by selecting strategies, and determine the minimum cost spanning tree. After the first stage, the graph constructed by the players changes randomly with a given probability, and the cost of one or more edges is changed, depending on the action of all players in the first stage. This paper defines a dynamic "optimistic" game with spanning tree and new characteristic functions in the two-stage stochastic game. Finally, it is proved that under certain conditions, the core of the dynamic "optimistic" game is not empty.

articleTitle: An Auxiliary Decision Method for Playing of the Poker2to1 Agent
abstract: Intelligent agents play a similar role to players in the game, which is an important carrier to determine the progress of the game. It is difficult for an intelligent agent to make intelligent decisions similar to human play in any situation in Poker2to1 because competition, collaboration, imperfect information, huge action space and other factors intertwined. Moreover, due to the randomness of Poker2to1 game process, the action decision set of any situation of AI agent in the game process is constantly changing, which makes it more difficult for the Poker2to1 AI agent to make decisions on playing cards. This paper abstracts the game process of Poker2to1, puts forward a concept of shanwin distance, and constructs the relevant calculation method to assist Poker2to1 AI agent in any situation decision in the game process. Experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper can improve the decision-making efficiency of Poker2to1 AI. It is of positive reference significance to solve the problems of Poker2to1 and other imperfect information games.

articleTitle: An Improved Algorithm Design and Implementation Based on Unsupervised Learning in Computer Games
abstract: At present, the computer games with the intelligent algorithm optimization are always a popular research direction of the artificial intelligence. In this research field, the key concerned technologies and the important resolve are how to continue to gain the final winning rate constantly by independent identification realization, movement optimization and real-time update games based on the unsupervised learning algorithm in the computer chess games. According to the typical artificial intelligence application scene of computer games, an improved algorithm based on the unsupervised learning is designed and proposed in the paper. This algorithm uses alfa-beta search tree to select the best matching pattern and applies the concept of feature learning to make the image recognition innovatively. With the characteristics of the Checkers and the common search methods, it proposes a feature and pattern learning method based on the K-means clustering algorithm. By the experimental data and results, the improved algorithm proposed in the paper can gain and keep a high winning rate in the real games.

articleTitle: Load recognition based on sEMG of human upper limbs
abstract: This article mainly studies the human upper limb forearm, upper arm, upper arm and forearm, and left and right forearms when snatching a load of 10kg, 20kg, 30kg, 40kg, 50kg, and 60kg respectively. By collecting the sEMG signals in these four situations, and from time to time Extract 5 common features of sEMG signal from the domain as the feature vector of the original signal, and then use decision tree, random forest, LDA, K nearest neighbor, SVM to perform pattern recognition on the feature vector, and select the sEMG feature that is more suitable for load identification and recognition algorithm. Finally, the best method among the above four load identification methods is obtained through comparative analysis of experimental data.

articleTitle: A Modified Active Disturbance Rejection Control Strategy for Current Balance in Parallel LLC Resonant Converter
abstract: LLC resonant converter is widely used in electric vehicles, new energy power generation due to its high efficiency and high power density. However, its power level cannot be effectively improved due to the limitations of semiconductor devices and magnetic devices. Interleaving parallel technology is a great solution. However, the resonant element variations of two-phase LLC converter are not completely consistent due to the manufacturing process, which will lead to serious imbalanced power distribution. To solve this problem, a hybrid control strategy based on Linear Active Disturbance Rejection Control (ADRC) for LLC converter is designed in this paper. Firstly, the mathematical model of LLC resonant converter is established based on fundamental analysis method. Then, a hybrid controller is designed, which uses frequency modulation to control the output voltage and uses phase angle to compensate the gain error caused by resonant element variations. The control strategy does not increase additional switching loss and improves the rapidity and anti-interference of the system. Finally, the simulation results verify the feasibility of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: A Hand-Eye Calibration Method based on Nonlinear Joint Optimization for RGBD Cameras
abstract: Hand-eye calibration is a basic research topic in the field of robotic vision. At present, most works focus on the hand-eye calibration of RGB cameras, while methods for calibration of RGBD cameras are relatively rare. Two popular kinds of modes for RGBD cameras are based on the stereo vision and the structured light, which both contain at least two cameras for generating the color image and the depth image, respectively. Motivated by this special structure feature, the paper proposes a novel hand-eye calibration method for RGBD cameras by integrating the vision system and the hand-eye robotic system into a whole model. Specifically, the traditional hand-eye calibration method is firstly used to obtain initial values of hand-eye matrices of the two cameras in the RGBD camera separately. Then, a nonlinear joint optimization algorithm is carried out to refine hand-eye matrices, in which the objective is to minimize the joint reprojection error of feature comers in images outputting by the two cameras in the RGBD camera. Thus, the optimized hand-eye calibration matrices can be finally obtained for both cameras. The proposed calibration approach is validated on the robotic hand-eye system, and the experimental results demonstrate that the presented algorithm greatly improves the calibration accuracy compared with the traditional methods.

articleTitle: A Novel Abnormal Vibration State Recognition Method for Rolling Mill
abstract: The vibration of rolling mill is nonlinear and non-stationary. To effectively extract rolling mill vibration signal features for fault diagnosis, a method of feature vector extraction based on empirical wavelet transform (EWT) and fuzzy entropy (FE) is proposed. The method extracts the midpoint between the adjacent maximum values in the frequency domain of vibration signals, adaptively divides the Fourier spectrum, and constructs a suitable wavelet filter group to calculate different intrinsic mode functions (IMFs). Subsequently, calculate the fuzzy entropy of IMFs to be used as the feature vector. In addition, probabilistic neural networks (PNN) classifier is used to identify the types of vibration faults. Experimental results indicate that the accuracy of the method is higher than those based on Empirical mode decomposition (EMD) and multi-scale fuzzy entropy (MFE), under the limited sample condition. Thus, a referential diagnostic method is provided for practical applications.

articleTitle: Multi-Robot formation control based on improved virtual spring method
abstract: Multi-robot system may be difficult to avoid obstacles and maintain formation in the complex environment. This paper proposes a multi-robot formation control algorithm based on the improved virtual spring method. First, the traditional virtual spring model is improved by increasing the dynamic damping coefficient between robots. As a result, robots can achieve stable formation in complex environments. Second, in order to solve the problem of the goals non-reachable with obstacle nearby in the formation process effectively, the repulsive force and traction formula of the traditional virtual spring method are modified, and the obstacle virtual spring model with adjustable damping is established to complete the obstacle avoidance behavior of the robot. In addition, a safe distance switching strategy is designed based on the obstacle virtual spring model so that the robots can switch between Go-to-goal and Avoid-obstacles modes according to the distance from the obstacle. The proposed strategies have addressed the local minima successfully. Finally, the simulation results are presented to verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Packaging Bag Edge Detection Based on Improved Canny Algorithm
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the gray contrast of packaging bag patterns is not obvious in edge detection, an edge detection method of packaging bags based on improved Canny algorithm is proposed. First, the image is grayscale stretched. Second, the threshold is determined adaptively using Augmented Otsu. Enhanced Otsu adaptation makes the edge information of the detected image richer and the overall information more complete. Third, the obtained threshold is input into the Canny algorithm to obtain the edge detection result. Finally, the experimental results are analyzed and the information entropy is calculated. The results show that the edge image output by the improved Canny algorithm is richer in edge information, and the information entropy is increased by 12.63%, 5.09%, 3.18%, and 5.41%, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on Rudder Travel Limit Function of Civil Aircraft Flight Control System
abstract: Safety is the basic feature of civil aircraft. In order to prevent catastrophic effect caused by rudder deflection beyond limit at high airspeed, most of the civil aircrafts generally provide the Rudder Travel Limit function. This thesis offers a new function architecture of Rudder Travel Limit, performs the error analysis and trade-off study, which fully considers the impact of airspeed and actuator errors, can be used effectively in the Rudder Travel Limit function design of civil aircrafts.

articleTitle: Research on Gas Emergency Disposal Method Based on Knowledge Graph
abstract: When a gas accident occurs, relevant departments need to quickly determine an effective decision-making and disposal plan. However, most of the current gas accident emergency response plans are stored in text form. On-site disposal personnel need to consult a large number of texts to determine the corresponding disposal measures, and the timeliness is poor. In order to improve the reusability and flexibility of the gas emergency response plan stored in the form of text, and overcome the shortcomings of poor timeliness, this paper constructs a top-down and bottom-up gas emergency response knowledge graph. According to the classification of gas accident cases, a knowledge graph is constructed by combining TextRank keyword extraction, expert experience and semantic role labeling, and the feasibility of the method is verified by cases. This will be a promising decision-making method for gas emergency disposal.

articleTitle: Parameter Learning for the Hammerstein Output Error System with Time-delay State-space Model
abstract: This paper discusses a scheme for identifying the Hammerstein output error system with time-delay state-space model. The Hammerstein system is composed of a static nonlinear block approximated by neural fuzzy model and a dynamical linear block modeled by time-delay state-space model, and the parameters learning separation of the Hammerstein system is realized by using special test signal composed of Gaussian signal and random signal. Firstly, according to the properties of unit backward operator, the state space system can be transformed into a transfer function, and the parameters of the linear block can be estimated by the virtue of correlation analysis method based on measurement input-output data of Gaussian signals. In addition, based on random signals, the parameters of static nonlinear block and noise model are learned by using the recursive extended least square algorithm. Simulation results show that the scheme proposed can effectively learn the time-delay-based Hammerstein state-space system and get high learning accuracy.

articleTitle: Inverse Covariance Intersection Fusion CKF algorithm based on Joint Optimization
abstract: For nonlinear multi-sensor systems with unknown cross-covariances, an inverse covariance intersection fusion Cubature Kalman filtering algorithm based on joint optimization (genetic algorithm and BP network) is proposed. Firstly, each local estimate is obtained through the Cubature Kalman filter (CKF). And then combined with the batch inverse covariance intersection (BICI) fusion algorithm, the BICI-CKF algorithm is proposed, which can effectively solve the fusion estimation problem of nonlinear system with unknown cross-covariances. Finally, in order to obtain the optimal weighting coefficients of the BICI-CKF algorithm, a joint optimization method based on genetic algorithm and BP network is proposed. This method can not only improve the fusion accuracy, but also significantly increase the fusion speed. The simulation example verifies the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Risk Control of Logistics Distribution Service Quality Based on FMEA and Performance Monitoring
abstract: Distribution is an important part of logistics management and of the process of creating value for enterprises and customers. This paper applies an FMEA analysis method to determine the factors that may lead to distribution service failure in the process of logistics distribution from the perspective of enterprise managers to enterprise operation performance monitoring. The entire process of logistics distribution is divided into 5 parts and 10 risk nodes, and 14 failure modes are identified in the distribution link. The possibility, severity, and detectability criteria of these 14 failure modes are then listed to determine the risk priority. Of these, the transport node has the highest risk grade. At the same time, according to the results of the FMEA analysis, combined with the idea of performance management, risk control measures for each risk node are given to improve the quality of logistics distribution service.

articleTitle: Nozzle Temperature Control of Injection Molding Processes Using Model Predictive Control
abstract: In the process of injection molding, controlling the nozzle temperature of an injection molding machine will have a great impact on the quality of plastic products. Therefore, it is of great significance to control the nozzle temperature of an injection molding machine. In this paper, in order to improve the control accuracy and response speed, the model predictive control method is used to control the nozzle temperature of an injection molding machine, and the control result is compared with that of the Smith predictive control method. Both methods are used under the large time delay characteristic of the nozzle temperature of the injection molding machine. When the system model is matched with the actual process, both have good control effects; When the model is mismatched, the model predictive control still has a good control effect.

articleTitle: Identification of Hammerstein CARMA systems with scarce measurements based on PSO and auxiliary model
abstract: This paper investigates the identification of Hammerstein CARMA systems with scarce measurements. The auxiliary model (AM) method is employed to solve the incomplete data problem caused by scarce measurements. And the particle swarm optimization (PSO) is used to estimate the parameters of the Hammerstein CARMA systems. In order to improve the convergence speed and the identification accuracy, some improvement strategies have been applied to the standard PSO algorithm. Then, the auxiliary model-based particle swarm optimization (AM-PSO) identification algorithm is proposed. The simulation results show that the derived AM-PSO algorithm can identify the Hammerstein CARMA systems with scarce measurements effectively.

articleTitle: Resilient flight control for unmanned aerial vehicle based on neural network and disturbance observer
abstract: In this paper, a resilient flight control scheme is proposed for the unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) with system uncertainties, external disturbances, actuator faults and controller gain perturbations. Radial basis function neural network (RBFNN) is employed to tackle actuator faults and system uncertainties. The nonlinear disturbance observer (NDO) is used to estimate the approximation errors of RBFNN and the external disturbances. By using RBFNN and NDO, the resilient flight control scheme is developed for the UAV attitude system based on the command filtered backstepping control method. An optimization method using the linear matrix inequality is studied for the feedback gain matrix design under gain pertubations. Under the resilient flight control scheme, the uniformly ultimate bounded convergence of all closed-loop signals is guaranteed via Lyapunov analysis. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed resilient flight control scheme.

articleTitle: Adaptive Optimal Control for Large-Scale Systems based on Robust Policy Iteration
abstract: In this paper, a robust policy iteration (PI) based adaptive optimal control approach is proposed for large-scale systems. The parametric and dynamic uncertainties are coped with by using the robust adaptive dynamic programming and small-gain theory. Based on the robust policy iteration, the learned control policy is composed of the measurement state and input. The closed-loop stability and the convergence of the proposed algorithms are analyzed by using Lyapunov stability theory and small-gain techniques. A practical example of multimachine power systems with governor controllers is given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Escalator Fault Diagnosis Method Based on SVM and Feature Frequency Extraction
abstract: For the problem of escalator step system faults, this paper proposes a method based on the combination of SVM and fault feature frequency extraction to diagnose the fault. Firstly, the vibration signal is analyzed and processed to extract the characteristics, and the SVM fault detection model is constructed to realize the detection of the fault signal. Then, the wavelet threshold method based on EMD is used to denoise the fault signal, and the method based on the combination of high-frequency matching method and envelope spectrum analysis is used to extract the fault characteristic frequency, and the fault type is determined by the fault characteristic frequency to realize the fault diagnosis. The experimental results show that the method has high accuracy for the fault diagnosis of escalator step system.

articleTitle: Research on Microgravity Measurement Technology of Manned Spacecraft
abstract: In the paper, the requirements of microgravity measurement for space science experiments carried out by the payload of manned spacecraft was analyzed, and the microgravity measurement technical scheme of manned spacecraft was put forward. At last, the microgravity data measured during manned spacecraft in orbit were deeply studied. The research result can provide an important reference for the monitoring and control of microgravity environment of manned spacecraft in China.

articleTitle: Visual tracking method of metal mold combining local directional feature and association matrix
abstract: To solve the problem of positioning the metal mold which contains metals in different states during the casting process, a tracking method combining local directional feature and data association matrix is proposed. Firstly, the local visual directional characteristics of the mold are extracted from multiple mold images. Secondly, the mold template is established from the local directional features, and molds can be positioned through matching. To achieve dynamic tracking of multiple molds, the idea of deepsort is used to build a multi-target detection framework for molds. The association matrix of the mold is obtained by the frames correlation, and the mold ID is marked and tracked according to the association matrix. Finally, the trajectory of the mold is mapped to a three-dimensional space. Experimental results show that the proposed method can be used to detect multiple molds and extract the running trajectory of molds at the same time. The method has advantages in accuracy, reliability and real-time performance, and can provide technical information for the industrial robots.

articleTitle: A Novel Train Operation Simulation System Based on Intelligent Mobile Robot and ROS Communication Network
abstract: With the development of train operation control technology, the safety and reliability of many theories and signal equipment related to train control need to be improved. However, there are safety problems in verifying the safety and reliability of the train control system on the railway, and many human resources and material resources will be wasted. Therefore, a semi-physical train operation control theory simulation verification method based on the intelligent mobile robot is proposed in this paper. Based on the theory of mobile robot technology and autonomous train operation technology, we have established a communication network to simulate the train operation environment and built a complete simulation demonstration test system. The system can verify the autonomous theory and key technologies of single-vehicle and multi-vehicle train control systems. This method has the advantages of saving economic costs and being safer for maintenance. The experimental results show that the average error of train speed control of our system is within 0.33%, and 84.88% of the error of communication-based speed following are distributed between 10<sup>−</sup>4 and 0.5 × 10<sup>−4</sup>, which proves that our system has application prospects in the simulation application of train control system based on wireless communication.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimal Dispatching Strategy for Active Distribution Network Considering Controllable Load and Energy Storage
abstract: In order to achieve the full consumption of renewable energy and the reduction of the peak-valley load in the active distribution network, this paper proposes a multi-objective optimization dispatching strategy for the active distribution network that takes into account the participation of controllable loads and energy storage. A multi-objective optimal dispatch model with the lowest operation cost of the active distribution network and the smallest variance of the load curve is established, and the consumption rate of renewable energy is introduced as a standard for evaluating the consumption capacity. The multi-objective particle swarm algorithm is used to solve and simulate the proposed model on the improved IEEE 33-node system. The simulation results show that the built model can effectively improve the ability of the active distribution network to absorb renewable energy and reduce the load peak-to-valley difference while ensuring the economic operation of the system.

articleTitle: Modeling and optimization of the re-balancing problem with re charging requirements in electric vehicle sharing systems
abstract: With the rapid development of station-based one-way electric-vehicle sharing, the temporal and spatial imbalanced distribution of vehicles resulted from the balance requirements and the charging requirements is becoming increasingly prominent. This study mainly addresses a re-balancing problem of station-based one-way shared electric-cars with re-charging requirements, with the goal of minimizing the total relocation costs, the number of unbalanced vehicles and the number of vehicles with low level of batteries. A 0-1 nonlinear programming model is built. Two valid inequalities are designed to solve the problem. The two valid inequalities are validated and evaluated based on randomly generated instances. Numerical experimental results indicate that the two valid inequalities can provide optimal or near-optimal solutions for large-scaled instances in a short running time.

articleTitle: HEFT-Dynamic Scheduling Algorithm in Workflow Scheduling
abstract: Cloud computing is a solution that can provide remote computing today. It provides users with a high-performance computing resource that can be used at any time. When users are dealing with large tasks, if the task scheduling algorithm is not scientific and reasonable, it will cause unnecessary energy waste in cloud computing. This paper proposes a new scheduling algorithm based on the currently widely used scheduling algorithm HEFT, which aims to save scheduling time in task scheduling. Comparing the optimized algorithm with the benchmark algorithm, the results show that it can also be completed within the deadline, but it can save up to 24% of energy consumption.

articleTitle: Research on bus voltage control strategy of DC side of wind power grid-connected inverter
abstract: In order to improve the anti-disturbance performance of the direct current (DC) bus voltage in wind power grid-connected system, a new double closed-loop structure based on improved linear active disturbance rejection control (LADRC) is proposed. The characteristic of the improved LADRC is that it introduces proportional derivative (PD) control to the gain coefficient of the observation total disturbance signal in the traditional linear extended state observer (LESO). According to the prediction function of differential control, it produces an advanced control effect and improves the disturbance observation ability of LESO. Frequency domain analysis shows that the improved LADRC has better anti-disturbance performance. The improved LADRC is applied to the voltage and current double closed-loop control of wind power grid-connected converter.
