First, an ocean environment is constructed, which includes unknown obstacles based on electronic chart and Automatic Identification System and then the features of obstacles were extracted and rasterized. Meanwhile, a mathematical model of the time-varying current is developed to make the marine environment more realistic and efficient. Subsequently, a capture scheme incorporating improved particle swarm optimization for avoiding unknown obstacles is proposed, and the critical condition and calculation formula for successful capture of the target unmanned surface vehicle under given conditions are given. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed strategy is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Prediction of Ash Deposition on Heating Surfaces of Coal-fired Power Plant Boiler based on Dynamic Neural Network
abstract: Ash fouling has been an important factor to reduce the heat transfer efficiency and safety of the coal-fired power plant boilers. Scientific and accurate prediction of ash fouling of heat transfer surfaces is the basis of formulating reasonable soot blowing strategy to improve energy efficiency. This study presented a comprehensive approach of dynamic prediction of the ash fouling of heat transfer surfaces in coal-fired power plant boilers. At first, the cleanliness factor is used to reflect the fouling level of the heat transfer surfaces. And then, a dynamic model is proposed to predict ash deposits in the coal-fired boilers using combining complete ensemble empirical mode decom-position with adaptive noise (CEEMDAN) and nonlinear autoregressive neural networks (NARNN). Finally, the experimental object is established on the 300MV economizer clearness factor dataset of the power station, and the root mean square error and mean absolute percentage error of the proposed method are the smallest.

articleTitle: Object Recognition in Substation Alarm Area Based on SVM Algorithm
abstract: As a place with extremely high safety protection factor, substations are often damaged. Although the current substations are equipped with various technical defense systems, the lack of correlation between the various systems results in a high rate of false alarms and false alarms. Protecting the safety of substations can be achieved by accurately identifying the attributes of objects in the alarm area, reducing the rate of false alarms and false alarms. Accurately identifying the attributes of objects is of great significance for the safety protection of substations. In response to such problems, this paper proposes a substation alarm area property recognition based on the SVM algorithm, which integrates multiple independent information of video, sound, radar and thermal imaging to obtain multi-dimensional information of the object, and adopts a combination of feature engineering and machine learning technology. The intrusion object recognition classification algorithm realizes the object recognition in the alarm area of the substation. Through experimental analysis, it is verified that the method proposed in this paper can accurately identify the attributes of objects and provide strong support and guarantee for the safety protection of substations..

articleTitle: Research on Synthetic Data Generation and Multi-modal Target Detection
abstract: Target Detection is one of the most important tasks in Computer Vision, which has broad application prospects in many scenes. For the past few years, great progress has been made in this field with the rapid development of deep learning technology. However, it’s still a big challenge at complex scenarios such as dim environment for traditional single-modal visible images. To address this problem, researchers introduce thermal images as additional modal in consideration of that thermal cameras are less susceptible to interference and explore how to fuse the two modalities information effectively. Nevertheless, the lack of large labeled and high-quality visible-thermal datasets hampers the usage of convolutional neural networks for detection. Therefore, we propose to use image-to-image translation model combined with a differentiable data augmentation method to generate fake thermal images from labeled visible images and use multi-modal target detection model to prove the validity of the method. Our experiment results show that our method can provide us a large labeled dataset of synthetic visible-thermal image pairs with better generalization and the introduction of thermal modality can obtain a better performance than single modality.

articleTitle: Cooperative Tracking Control of Multiple Airships
abstract: This paper studies the cooperative tracking control problem for multiple airships with second-order moment processes. A distributed vectorial backstepping design scheme is proposed. A distributed cooperative controller with adjustable parameters is designed to ensure that while all states of the closed-loop system are bounded in probability, the mean-square of the tracking errors between the followers’ output and the leader’s output can be made arbitrarily small. Finally, the effectiveness of the designed control scheme is verified by a simulation example.

articleTitle: A Reference Nodes Selection Optimize Algorithm in Multi Robot System
abstract: Relative positioning is essential for control and coordination of multi-robot systems (MRS). For large-scale MRSs, relative positioning may consume too much computation and communication resources. By selecting a suitable subset of robots in the system as reference nodes (RN), the time difference of arrival (TDOA) algorithm can effectively resolve this problem. However, in a mobile MRS, varying topology may decrease the TDOA positioning accuracy. This paper addresses these challenges by presenting the dynamical RN selecting algorithm (DRS) in the fixed RNs amount situation. This algorithm updates the selection of RNs to maintain the accuracy of positioning when the topology changes. We prove the optimal conditions for RN selection with Cramer-Rao Lower Bound (CRLB) and propose an iterative RN selecting procedure. The simulations indicate that our algorithm can update the selection of RNs to limit the error of TDOA measurement efficiently.

articleTitle: Multi-Crane Scheduling for Steelmaking-Continuous Casting Processes
abstract: This work considers a multi-crane scheduling problem arising from steelmaking-continuous casting processes. By analyzing the optimization objectives and constraints in industrial scenarios, a multi-objective mathematical model is established. A conflict resolution strategy is designed to avoid conflict of multiple cranes. A metaheuristic algorithm based on the framework of Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm-II (NSGA-II) is developed to solve the concerned problem and provide practitioners with Pareto near-optimal solutions. The actual production data are collected as a dataset to test the proposed algorithm. The experimental results show that the concerned problem can be well solved by the proposed algorithm whose performance is much better than that of a greedy-based heuristic algorithm.

articleTitle: ADRC Voltage Control Based on Asymmetric Duty Modulations Strategy for Dual Active Bridge
abstract: In view of the dynamic characteristics and the transmission efficiency problems for dual active bridge (DAB) converters of storage energy in a wide voltage range, an asymmetric duty cycle modulation strategy for the DAB converters of storage energy based on active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) of voltage control is proposed, which significantly improves the transmission efficiency and the dynamic performance in DAB converters of storage energy. Firstly, a principle of asymmetric duty cycle modulation is described, and a linear large signal model is derived with the value of unified transmission power as the control quantity. The parameter setting process is optimized using an asymmetric duty cycle modulation principle, and a corresponding linear active disturbance rejection controller is designed to ensure system performance. Finally, the experiment is verified by simulation platform, simulation results show that the transmission efficiency reaches up to 94.87%, which improves the transmission efficiency of DAB converters of storage energy. At the same time, proposed control has better robustness than traditional PI control, greatly, the problem of too many parameters and difficult values in design of traditional ADRC controller is simplified.

Author Keywords: dual active bridge of storage energy

articleTitle: Data-driven wide-area damping controller design based on improved model-free adaptive control for interconnected power systems
abstract: With the large-scale integration of wind farms into power grids, the problem of inter-area oscillations (IAO) in interconnected power systems may become more serious. However, the original model-based wide-area damping control (WADC) is hard to effectively suppress the IAO mode. In this paper, an improved model-free adaptive control (MFAC) algorithm is proposed to design data-driven WADC for the multiple IAO modes control. The improved MFAC algorithm uses full-form dynamic linearization technique to linearize the power system dynamically and a step-size vector is designed to adjust the pseudo-partial derivative vector and make the algorithm more flexible. Simulations results based on New England ten machine 39-bus system with the integration of wind farms verify that the improved MFAC based WADC can effectively damp multiple IAO modes simultaneously. Compared with the original MFAC algorithm and conventional wide area damping controllers, the step-size vector make the improved MFAC algorithm have better damping performance. And compared with the single IAO mode control, the multiple IAO modes control has superiority on the suppression of low frequency oscillations.

articleTitle: Research on Opinion Mining for Sentiment Classification of Micro-blog Text Based on DeBERTa
abstract: Aiming at the problems that the sentimental information contained in micro-blog text is not fully represented and the sentiment classification is not accurate enough, this paper proposes a sentiment classification model of micro-blog text based on DeBERTa combined with BiGRU network and attention mechanism. Firstly, the text is represented by word vector through the pre-trained language model DeBerta. Then, it is input into BiGRU network to further extract context semantic information, and then through attention mechanism to assign corresponding weights to text features. Finally, the text is classified by the output layer. This paper selects the dataset of "sentiment recognition of netizens during the epidemic" competition held by DataFountain platform in 2020. The experimental results show that sentiment classification effect of the model proposed in this paper is better, which verifies the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: A Large Scale Impact-Time-Control Guidance Law For Salvo Attack
abstract: This paper proposes an impact time guidance law for the implementation of loitering munition’s salvo attack. First, the mass-point dynamics of the loitering munition and the target are established. Then, a circumnavigating guidance law is investigated. In addition, we formulate an online cruise-switching strategy for the loitering munition to achieve salvo attack of multiple loitering munitions. Finally, numerical simulations are conducted to validate the performance of the proposed guidance law in different scenarios.

articleTitle: Decentralized robust control of modular robot manipulators with harmonic drive transmission using RARKF-based joint torque estimation
abstract: This paper presents a decentralized robust control of modular robot manipulators (MRMs) with harmonic drive transmission using redundant adaptive robust extended Kalman filter (RARKF)-based joint torque estimation. The dynamic model of MRMs is formulated via RARKF-based joint torque estimation method. A decentralized robust control is developed to guarantee the trajectory tracking error is uniform ultimate bounded (UUB). The closed-loop robotic system is asymptotic stability on the basis of Lyapunov verification. The experiments are performed to clarify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Robust Model Reference Adaptive Consensus with Neural Networks
abstract: This paper addresses distributed and robust leaderless consensus control for a class of uncertain multiagent systems with matched unknown nonlinearities and disturbances. The problem is challenging due to the lack of a leader (reference signal), the large uncertainties in agent dynamics, and the asymmetric communications among the agents. A novel neural network embedded model reference adaptive consensus (NN-MRACon) framework is proposed, which bridges NN and MRACon by means of nonsmooth control. Asymptotic consensus is proved based on robust analysis and input-to-state stability theory. Numerical examples on networks of second-order integrators and two-mass-spring systems are included to validate the effectiveness of NN-MRACon.

articleTitle: Semantic Segmentation for Point Cloud based on Distance Weighted and Adaptive Augmentation
abstract: Since a scene represented with point clouds usually have richer information compared with 2D image and is capable of achieving an intuitive reflection of the real world, the analysis of original point cloud data has attracted intensive research interests in recent years. Due to the disordered nature of 3D data, perceptually understanding of large-scale 3D data is very challenging, especially for the dense prediction task such as the semantic segmentation. As limited by the computation resources, most existing approaches are only able to deal with small patches that are extracted from a large-scale 3D data, which is still a problem. In this work, we concentrate on the essential visual task, semantic segmentation, for large-scale point cloud data collected in reality. On the one hand, to reduce the ambiguity in nearby points, we augment their local context by features and spatial distance mutually weighted. On the other hand, to reduce the loss of information during the aggregation of neighborhood features, we introduce an attention mechanism to adaptively enhance local features. Further, we perform semantic segmentation on benchmarks S3DIS and our method has achieved outstanding performance.

articleTitle: A Unified Stabilization Control of Nonholonomic Systems With or Without State Constraints
abstract: In this paper, we present a control scheme for nonholonomic systems with or without state constraints in a unified manner. A tan-type barrier Lyapunov function is considered to address time-varying constrains for the x0-subsystem. By introducing a new nonlinear state-dependent function that purely depends on constrained states to deal with asymmetric time-varying state constraints for the x-subsystem. A coordinate transformation are constructed to convert the original state-constrained space into a free space. We design a dynamic surface control based backstepping design, removing the demanding feasibility conditions on virtual controllers. As a result, cumbersome off-line calculations are not required for feasibility verification, enabling designers to choose design parameters more freely and leading to the system to handle a wider range of initial conditions.

articleTitle: Top-Down Meets Bottom-Up for Multi-Person Pose Estimation
abstract: Body posture, as a basic feature of humans, occupies an important position in human-computer interaction and other fields. In order to accurately recognize human body posture features and eliminate misrecognition caused by different human movements. This paper proposes a human body posture detection method that combines top-down and bottom-up two-way. This method divides the input image into two forks, and uses the Mask R-CNN model to extract key point features and human target location features. The key point recognition feature map is divided into two, and using CNN to extract Part Affinity Fields and Part Confidence Maps. The obtained confidence map is added with the human body position feature map. Then use PAFs to segment the key points of different individuals in the result. Finally, the Hungarian Algorithm is used to process the maximum matching of the bipartite graph to obtain the human body posture detection result. Experimental results show that this method can accurately recognize human posture. It has good performance on different data sets and eliminates the estimation accuracy defects of traditional models due to the complex high-dimensional motion of the target.

articleTitle: Study on Route Optimization of Shenyang subway Network Base on Improved Ant Colony Algorithm
abstract: Shenyang underground route planning algorithm is the shortest route planning algorithm based on ant colony algorithm (ACA). ACA has a leading position in routing and route planning with a great space for development. In view of the defects of long random search time, premature stagnation in the basic ACA, in order to facilitate the subsequent improvement of route planning in other provinces and cities, we adjusted the ACA adaptively. Route planning algorithm has stronger adaptability and machinability after adjusted. This improved ACA include three planning programming: point to point, point to plane, and Planar programming. It add the speed and accuracy of planning and reduce The calculation amount of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Adaptive temperature tracking control of microwave heating high titanium slag based on ε-ADP
abstract: A data-driven model-based microwave heating adaptive dynamic planning temperature tracking algorithm is proposed for the microwave heating process with time-varying nonlinearity and strong coupling. The microwave heating process is modeled using a single hidden-layer feedforward network and the discrimination capability of an extreme learning machine. Based on this, the performance index functions and control laws are approximated using the approximation capability of the single hidden layer feedforward network and the extreme learning machine. Experimental and simulation results show that the proposed algorithm successfully tracks the temperature of high titanium slag during the microwave heating process.

articleTitle: Graph Convolution Network for Road Detection with Lidar
abstract: Road detection is an important task in environment perception of intelligent driving. The road detection method is usually affected by many aspects, such as the occlusion of road vehicles and pedestrians, the change of illumination, etc. It is noting that lidar is insensitive to light and perceive the 3D environment information around the vehicle well during the day and night. So lidar road detection is suitable for intelligent driving scenarios. In this work, a Graph Convolution Network, named GCN RoadNet, is proposed for road detection using lidar point cloud, which discriminates on-road points from off-road points. Graph convolution network focuses more on local connections of point cloud points than global ones, therefore it achieves better accuracy than PointNet. Experiments on the KITTI dataset validate the robustness and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Fault Detection for Enclosed Board with Autocorrelation Analysis
abstract: The board of control system is a key for accuracy of data acquisition. It is a challenge to judge the status of with tunnels of board because the board is always working on an enclosed way in order to safety and reliability which leads to their inner states be unmeasurable directly. In this paper a novel approach is proposed to detect the status of board by only using external time series information. The data series are analyzed by autocorrelation theory and the shape comparison is employed to the target sequence. Then the fault of the enclosed board channel is diagnosed according to the data autocorrelation characteristics. The simulation shows the proposed approach is effective.

articleTitle: A Novel MLCNN for Aircraft Target Classification in Optical Remote Sensing Images with Small Samples
abstract: In this paper, the use of deep learning method for optical remote sensing image classification of aircraft targets is studied. Deep neural networks show great power in the field of image processing and analysis mainly by using a very large number of training samples. However, sufficient samples cannot be obtained in the field of many image analysis fields including optical remote sensing image classification. Image classification based on small samples as a research direction in the field of image analysis has become one of the research hotspots. In this paper, a novel multi-layer convolutional neural network (MLCNN) is proposed for optical remote sensing image classification of aircraft targets with small samples. The MLCNN has only 3 convolutional layers, which shows more effective for image classification with small samples. In the experiment, transfer learning is first performed on the Alexnet network to achieve image classification tasks, then, the MLCNN is executed. And different numbers of samples from OPT-Aircraft _v1.0 are used to test the performance of Alexnet network and the proposed network. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed MLCNN achieves higher classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Text Sentiment Analysis Based on Similarity and Cloud Model
abstract: Text sentiment analysis is an important research topic in natural language processing field. There are many problems in existing research methods due to semantic incoherence and independent topics. To address these problems, a comprehensive rating model is proposed in this paper for text sentiment analysis. It integrates topic similarity with cloud model theories. Firstly, LDA model is adopted to extract topic features. A sentiment revision algorithm based on cloud model is proposed to optimize the word sentiment polarities. Secondly, cosine similarity theory is introduced to measure the potential correlation of topics. Then, aspect segmentation algorithm is performed to obtain feature matrix and feature weight of reviews. Finally, feature parameters are optimized and the feature ratings of the reviews are concluded on the basis of above results.

articleTitle: Application and optimization of the UCT algorithm in Einstein würfelt nicht!
abstract: Based on the characteristics of Einstein würfelt nicht!(EWN), this paper puts forward the UCT algorithm applied to EWN, and on its basis, an optimized UCT algorithm with the evaluation function and the dynamic searching rounds is proposed. The evaluation function is used to better evaluate the situation, and the dynamic searching rounds is used to reduce the average cost per game by a decay function. By playing multiple games with the UCT algorithm, the optimized UCT algorithm proved to be effective in improving the strength of the EWN game system.

articleTitle: Differential Wheel Robot Prescribed Time Positioning Control
abstract: This study focuses on the prescribed time positioning control of a differential wheeled robot (DWR). First, a time gain function with switching characteristics is given, and it is applied to the positioning control law of the robot to ensure that the robot reaches a stable state within the prescribed time when the state variables are bounded. In addition, a Gaussian function with orientation error as input is introduced into the positioning control law to make the robot reach the target point more stably. Finally, Matlab simulations show that the proposed control strategy can effectively make the mobile robot reach the designated place at the predetermined time.

articleTitle: An Integrated Model for Predicting Free Lime Content Based on Different Working Conditions
abstract: The quality of cement clinker depends strongly on free lime (f-CaO) content. To overcome the problem associated with time delay exists in the manual determination of f-CaO content. We present an integrated support vector machine (ISVM) model for f-CaO soft sensing based on different working conditions in this paper. The data from a cement plant is first pre-processed, and then the data is classified into three types based on the condition of different cement calcination for training the SVM classification model and the SVM regression model of each category. Finally, the suggested integrated model's advantage is verified by comparing it to the single SVM regression model without differentiation of operating conditions, and tests showed that the Integrated models have better prediction accuracy and generalization ability. The model in this paper provides technical assistance in the improvement of cement clinker quality and energy saving.

articleTitle: Robust Adaptive Trajectory Tracking Control for Robot Manipulator With Friction Disturbances
abstract: A robust adaptive trajectory tracking control strategy is proposed in this paper for the trajectory tracking problem of the robot manipulator with friction disturbances. Firstly, a robot manipulator trajectory controller with a friction model is designed using the backstepping method, and a first-order filter is applied to deal with the complex derivation problem of the virtual control input. Then, a disturbance observer is designed to estimate the external time-varying disturbances online. We use an adaptive law to update the parameters of the observer. The Lyapunov theory proved the closed-loop system to be semi-globally asymptotically stable. The simulation results show that the robot manipulator can overcome the external disturbances well and track the trajectory quickly and accurately. The control scheme effectively improves the tracking accuracy of the system.

articleTitle: Sub-fixed-time control of an unmanned surface vehicle based on backstepping method
abstract: In this paper, the concept "sub-fixed-time stability" (SFTS) proposed in 2020 for a simple second order system for the first time, is researched and applied to design controllers for an underactuated unmanned surface vehicle (USV), which is the system with fewer independent actuators than degrees of freedom. Different from the "sub-fixed-time control" (SFTC) method proposed in 2020, which is based on Lyapunov equation, in this paper, we design SFTC based on the well-known backstepping method. The new SFTC method is simpler and clearer, and the constrained conditions of parameters have fewer constraints. Moreover, two terms with power exponents which are less than one have been added in the control laws to further improve the control performance. The effectiveness of the proposed SFCT and the additional terms is demonstrated and validated by comparison simulation.

articleTitle: Multi-type and Multi-level Feature Fusion Network for RGBD Indoor Semantic Segmentation
abstract: RGBD images, which refer to the three-channel color images augmented with depth channel, have been greatly exploited to improve the performance of scene semantic segmentation. RGBD semantic segmentation task is of great significance to help the development of robot navigation and grasping. However, most existing methods addressing RGBD semantic segmentation lack effective feature fusion modules. To address the aforementioned problem, we propose a novel network with two novel modules for feature fusion, namely Channel-Attention based Complementary Feature Fusion Module (CAC-FFM) and Cross-Layer Feature Fusion Module (CL-FFM). Specifically, CAC-FFM, which is essentially based on the channel-attention mechanism, effectively utilizes the complementary information of RGB and depth to generate fusion features, and CL-FFM captures patch-wise features from low-level feature maps to assist the training of high-level features so as to further optimize the segmentation results. Experimental results on the publicly available NYUDv2 dataset validate the effectiveness and superiority of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Classification of Haematococcus pluvialis cells based on Bayesian Classifier
abstract: Haematococcus pluvialis is known as the "natural producer" of astaxanthin, and its culture stage is mainly divided into cell proliferation stage and astaxanthin accumulation stage. Because Haematococcus pluvialis cells at different stages exhibit different characteristics in terms of color and cell radius, this paper proposes a cell image division method fused with a naive Bayes classifier to solve this problem. Perform feature extraction and calculate the number of pixels in each gray level of the image to obtain the gray histogram, and then use the Bayesian algorithm to train the model for classification. Experimental results show that the classification accuracy rate can reach about 84%, and the recall rate can reach about 89%. The model trained by Bayesian algorithm can effectively solve the problem of Haematococcus pluvialis cell image classification, and provides an objective means for scientific research and management personnel to study Haematococcus pluvialis.

articleTitle: Linear active disturbance rejection tracking control for industrial manipulator with disturbance and time delay
abstract: In this paper, a linear active disturbance rejection controller (LADRC) is designed for the tracking control problem of industrial manipulator with uncertain factors, such as disturbance and time delay. Firstly, the discrete system model of industrial manipulator with disturbance and network induced delay is established by discretization analysis method, and then the disturbance and network induced delay uncertainties in the model are defined as a new extended state. Secondly, a linear extended state observer (LESO) is designed to estimate the system uncertain factors in time. Then, by using the estimated values, a linear state error feedback control law with feedforward compensation for uncertainties is designed to suppress the effect of disturbance and time delay for control performance, and to ensure that the system tracking errors can converge to zero stably. Finally, Comparative simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: Event-Triggered Neural Adaptive Control for a Switched Model of Hypersonic Flight Vehicle
abstract: In this paper, the event-triggered neural adaptive control for the hypersonic flight vehicle (HFV) with a switched model is investigated. The switched model uncertainty is handled utilizing the neural networks (NNs) control. Using the event-triggered mechanism, drastic changes of control signal caused by the switched model are avoided. To avoid the ‘explosion of complexity’ and get the fast-tracking performance, the command filter is employed to construct the backstepping control framework. Comparative simulations illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Wind power interval prediction based on GRU-LUBE

authors.preferredName: Yucong Huang Haotian Li Zhen Fan

abstract: In wind power interval prediction, the performances of prediction model are usually evaluated in terms of reliability and accuracy, which can be quantified by PI coverage probability (PICP) and Mean prediction interval width (MPIW). The ideal high quality prediction interval should have high coverage probability and narrow interval width, which are contradictory to each other. In this case, the method of weight coefficient is proposed to balance the two indexes. At the same time, in the prediction model GRU-LUBE (GRU, gate recurrent unit; LUBE, lower upper bound estimation), in order to reduce the deviation at the peak of the predicted power, this paper proposes a piecewise function of prediction interval accumulative deviation (PIAD) and lets it construct the optimized objective function together with the weight coefficient. Then, sigmoid function is adopted to make the objective function compatible with gradient descent method. Finally, the simulation results show the superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Novel Anomaly Detection Algorithm Based on OCSVM for Lower Limb Exoskeleton System
abstract: This paper presents a novel anomaly detection algorithm for lower limb exoskeleton system, which based on the gait characteristics of human walking on a Hat ground. This algorithm is suitable for lower limb exoskeleton system which can obtain the angles of hip, knee and ankle in real time. Previous studies have shown that the traditional balance evaluation methods such as zero moment point (ZMP), center of press (COP) and base of support (BOS) are difficult to solve and rely on accurate plantar pressure sensors. Therefore, through the analysis of the characteristics of human body stability, this paper uses the position relationship between the center line of feet (CLOF) and center of mass (COM) as the evaluation index of human body balance. To verify the correctness of this index, the forward, backward, left and right lateral abnormal data of human body are collected by inertial navigation, and the algorithm is used to train the anomaly classifier. Finally, through the test of normal sample and abnormal sample data, the classification accuracy is 99.821% and 99.297% respectively. In the next step, the algorithm will be used to control the balance recovery of the lower limb exoskeleton system.

articleTitle: Finite-time tracking control method for unmanned vehicle with external disturbance
abstract: In this paper, a finite-time tracking control scheme is proposed for unmanned vehicles. Considering the nonlinear effect of tires on vehicle models, the controller is designed to maintain the stability of unmanned vehicle trajectory tracking system. For the nominal system, a finite time control method is designed to make the unmanned vehicle track to the ideal trajectory; for the system with external disturbance, a combination of sliding mode control and finite-time tracking control is used to ensure that the tracking error converges to zero. The simulation results show that the vehicle stability control strategy based on this method has better tracking performance.

articleTitle: PI Tuning and Optimization for Speed Control of PMSM Based on Multivariable Sliding-Mode Extremum Seeking
abstract: The PI controller is the most basic and widely used for the permanent magnet synchronous motor speed control. The cumbersome parameter adjustment process makes it difficult for the PI controller to balance convenience and performance. To this end, this paper presents a new PI tuning and optimization scheme based on multivariable sliding-mode extremum seeking. Firstly, by analyzing the frequency domain model of permanent magnet synchronous motor, the analytical calculation formulas of controller parameters and motor parameters are derived as the initial value of PI parameter optimization. Then, a multivariable sliding-mode extremum seeking optimizer is designed to optimize the control parameters by minimizing the cost function based on the feedback error term. The feasibility of the above scheme is proved by theoretical derivation, and the simulation and experimental results also verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Integration Time Method Based on Adaptive Control
abstract: In the process of spaceborne detector tracking the sun based on image, the intensity of solar light changes due to the change of relative position, and the solar image changes sharply in light and dark. In order to ensure the tracking accuracy, it is necessary to change the Integration Time to make the image quality stable. How to control the Integration Time in real time and adaptively is the key to solve the problem. In this paper, a control method of Integration Time based on image quality evaluation is proposed. This method takes image grayscale value distribution as reference variable, combines adaptive control with image quality evaluation method. The problem of adaptive control of imaging Integration Time under sudden change of light intensity is solved, and the adaptive control of daily imaging Integration Time is realized.

articleTitle: Application Analysis of AI Technology in Tax Collection and Administration in China
abstract: By reviewing the development course of Artificial Intelligence and tax collection and management in China, this paper analyzes the exploration and application of AI technology in tax declaration, evaluation, inspection and other links. The purpose of this study is to improve the information level of tax collection and management, and simplify the collection and management procedures. Based on AI intelligent technology theories and tax principles, this paper mainly discusses the efficiency of tax management. Our research not only shows that AI intelligent technology can make the complicated tax management work more efficient, but also enhance the service awareness of tax departments. While promoting the establishment of modern financial system, AI technology also face many challenges.

articleTitle: Research on UWB Indoor Location Approach in Interference Environment
abstract: Indoor ultra-wideband (UWB) positioning often faces various interferences. For the type of non-line-of-sight error (NLOS) problem where some sensors are blocked, an indoor three-dimensional positioning approach T-T algorithm based on measured distance is proposed. Through the accurate distance measured by three sensors, the target position can be calculated and the accuracy of the algorithm is within a reasonable range. Moreover, the proposed method can be applied to other scenarios.

articleTitle: Template Matching Algorithm Based on New Particle Swarm Optimization
abstract: A new image matching algorithm based on particle swarm optimization (PSO) is proposed to solve the problems of falling into local optimum, slow search speed and low matching accuracy in the process of image matching. Firstly, the particle swarm optimization algorithm is optimized with improved nonlinear inertial weight to balance the global and local searching ability of particles. Secondly, the adaptive learning factor is improved to further enhance the local search ability, so that the particle swarm can obtain better search ability at different stages, and avoid the particle velocity stagnation to zero in the later stage of the algorithm and fall into the local optimal. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm improves the global searching ability and convergence accuracy of particles, and effectively prevents premature convergence. Compared with the PSO image matching algorithm based on standard, the proposed algorithm has the characteristics of fast convergence, good robustness and high matching accuracy.

articleTitle: A Trajectory Planning Method in Three-Dimension for Unmanned Parafoil Based on Compound Optimization RRT
abstract: Aiming at the trajectory planning problem of unmanned parafoil in special environment, a three-dimension (3D) trajectory planning method algorithm is proposed based on the compound optimization rapidly exploring random tree (CO-RRT) in hilly areas airdrop task. Firstly, the particle model of parafoil and 3D simulation model of hilly areas are established. Meanwhile, the constraints of flight performance and obstacle avoidance rules are defined. Then, the trajectory planning method of CO-RRT algorithm is proposed by introducing the optimization strategy of sampling extension and movement smoothness to the conventional RRT. Finally, the simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can not only ensure the flight feasibility, but also enhance the smoothness and the operability of the trajectory.

articleTitle: Design of high precision scanning control system based on flexible pivot support
abstract: In this paper, a scanning mirror control system supported by flexible pivot is introduced. The control system uses voice coil motor as driving element and photoelectric code plate as measuring element. This is the first time such a mechanical structure has been used in space optical detection. Firstly, due to the flexible pivot support, the Angle measurement error of the photoelectric encoder will increase with the scanning mirror deviate from the center position, so the Angle measurement should be corrected before being used as the feedback signal of the control system. Secondly, a compound control algorithm is proposed for scanning control system, which is composed of velocity feedback and position feedback and feedforward control. The dynamic scanning accuracy is ±4 arc second and the velocity nonlinearity is 0.4% by using the laser gyroscope measuring device. The experimental results show that the control algorithm can greatly improve the control accuracy and speed stability of the system, which lays a foundation for high-resolution spatial optical detection.

articleTitle: Adaptive Multi-dimensional Taylor Network Control for Stochastic Nonlinear Systems with Full State Constraints and Dead-zone Input
abstract: In this paper, the stochastic nonlinear systems with full state constraints and dead-zone input are considered in the same framework for the first time, and a new adaptive controller based on MTN is designed. Firstly, for the dead-zone input constraint problem, the characteristic function is introduced to avoid the nonlinearity of the dead-zone. Secondly, in the process of adaptive control design, MTN technology is employed to approximate the nonlinear structure generated in backstepping, and a simple controller is designed. By constructing the barrier Lyapunov functions (BLFs) to deal with the full state constraint problem, the proposed scheme ensures that all states of the closed-loop system do not exceed the constraint limit. Then, Lyapunov stability theory is used to analyze the stability. Finally, two simulation examples are given to illustrate the effectiveness and applicability of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Analysis on blow-up time of parabolic equation system with nonlinear boundary conditions
abstract: The paper deals with blow-up phenomena for the following parabolic equations with nonlocal source and nonlinear boundary conditions. By using Sobolev inequality and some first-order differential inequalities and constructing auxiliary functions, the global existence of the solution and the upper and lower bounds of blow-up solutions of equations are obtained. Finally, two examples are given to illustrate the main results of this paper.

articleTitle: Cascaded fault model of power grid with active defense strategy
abstract: With the rapid development of power system, its potential hazards are also increasing. Paying attention to grid cascading faults and building a robust smart grid have become a hot topic in current research. Based on the complex network theory system and the existing electrical betweenness model, a cascading failure model with active defense strategy has been proposed and its robustness has been analyzed. When the node is attacked and fails, the distribution principle of "the capable nodes are always busy" is adopted to distribute the failure load. That is, the larger the residual load capacity of adjacent nodes, the more load will be distributed. An active defense strategy has been proposed to artificially remove a small number of nodes with a large "removal ratio", reduce the electrical betweenness of other nodes, and prevent the propagation of cascading faults and power grid collapse. Through IEEE118 and IEEE300 power grid system simulation, the effects of key factors such as attack mode, allocation strategy and tolerance parameters on network robustness have been studied. The experimental simulation shows that the power grid cascade failure model with active defense strategy can better inhibit the further spread of power grid cascade faults.

articleTitle: Research on Field Weakening Control of PMSM Based on Improved Single Current Regulator
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low field weakening control efficiency and poor dynamic response performance of a permanent magnet synchronous motor fixed quadrature axis voltage single current regulator, this paper proposes a permanent magnet synchronous motor field weakening control based on an improved single current regulator. Through the combination of variable quadrature axis voltage field weakening control and predictive control, the efficiency and dynamic response speed of the motor during field weakening are improved. Through MATLAB simulation and experiments, it is shown that the control method proposed in this paper can improve the efficiency and dynamic response speed of permanent magnet synchronous motor during field weakening and optimize the robustness. This method provides a reference for the field weakening control of the permanent magnet synchronous machine.

articleTitle: Variable Universe Fuzzy Control of Synchronization Error Compensation for Networked Multi-Motor System
abstract: Networked multi-motor synchronous control system has been widely used in industry for its good flexibility and extensibility. Aiming at the synchronization control problem of networked multi-motor system, an improved compensation control strategy of synchronization error of deviation coupling based on variable universe fuzzy control is proposed to reduce the synchronization error during start-stop and disturbance. In this paper, the synchronization error and compensation control strategy of synchronization error of multi-motor system are analyzed. The improved compensation control strategy of synchronization error of deviation coupling includes two aspects. Firstly, on the basis of the traditional structure, error factor is added to improve the coupling between the motors. Secondly, variable universe fuzzy PD control is used as synchronization error compensation algorithm to realize dynamic synchronization error compensation. Finally, the simulation model of networked three-motor deviation coupling synchronous control system is established using TrueTime toolbox. The results show that the improved compensation control strategy of synchronization error of deviation coupling can obviously improve the synchronization performance of the system.

articleTitle: Path Tracking Control of Unmanned Vehicle Based on Adaptive Steering Angle Constraint
abstract: The research and application of nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) in the path tracking of unmanned vehicles are gradually increasing. However, the consideration of the relationship between the constrained values of steering angle and the vehicle speed on the handling stability and ride comfort is insufficient in the current research of path tracking control. In order to improve the applicability of NMPC in path tracking, this paper analyzes the constrained values of steering angle and vehicle speed on handling stability and tracking error in lane change scenario with traditional NMPC algorithm, and then fuzzy control is used to divide the maximum steering angle of front wheel at different speeds which can improve the tracking performance of traditional NMPC controller. Finally, the handling stability and tracking performance in path tracking are simulated and verified. The simulation results show that the improved NMPC controller can achieve the tracking control of vehicles at different speeds on the premise of ensuring ride comfort and tracking accuracy.

articleTitle: State Feedback-Based Load Frequency Control of Multi-Area Power System Under Hybrid Attacks
abstract: This paper aims at solving the control problem of multi-area load frequency control (LFC) systems in the presence of periodic denial-of-service (DoS) and false data injection (FDI) attacks. The injected FDI attack signal is generated by an external dynamic systems. A switching impulsive observer is constructed to estimate the unknown FDI attack signal. Moreover, a new exponential stability criteria of the state feedback multi-area LFC systems under periodic DoS and FDI attacks is first derived by using attack parameter dependent time varying Lyapunov function method. Then, a co-design method of a resilient attack compensation controller and attack observer is developed. Finally, a numerical example is given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed theoretical results.

articleTitle: Research on Dual-Loop Redundancy Control Method on Turbofan Engines
abstract: Comparing to traditional turbofan engines, new configuration engines with variable area fan nozzle (VAFN) have an additional control variable, making it a redundancy control. This paper studies the influence of the VAFN area, which is a redundant control variable, on the performance of the fan and the engine. Specifically, a controller including two variable control loops is designed for redundantly-controlled engines. An activation logic is designed for the redundant variable control loop, so that the redundant loop can be switched into control when necessary to improve the performance of the fan and the engine. After meeting the control goal, the control is deactivated and switched off, saving power consumption in the control process. Perform the same acceleration process on the same engine. The simulation show that, comparing to traditional single-variable control, Redundant control can significantly improve the performance of the fan and the engine, in which the fan efficiency is about 10% higher, the reserved surge margin is 15% lower, and the distribution of circle work between core and bypass duct is more reasonable. The fuel consumption of the engine is reduced by 3.7%, and the thrust and specific thrust are respectively higher by about 10% and 20%.

articleTitle: Sliding-Mode Control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on New Reaching Law
abstract: In order to improve the speed control performance of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) and enhance the anti-interference ability of the system, a new power reaching law (NPRL) is proposed. Based on the power reaching law (PRL), the system state variable term is added, and the saturation function of variable boundary layer is used to replace the original switching function to suppress the inherent chattering phenomenon of sliding-mode control. Afterwards, the PMSM speed controller is designed based on the NPRL, and the stability analysis is validated by the Lyapunov function. Finally, the simulation and experimental results show that compared with PI, NPRL can effectively improve the dynamic performance and robustness of PMSM speed regulation system.

articleTitle: Research on Data Acquisition System of Pipeline Snake Robot
abstract: The number of underground pipelines is increasing, and their unique transport methods provide convenience and reduce costs. However, many pipelines are buried deep underground and are damaged by the oxidation of underground air or erosion of chemical substances, which affects their normal transportation.In order to regularly detect and clean the inside of pipelines, this paper proposes a study of a data acquisition system based on pipeline snake robots. The overall framework of the serpentine data acquisition system is proposed, including the control communication and sensing acquisition parts. The CAN bus is used as the control communication bus, and the master-slave distributed control can transmit the information from the upper computer to the master controller in real time, while the slave controller can use its own sensing (sensors) to collect the surrounding information and its own state and transmit it upward to the master controller. The upper computer uses Configuration King to develop the interface and display the information transmitted back from the controller in real time. The system is stable and reliable in the actual field test, and has great application value.

articleTitle: Application of Evaluation Index of Cascade Control System Based on Improved Covariance in Superheated Steam Temperature System of Thermal Power Plant
abstract: The correlation between variables is only considered in covariance analysis when used as an evaluation indicator, and the limitation of the performance requirements of the variables is not emphasized. An improved covariance evaluation index combining the covariance of the master and secondary variables with the variance of the master variable is proposed in this paper. The characteristics of cascade control are also emphasized while considering the correlation between variables. The evaluation of cascade control systems with similar control quality can be completed, which improves the effectiveness of index evaluation.

articleTitle: Temporal Enhance and Spatial Gated Network for Group Activity Recognition
abstract: The main goal of Group Activity Recognition(GAR) is to analyze the group behavior in a multi-actors scene. It is a challenging task that integrates group activity features from individual actors who frequently interact with each other. However, existing state-of-the-art methods do not consider temporal information and take full advantage of spatial relations. Moreover, existing methods utilize max-pooling operation to generate group activity features, which introduces noise into group activity features and leads to bad performance. To tackle these problems, a temporal enhance and spatial gated network is proposed. To fully utilize the rich temporal features and spatial features, two branches are set up to extract temporal features and actor interactive relations, respectively. Then, a feature aggregation module is used to generate group activity features, which can decrease the noise introduced by the max-pooling operation. We conduct a series of experiments on two stand datasets. Experimental results on these benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves state-of-the-art performance. Compared with previous work, the recognition accuracy increases by 0.5%~1.0%.

articleTitle: Non-contact Monitoring Of Ambulatory Blood Pressure Based On Webcam
abstract: Measurements of ambulatory blood pressure can provide a vital physiological assessment. However, attempts so far are contact and non-automated, susceptible to external factors and typically expensive. In this paper, a non-contact method of measuring ambulatory blood pressure is presented. This approach allows for efficient pulse rate acquisition directly from face image captured from webcam and is based on imaging PhotoPlethysmoGraphic. In essence, given the two pulse signals, the phase difference and the heart rate can be obtained. The desired signal was acquired by the functional relationship between phase difference, heart rate, and blood pressure. The proposed algorithm is thoroughly assessed on a dataset containing 249 videos. Using Bland-Altman for correlation analysis, we compared blood pressure extracted from video recorded by a basic webcam with the sphygmomanometer and achieved high accuracy and correlation. Furthermore, the proposed technique can measure more than one person at a time and may have a great value in monitoring a person at home.

articleTitle: Soft-sensing Model of SAG Mill Based on PSPCAW-SVM
abstract: By analyzing the soft-sensing modeling process of SAG based on support vector machine, the problem mainly involves the selection of auxiliary variables and data processing in soft-sensing modeling. In this paper, the correlation coefficient method is used to analyze the correlation between the dominant variable and the auxiliary variable, and the auxiliary variable with high correlation is selected. The phase space of the signal related to the load of SAG is reconstructed, and the selection dimension of the auxiliary variables is preliminarily determined, and the principal component analysis technology is used to fuse some auxiliary variables to prevent information redundancy. Then it combines the three techniques to construct an improved PSPCA algorithm for screening auxiliary variables, and determines the auxiliary variables of the soft-sensing model, and wavelet denoising filtering is performed on the data sample of the determined auxiliary variables to remove the noise in the original data. Finally, PSPCAW-SVM soft-sensing model is established to lay the foundation for further research.

articleTitle: Fusion VIO: An Extendable Sensor Fusion Framework for Unmaned Vehicles
abstract: Real-time perception based on the simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) technology is of immense application potential in the industry filed. In this work, we provide an extended Kalman filter (EKF) based visual SLAM framework named Fusion VIO, which contains HDR imaging system, hardware synchronization, object detection, filter based sensor fusion, and semantic fusion. Notably, Fusion VIO well fuses loop closure information, which takes effects in solving the error problem during operation of the robot and improving the robustness of the system. Besides, experimental validation shows that Fusion VIO not only maintains high accuracy but also cost one-third resources compared to the common VINS fusion. Our work demonstrates a novel sensor fusion framework for unmaned vehicles.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Optimal Controller Design for Maglev Train: Q-Learning Method
abstract: The maglev train is an open-loop and unstable complex nonlinear system. Generally, design of offline controllers based on a single operating state. However, the system of maglev train will influence by various complex factors in actual operation. When the system model changes, the controller is designed and tuned offline will suffer severe performance degradation that will affect the system’s stability. This paper proposes a Data-Ddriven Optimal Controller (DDOC) based on the Q-learning theory in reinforcement learning in response to this problem. The controller does not need to know the model information of the controlled object, only calculates iteratively based on the system’s real-time input, output data, which has the advantages of fewer tuning parameters and fast convergence speed. For the problem that system model change during operation, the method proposed in this paper makes the system accurately track the given reference signal by dynamically and rapidly changing the parameters of feedback gain matrix through the real-time data of the system, thus ensuring the stability and reliability of the control system.

articleTitle: Integrated Production Scheduling for Hot Rolling and Delivery with Time Windows
abstract: Hot rolling is the last process of steel-making production, where the slabs are rolled into designated specifications according to the requirements of variant customer orders. The scheduling problem of hot rolling is complicated due to the diversified and strict production constraints. As the follow-up stage of the hot rolling, transportation of final products determines the delivery time of each order. Although the two stages are closely related, each one may be optimized separately in the traditional scheduling methods, the unified optimization cannot be achieved. In this paper, a mathematical model is proposed to formulate the problem of integrated production for both hot rolling and delivery stages. And a dynamic programming algorithm with tabu search is proposed to solve the problem in the single rolling mill production environment. At last, the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by comparing with MV heuristic algorithm in different scales of computational experiments.

articleTitle: An image defogging enhancement algorithm combining dark channel and haze-line prior
abstract: Affected by dust and haze weather, outdoor images will appear distortion and fuzzy to a certain extent. Aiming at the characteristics of dark channel prior and haze-line prior, an improved fog removal method combining the two methods is proposed, which can effectively restore the fogging image of the sky region. Firstly, the image is divided into sky region and non-sky region by threshold segmentation, and the airlight value is estimated by introducing brightness and gradient information into the image. Secondly, dark channel prior model and haze-line prior model are used to estimate the transmission of foreground region and sky region respectively, then gamma correction and guided filtering are used to optimize the transmission map of the whole image. Finally, combined with the hazy image formation model, the restored image is obtained by inverse operation. Then the brightness compensation and contrast stretch correction are used to restore the brightness and contrast of the image, and the final defogging image is obtained. Experimental results show that this algorithm can effectively solve the image distortion, improve the contrast and sharpness, so as to get a higher quality image.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Identification and Control of the Hammerstein System with Application to pH Neutralization Process
abstract: This paper deals with the nonlinear identification modeling and control based on the Hammerstein structure for the pH neutralization process. The Hammerstein structure is composed of a static nonlinear part approximated by Gaussian basis function-based neural network and a dynamical linear part modeled by transfer function, and the parameters separation identification of the Hammerstein system is realized by using the characteristics that the binary signal does not excite the static nonlinear system. As a consequence, the linear part parameter are identified according to least square method. Furthermore, the parameters of Gaussian basis function based feedforward neural network are learned using gradient descent method and error back propagation with the help of measurable random signals. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed Hammerstein structure can effectively represent the pH neutralization process, and the proposed algorithm can acquire good tracking performance.

articleTitle: Fixed-time Cooperative Path Following of Multiple USVs Based on Event-triggered Communication
abstract: In this paper, an event-triggered communication based fixed-time cooperative path following algorithm is proposed for multiple unmanned surface vessels(USVs). Firstly, the structure of the control system is presented. By modularization design, the cooperative path following problem of multiple USVs is transformed into two problems, i.e. the fixed-time parameter coordination problem and the fixed-time trajectory tracking problem. After that, the fixed-time parameter coordination algorithm and the fixed-time trajectory tracking algorithm are proposed. The function of the parameter coordination algorithm is to coordinate parameters of USVs on the expected path, so as to calculate an ideal position for each USV. The function of trajectory tracking algorithm is to make USVs tracking the ideal position generated by the parameter coordination algorithm in real time. The algorithm of each module can guarantee fixed-time convergence, so the whole system can realize fixed-time convergence. In order to reduce the communication burden, the event-triggered communication strategy is adopted for the parameter coordination module. Sufficient conditions for realizing the control objective are given. Effectiveness of the proposed results is confirmed by simulation.

articleTitle: RBFNN-based event-triggered MFAC for discrete-time nonlinear systems with disturbances and data quantization
abstract: This parper concentrates on neural network-based event-triggered MFAC for discrete-time nonlinear systems with disturbances and data quantization. First, the logarithmic quantizer is adopted to quantify the input signal. By uti-lizing the radial basis function neural network, an estimation method is presented to estimate the unknown pseudopartial derivative and disturbances. To reduce the influence of disturbances, an improved control law is built on the estimated disturbances. By using the tracking error and the estimated disturbance, an event-triggered mechanism is designed to save the communication resources. Conditions are presented to guarantee that the tracking error is uniformly ultimately bounded. The validity of the proposed method is verified by simulation example.

articleTitle: A Novel Transfer Learning Method Based on Domain Adversarial Networks for Remaining Useful Life Prediction
abstract: As a core technology of prognostics health management (PHM), remaining useful life (RUL) prediction has gained more and more attention with the approach of the Industry 4.0 era. However, there are still relatively few studies dedicated to transfer learning to consider the applicability of models in RUL prediction. So in this paper, a transfer learning method based on domain adversarial network (DANN) is proposed for the case where the target domain data is unlabeled, and the source domain data is labeled. In the predictor branch, a multi-scale separable convolution is used in order to enhance the feature extraction process. In addition, an attention mechanism is added to perform adaptive correction of the extracted features. An unbalanced loss function is also proposed in order to reduce the lagged prediction points. In the domain classifier branch, domain invariant features are extracted by setting a gradient inversion layer between the feature extraction module and the domain classifier. The proposed method is validated on the dataset of NASA Commercial Modular Aero-Propulsion System Simulation (C-MAPPS), and the experimental results have verified the superiority of the method.

articleTitle: Multi-Cue Depth Estimation from Epipolar Plane Image
abstract: Depth estimation is essential in many light field applications. In this paper, we present a depth estimation method from epipolar plane images(EPIs) by combining both linear consistency cue and regional distribution difference cue to improve the occlusion handling capability. For the linear consistency cue, a rotational linear entropy (RLE) metric is proposed to measure the pixel color consistency of an EPI line. For the distribution difference cue, a height-variable SPO (HSPO) that integrates the color consistency constraint as a new weight in SPO, is introduced to measure distribution difference. Integrating the two data costs is shown more robust to complex occlusions and varying planes. Cost volume filtering and global optimization are applied to improve the accurate of the final depth map. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms other state-of-art light field depth estimation methods in both qualitative and quantitative evaluations.

articleTitle: Synchronization of Fractional-Order Quaternion-Valued Coupled Neural Networks via Hybrid Control Approach
abstract: Without separating the fractional-order quaternion-valued coupled neural networks (FQVCNNs) into four real-valued systems, synchronization for FQVCNNs is investigated in this paper. Firstly, a hybrid control approach including internal drive and external control is considered. To be specific, based on local information of the nodes’ dynamics, edge-based fractional-order adaptive technique for coupling weights and adaptive feedback controllers are simultaneously applied to synchronize the FQVCNNs to the desired trajectory. Particularly, some new analytical approaches for fractional-order adaptive schemes, including the method of contradiction, the Mean Value Theorem are developed to establish synchronization criteria of the network system. Finally, a numerical simulation is provided to illustrate the validity of theoretical results.

articleTitle: NSGA-II based Electric Vehicle Charging Scheduling for Daily Commuting
abstract: With the increasing proportion of electric vehicles (EVs) in private cars, the EVs’ public charging scheduling problem has been paid more attention due to the limited number of charging stations at home and long-distance commuting demands. This paper proposes an EV charging scheduling system (EVCSS) based on the NSGA-II algorithm to schedule multiple vehicles in urban daily commuting. The benefits of all EVs and users’ preferences are considered in optimizing charging stations’ selection and route planning. The simulation results validate the effectiveness of the NSGA-II algorithm in solving the charging scheduling problem of EVs, and the superiority of EVCSS compared with the nearest neighbor charging routing algorithm (NNCR) in saving time, reducing charging cost and improving users’ satisfaction level.

articleTitle: BADE: BEV-Adaptive Distance Estimation Neural Network based on Monocular Cameras
abstract: Distance estimation is a pivotal component of environment perception of autonomous driving. The current mainstream distance estimation methods are mainly based on binocular cameras and laser radars, which are, however, either difficult to calibrate or expensive. It is promising to perform distance estimation based on monocular cameras, which are less expensive and easier to calibrate. But depth information is lost in a single image of monocular cameras so that it is more challenging to ensure the distance estimation precision compared with other methods. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a neural network for monocular distance estimation, which estimates the distance of objects within a single image in an end-to-end way. More specifically, we implement an object detection neural network to detect objects, fuse that object detection network and the distance estimation methods based on bird's-eye view to form our BEV-Adaptive Distance Estimation Neural Network(BADE) based on bird's-eye view, which generates multi-objective distance estimation. Meanwhile, we enhance our BADE by inserting an auxiliary network branch into the object detection network, which takes the distance estimation results as feedback to better train the object detection neural network and can improve the distance estimation precision. Experiments demonstrate the performance of the proposed BADE.

articleTitle: Fault Detection for Discrete-time Switched Systems With Bounded Disturbances and Faults
abstract: The present study is concerned with the fault detection for a class of switched systems with dwell-time constraint in discrete-time domain. Different from the reported results, the considered disturbances and faults are relaxed to the case with bounded magnitude rather than the bounded energy. To address this situation, the dwell-time dependent ℓ<inf>∞</inf> fault detector is then constructed for implementing detection process. More incisively, when the magnitude is known in advance, a reachable-based fault detector is also designed to improve the detection performance. In addition, with the dwell-time dependent Lyapunov function approach, several sufficient conditions for the existence of the ℓ<inf>∞</inf> and reachable-based fault detectors are derived, and a practical example is provided to demonstrate the applicability of the proposed detection methods.

articleTitle: Robust Adaptive Path Following Control Strategy for Underactuated Unmanned Surface Vehicle with Unknown Time-varying Disturbance
abstract: This paper solves the path following control problem of underactuated unmanned surface vehicle with unknown time-varying disturbances. An adaptive fast non-singular terminal sliding mode path following control strategy is proposed based on an extended state observer (ESO) line-of-sight guidance law. Considering the influence of external disturbances on the navigation of the unmanned surface vehicle, a finite-time convergent disturbance observer (FCDO) is applied in the control law to compensate for the external disturbance to reduce the chatter problem of the sliding mode controller effectively. A robust term is designed to compensate for the estimation error of the observer, which ensures the stability of the system. The results of simulation experiments are carried out to demonstrate that the designed control law has stronger robustness and faster convergence speed.

articleTitle: Research and design of power monitoring system for advanced and sophisticated laboratory users
abstract: In order to improve the informatization and automation degree of power intelligent monitoring for users of advanced and sophisticated laboratories, the research and design of power monitoring system were carried out. The power monitoring and control system integrates various electrical parameters and has the function of remote control. Based on its database management system, the load prediction model and dynamic fault model were established, which improved the accuracy of energy consumption measurement, realized the remote control, maintenance, fault diagnosis and overall load prediction ability of related electrical equipment, improved the use efficiency of power resource allocation, the safe operation guarantee ability and the strain ability of taking emergency measures and operation analysis.

articleTitle: Prescribed Impact Time Cooperative Guidance Law with Seeker’s Field of View Constraint
abstract: This paper presents a cooperative guidance law which can prescribe the impact time and ensure the seeker to lock on the target. Firstly, taking the initial state of missiles relative to the target as a reference, the role of missiles can be divided into a leader and followers. Secondly, a prescribed impact time guidance law considering seeker’s field of view (FOV) is designed for leader, which realizes finite time convergence of impact time error. A distributed cooperative guidance law is proposed for followers to ensure that the target is always in the seeker’s FOV while followers are tracking the leader’s state. Furthermore, in order to avoid the singularities of guidance law, a two stage guidance law conversion strategy is proposed to ensure the stable operation of the missile cooperative system. Finally, numerical simulations are utilized to validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Adaptive Collaborative Control of Virtual Synchronous Generator in Microgrid
abstract: The virtual synchronous generator technology introduces rotational inertia and damping factor to improve the impact of frequency oscillation on the grid effectively, but cannot take the properties of dynamic regulation into account. Therefore, a strategy for adaptive collaborative control of rotational inertia and damping factors is proposed in this paper. Firstly, a mathematical model of the virtual synchronous generator is established. On this basis, the influence of each parameter on the dynamic characteristics of the system is analyzed when the power changes. Secondly, the principle of parameter selection is determined. Oscillation and overshoot of transient processes are effectively suppressed by real-time adjustment of rotational inertia and damping factors. Finally, the simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Research and Simulation on Aircraft Bidirectional Dynamic Track Search Algorithm
abstract: Aiming at the problem of dynamic programming algorithm costs too much time in 2-D environment, the bidirectional dynamic programming algorithm is proposed. The new algorithm utilizes the limited decision of single way dynamic programming algorithm and reduces the number of state points in calculation process to improve efficiency, then, the optimal intersection stage of bidirectional dynamic programming algorithm is proposed, the feasibility and global optimality of new algorithm are proved by mathematics. The simulation results show that the new algorithm can improve efficiency of aircraft track search.

articleTitle: Simultaneous arrival control strategy of multiple drones considering target movement
abstract: Simultaneous arrival of multiple UAVs is one of the classic applications in cooperative control. In this paper, the expected time of arrival (ETA) is selected as the coordination variable, and the consensus algorithm is used to realize the air aggregation and simultaneous arrival of multiple UAVs. Based on the comprehensive consideration of UAV speed constraints, acceleration constraints and target motion model, according to the different starting point, flight direction and distance, the control algorithm is simulated and verified. The simulation results show that the algorithm is effective, robust and flexible.

articleTitle: Opinion Evolution Analysis for Extended Friedkin-Johnson Model in Social Networks
abstract: In some social situations, the previous moment opinion may influence the opinion formation on a given topic. In this paper, we propose an extended opinion dynamics model, unlike the Friedkin-Johnson model, the proposed model considers the opinion formation depending on the previous moment opinion, initial opinion and neighbor opinon. Necessary and sufficient conditions guaranteeing the convergence of the stubbornness individuals are obtained. Moreover, it is shown that the opinions of the memory individuals achieves consensus. Simulation examples are given to demonstrate the convergence and consensus behaviors observed for opinion dynamics.

articleTitle: Collapse column prediction model based on random forest algorithm
abstract: In recent years, with the frequent occurrence of coal mine safety accidents, the fine interpretation of the geological structure inside the coal seam has become more and more important. Collapse column, as a common geological anomaly in the process of coal mining, has caused serious damage to the continuity of coal seam and brought huge hidden danger to the safety of coal mine production and personnel. In this paper, based on the random forest algorithm, several seismic attributes obtained by 3d seismic exploration technology are analyzed jointly, and the location of collapse column is successfully predicted, which provides a reliable means for predicting collapse column.

articleTitle: HFGAN-CN: T2I Model via Text-Image Hierarchical Attention Fusion
abstract: In this paper, we propose a simple and effective text-to-image generative adversarial network named Hierarchical Fusion via GAN with Capsule Network discriminator (HFGAN-CN) , which uses only one generator and one discriminator to generate high-resolution images directly from text. We introduce a text-image feature fusion module via spatial and channel attention mechanism into the generator, which performs hierarchical fusion on the features of the two modes in the image generation process, so as to guide the generator to generate high-quality images in line with text semantics. We propose a match-aware discriminator to synthesize text-semantic compliant images and employ a capsule network to reconfigure the network structure of the discriminator without introducing an additional network. Experiments on the benchmark dataset show that our method is superior to the existing techniques and can effectively generate high-resolution images conforming to the text description.

articleTitle: Position synchronization control of multi-motor drive system based on FCS-MPC and RPCSC
abstract: In order to improve the dynamic, steady-state performance and synchronization accuracy of the multi-motor drive system, this paper proposes a finite control set model predictive control (FCS-MPC) + deviation coupling position command shaping control (RPCSC) for the multi-motor drive system. FCS-MPC is used to design a non-cascaded predictive speed controller for multi-motor system to improve dynamic performance. In order to improve synchronization accuracy and reduce synchronization errors, RPCSC is used to feed forward the synchronization compensation to the controller.
