According to the Y0L0-v4 detection results, make basic judgments on the intersection situation and vehicle status in the traffic violation pictures, and provide further relevant information for subsequent manual screening to reduce the burden of manual work. In view of the characteristics of the target to be detected in the traffic violation image, the Mosaic data augmentation in Y0L0-v4 is replaced by Mixup data augmentation. Due to the low detection accuracy of small targets such as traffic lights and traffic piles in traffic violation images, a variety of attention mechanisms are compared, and finally, the Coordinate Attention attention mechanism which has a better effect on improving the traffic violation image datasets and the fewer parameters is selected. The Depthwise Over-parameterized convolutional layer(DO-Conv) is used to replace the basic convolutional layer to extract input image information more efficiently and further improve the accuracy of network detection. Finally, We propose a lightweight Y0L0-v4, which greatly reduces network parameters and improves the speed of network detection while meeting the detection requirements.

articleTitle: Linear Active Disturbance Rejection Anti-Backlash Control for Dual-Motor Coaxial Driving Robotic Joint
abstract: This paper describes a linear active disturbance rejection anti-backlash controller for a dual-motor coaxial driving robotic joint. This type of robotic joint is an over-actuated system that dual motors collaboratively drive load each axis. Firstly, a dual-motor driving model is built considering backlash and then a simplified control-orient model is proposed based on the principle of dual-motor anti-backlash strategy. Secondly, a linear active disturbance rejection control-based dual-motor position tracking framework is developed in accordance with the control-orient model. Finally, in order to deal with backlash coupling with unknown external torque, an admittance control-based adaptive position compensator is proposed. Unlike other control strategies, it practically achieves high tracking performance without requiring any backlash and external torque information. The effectiveness and simplicity of proposed control strategy is verified through comparative experiments.

articleTitle: The consensus of discrete multi-agent systems with asymmetric delay
abstract: The consensus problem has always been the core of multi-agent systems. In recent years, the studies of multi-agent systems with symmetric delay or variable delay have some work. But few scholars are involved in the research of the study of multi-agent systems with asymmetric delay. In this paper, the consensus of discrete multi-agent systems with asymmetric delay are discussed under the network topology whose adjacency matrix is the stochastic matrix. The eigenvalue distribution consensus is proposed based on the predecessors’ research. Using the theory of stochastic matrix and stability theory of discrete system, the sufficient conditions of Lyapnov stability , eigenvalue distribution consensus and average consensus are given, respectively. Lastly, numerical simulations are given to show the effectiveness of our results.

articleTitle: Finite-Time Couple-Group Consensus for Fractional-Order Multi-Agent Systems with Coopetition Interactions
abstract: The problem of finite-time couple-group consensus for fractional-order multi-agent systems with weakly connected topology is investigated in this paper through pinning control. A new error variable based on cooperative and competitive interactions among agents is introduced to transform the fractional-order multi-agent system into a first-order multi-agent system and a novel group consensus protocol is designed for the transformed system. By applying the Lyapunov approach and matrix theory, several sufficient conditions are obtained to ensure the achievement of finite-time couple-group consensus of the system. In addition, the settling time is upper bounded by a definite value, which is independent of the initial states. Finally, the correctness and validity of our findings are verified through some numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Hybrid Soft-Sensing Model of Tuyere Raceway Temperature Based on Improved RBF Network
abstract: Blast furnace is an important unit in iron-steel making. The temperature in tuyere raceway of blast furnace has been a primary concern due to that it plays a crucial role in meeting the production requirements of high product quality and low energy consumption. In this paper, an improved Radial Basis Function (RBF) neural network is proposed to predict the temperature in tuyere raceway of blast furnace. The proposed method integrates the MeanShift-Kmeans algorithm and the immune algorithm to improve its prediction accuracy. The MeanShift-Kmeans is introduced to solve the center vector of radial basis function, in this way, the initial center is determined in accordance with the density distribution of data, reducing the instability of clustering results and further enhancing the prediction accuracy of the temperature in tuyere raceway. We adopt the immune algorithm to optimize the network hyperparameters, effectively avoiding the generation of local optimal solutions. Considering that there is available image data in the tuyere raceway, we establish the soft-sensing model of temperature based on physical data and image data to enhance the prediction accuracy. This paper uses the data of a 2500m<sup>3</sup> blast furnace to conduct experiments, and the results show that the proposed method is effective.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Prediction of Fully Automatic Operation System Based on Ontology and Bayesian Network
abstract: The emergence of fully automatic operation (FAO) system realizes the automation of the whole process of train operation and improves the overall automation level and system performance. In order to predict the possible faults of the system in operation, facilitate relevant personnel to formulate risk control measures, explore the causes of risk events, and carry out early prevention of accidents. In this paper, a fault prediction method based on ontology and Bayesian reasoning is proposed: firstly, the class in a specific scenario, the attribute relationship of the class and the case model are defined based on ontology to describe the interaction behavior and scenario parameters between subsystems; Then, according to the concepts described in the ontology model - the relationship between concepts, the Bayesian network topology is established to qualitatively describe the relationship between nodes, and the conditional probability distribution between network nodes is determined according to the historical fault data and expert experience; Finally, the proposed method is verified by an actual fault case of Yanfang line.

articleTitle: A High Accuracy and Recall Rate 6D Pose Estimation Method Using Point Pair Features for Bin-picking
abstract: Bin-picking is one of the most common tasks for robot applications in industry, while point cloud registration is the most important part of it. Although much research has been done in the related field and obtained considerable achievement, it is still a difficult challenge since multiple target instances locate in the scene. In addition to higher recognition accuracy, it is also necessary to recall as many target instances as possible. In this paper, we improve Point Pair Feature (PPF) matching method and propose a new 6D target pose estimation method for point cloud registration. We adjust the computation of feature and the voting scheme of the original PPF method. Besides, we add a post-processing step after pose clustering to remove the wrong and overlapped poses. Furthermore, we test our method on sileane dataset and real data. The final experiments show that our method greatly improve the recall rate and accuracy, and can effectively remove the poses which overlap with each other or are mismatched.

articleTitle: Optimal Path Planning for Unmanned Surface Vehicle Based on Fast Marching Method
abstract: Path planning is one of the key technologies for unmanned surface vehicle (USV) to realize intelligent navigation. However, most path planning algorithms only consider the shortest path length and ignore other constraints during the navigation, which may generate a path that is not practically optimal in the view of safety and angular constraints. To solve this problem, an optimal path planning algorithm for USV based on fast marching method (FMM) is proposed in this paper. Firstly, a arrival time potential field with the only minimum point is generated by executing FMM on the initial binary map, which is used as a basic model for path planning. Secondly, to modeling the safety and heading angle constraints of the vehicle, the saturated safety map based on SFMS and the virtual obstacles formed by USV’s turning ability are introduced and applied respectively. Thirdly, the gradient descent method is used on the improved potential field to search out an optimal path that can well meet the actual constrains of USV. The effectiveness and rationality of the algorithm are then verified by simulations.

articleTitle: Monocular Feed-forward based 3D Target Aiming Using a 6-DOF Robotic Arm
abstract: With the overall development of artificial intelligence technology, the autonomous application of robotic arms has been significantly improved, which places extremely superior requirements on the reliability of algorithms such as target detection and target positioning. In this paper, based on a 6-DOF collaborative manipulator, we propose a 3D target aiming algorithm with high real-time performance through monocular vision feed-forward control. First, we present a coordinate system calibration algorithm to obtain the relative pose relationship between the monocular camera and the laser transmitter. Second, a modified YOLO-v4 algorithm is designed to further improve the speed and accuracy of target detection. Third, we propose a monocular aiming algorithm, which can directly aim at a 3D target based on the target’s 2D pixel deviation. Through experimental verification, the single-frame detection time of our algorithm can be reduced to 14.12 ms, and the response time of monocular aiming algorithm is only 0.61 s.

articleTitle: MI Classification based on Locally Linear Embedding and One-dimensional Simplified Convolutional Neural Network
abstract: Motor imagery (MI) electroencephalogram (EEG) signals are extensively used in brain-computer interface (BCI) systems, and it is considered as a promising cognitive tool for the rehabilitation of movement disorders. Due to the limited dataset of MI, the complex neural networks fed by the MI data are prone to overfitting. However, the feature extraction capability of simple neural networks is limited. Therefore, this paper combines the locally linear embedding (LLE) of unsupervised learning and one-dimensional simplified neural network (1DSCNN). Locally linear embedding is used for dimensionality reduction of MI signals. Then the features are sent to the 1DSCNN for MI classification. Using dataset III from BCI competition II, the experimental results show that the proposed method achieves accuracy as high as 98.21%. Compared with other algorithms, it can improve the recognition rate of EEG by 6-13% on average in BCI competition IV dataset 2b, with shorter training time.

Author Keywords: Locally Linear Embedding and Convolutional Neural Network

articleTitle: Stability of Spinning Missiles Guided by Trajectory Tracking Guidance Law
abstract: Trajectory tracking guidance is employed widely by low cost missiles for the characteristic of easy to implement. However, for spinning missile, the guidance loop may result in dynamic unstable in the form of a divergent coning motion. Due to the cross-coupling effects between the pitch and yaw channel caused by spinning and the phase lag caused by the actuator, the stability criterions of the trajectory tracking guidance applied to the non-spinning missiles are no longer suitable for spinning missiles. Addressing this issue, a new model based on the state space function has been established in this paper, and the stability criterions for the acceleration autopilot and the tracking guidance loop have been derived. Simulation results illustrate the effectiveness of the stability criterions. It reveals that the trajectory tracking guidance stable region of the coefficients for a spinning missile will shrink a lot compared with the non-spinning missile, if there is no autopilot acting on the control loop, but it will vary little if there is a stable acceleration autopilot with the phase lag compensated acting on the the spinning missile. With increasing of the phase lag, the stable region of the guidance coefficients for the spinning missile becomes smaller.

articleTitle: Adaptive Coefficients Multi-view Projection and Its Application for Fault Detection
abstract: Fault detection technology is playing an increasingly important role in industrial processes. Therefore, a fault detection algorithm based on adaptive coefficient multi-view projection is proposed in this paper. This method uses the consistency and complementarity of hidden features in the multi-view data to enhance the accuracy of the model. Meanwhile, the manifold learning idea is used to maintain the local geometric structure of the data. The most important thing is to introduce the spectral radius to assign the weight coefficient of each view and different views, which reduces the influence of artificially set parameters and the time for artificial parameter adjustment when training the model. On this basis, considering the non-Gaussian of industrial data, monitoring statistics suitable for this method are proposed in the feature subspace and residual subspace separated from the original data. A real industrial process proves the validity of the detection method.

articleTitle: Two-Branch Convolutional Neural Network Based on Multi-Source Information for Flotation Overflow Identification
abstract: The overflow identification of flotation process is important to ensure the flotation quality and improve the comprehensive economic efficiency of the enterprise. However, direct monitoring of flotation froth overflow is difficult due to the strong nonlinearity, information redundancy and uncertainty of industrial processes. To solve the above problems, a two-branch convolutional neural network model (MSI-two-branch CNN) based on multi-source information is proposed. By merging multiple network branches, the features of industrial processes can be extracted effectively. In addition, the one-dimensional time series are transformed using Gram angular domain (GAF) to generate two-dimensional images, which not only can introduce process variables into the overflow recognition model, but also can improve the recognition efficiency by using the correlation between variables. Finally, the method was applied to the gold flotation process. The experimental results show that MSI-two-branch CNN can perform overflow recognition with high accuracy and efficiency in a practical industrial context.

articleTitle: Double Deep Q network-based speed trajectory intelligent optimization for high-speed train
abstract: As a part of the automatic train operation (ATO) system, the recommended speed trajectory is crucial to the safety and efficiency of train operation. This paper proposes a speed trajectory intelligent optimization approach based on a Double Deep Q network (Double DQN). The train dynamics model is established taking into account the traction and braking characteristics of the train, the line conditions, and the train position and speed constraints. The reinforcement learning environment suitable for high-speed train operation is established, including state collection, action collection, and reward function. The agent is responsible for selecting appropriate driving strategies with the aim of achieving energy efficiency, punctuality, and riding comfort under speed and position constraints. Numerical experiments based on the data of Beijing-Shanghai High-speed Railway and high-speed train CRH2 are conducted to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed Double DQN method under the scene of fixed-line speed restriction conditions. The results show that the proposed method can improve punctuality and reduce energy consumption in case of loss of a small amount of comfort.

articleTitle: NOx prediction of gas turbine based on Dual Attention and LSTM
abstract: Aiming at the difficulty in predicting NOX emissions products of gas turbines in power plants, this paper analyzes the long-term operating parameter data during the combustion process, and proposes a dual attention long short-term memory (DA-LSTM) gas turbine NOX prediction model. Decompose time series by singular spectrum analysis (SSA) to remove noise in data acquisition, apply Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM) method to select features, and the dual attention mechanism is used to establish a time window to assign weights to input features and times. The model in this article is tested on the UCI public data set, and compare with related models. The simulation result shows the model can achieve effective prediction on NOX gas emissions during the combustion process.

articleTitle: U-Select RCNN: An Effective Voxel-based 3D Object Detection Method with Feature Selection Strategy
abstract: Accurate object detection is a fundamental requirement for autonomous systems to operate in dynamic urban environments. Considering the intricacy of the environment and the occlusion of objects, various point cloud based three-dimensional (3D) object detection methods have been proposed, such as point-based or voxel-based methods. In this paper, a feature selection mechanism is proposed in a voxel-based method to generate bird’s eye view (BEV) feature maps from the original point cloud. For the 3D Backbone, the U-shaped structure and single scale feature selection module are combined. After combining high-level semantics and low-level fine-grained features, the optimized features after the BEV feature maps are applied to region of interest (RoI) refinement, so that the voxel features can better serve the subsequent 3D object detection. The experimental results on KITTI dataset show higher 3D object detection accuracy compared to the state-of-the-art 3D detection methods, which reflects the effectiveness of the proposed architecture.

articleTitle: SINR-based power allocation under DoS attacks: A Stackelberg game approach
abstract: In this paper, the communication between a source and a destination in the presence of a attacker is considerd, and the game theory approaches are used to solve the power schedule problem in the wireless communication network. The sensor can be affected by DoS attacker when transmitting data. The game process between the defender and the attacker is established as Stackelberg game strategy. First, a Stackelberg game is divided into two parts, i.e., the leader and the follower. Each of two parts provides an optimal solution to solve total power allocation based on the object function consist of signal-to-interference-and-noise-ratio(SINR) and transmission cost. Second, the existence and uniqueness of Stackelberg Equilibrium have been proved. By constructing a sub-gradient based Stackelberg iterative algorithm, the Stackelberg Equilibrium can be solved. Finally, numerical examples are provided to illustrate the main results.

articleTitle: Attitude Angle Compound Controller Design for TREX 700L Electric Unmanned Helicopter
abstract: In order to improve the control accuracy of attitude angles and enhance the anti-interference ability of unmanned helicopter, a novel ESO-LQG-PI control method for TREX 700L helicopter is proposed in this paper. By considering the high non-linearity of the helicopter system, a class of small disturbance incremental linearization processing approach is used. Meanwhile, an extended state observer (ESO) is used to estimate and compensate the system disturbance in real time. The proportion integral (PI) controller is utilized to reduce the steady-state error caused by input signals, then linear quadratic gaussian (LQG) based controller is presented to obtain the optimized control gain. Summing up the advantages of PI and LQG, this paper proposes an ESO-LQG-PI control method that can improve the control accuracy and adaptability of the studied system. The simulations and flight tests show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Image Matching Method Based on ORB and Grid Motion Statistics
abstract: The ORB algorithm has a small amount of calculation and can quickly abstract numerous feature points. The grid motion statistics algorithm can filter the initial match, reduce false matches, and retain more inliers. Combining ORB and grid motion statistics algorithm to complete the indoor matching of two adjacent frames of pictures. Proved by experiment: The algorithm used in this paper can eliminate mismatched point pairs and retain more inliers. Compared with the ORB+RANSAC algorithm, the inliers ratio is increased by 7.62% on average. The algorithm in this paper can be applied to the indoor positioning of vision-based mobile robots and has strong robustness in the feature point matching of image rotation and scaling.

articleTitle: Prescribed Performance Based Adaptive Event-Triggered Fuzzy Tracking Control for Uncertain Nonlinear Systems
abstract: This study reports the prescribed performance based adaptive event-triggered fuzzy tracking control problem for uncertain nonlinear systems. An adaptive event-triggered fuzzy tracking controller is constructed under the framework of backstepping design, and the command filtered technique is used to avoid the problem of the explosion of complexity. The prescribed performance function is introduced to ensure the transient and steady state performance simultaneously, which greatly improves the control performance of the system. With the help of event-triggered mechanism, the proposed method can reduce computing burden and save communication resources. In addition, the proposed control scheme ensures that the tracking error converges asymptotically to zero but does not exceed the prescribed boundary, and all signals of the system are bounded. Finally, the simulation result verifies the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Design of Cascaded Model Predictive Controller for Modular Robot Joints
abstract: As the core driving force providers in the robot system of next generation, modular robot joint’s motion and power performance directly affects the overall motion control effect of robot body. The design starts from the servo control of the modular robot joint and follows the principle of model predictive control to devise a cascaded model predictive controller based on the mathematical model of a permanent magnet synchronous motor for the joint to substitute for the traditional dual-loop PI controller with current and velocity loops in the closed-loop vector control link. The design also employs the MATLAB/Simulink platform to simulate the control effect. The simulation experiments illuminate that the design of the cascaded model predictive controller has better dynamic response performance than the traditional PI controller and effectively enhances system robustness.

articleTitle: A Fusion-based Enhancement Method for Low-light UAV Images
abstract: This paper focuses on the enhancement of low-light UAV images. There are some differences between low-light UAV images and general low-light images. Specifically, low-light UAV images are underexposed as a whole but contain overexposed areas produced by lamplights. In addition, these images have a larger field of vision and therefore contain more information. Based on these characteristics, we propose an enhancement method for low-light UAV images. First, we adopt two different enhancing methods, one is to improve the global brightness, the other enhances the local contrast, and then we use appropriate weights to fuse them to retain their respective advantages. Second, a new detail enhancement strategy is designed to preserve more details of these images. Finally, a brightness and chrominance optimization operation based on linear stretching is used to further optimize the enhanced images. We test the proposed method with three different datasets, including a public UAV dataset, a self-made UAV dataset and a widely used image enhancement dataset. Besides, our enhancement method is compared with several state-of-the-art enhancing methods and evaluated with two image quality assessments. All the experiments demonstrate that the proposed enhancement method is superior to others in enhancing low-light UAV images.

articleTitle: Remaining Useful Life Prediction for Pneumatic Control Valve System Based on Hybrid CNN-LSTM Model
abstract: Pneumatic control valve is an important terminal control element in the industrial control system. Accurate prediction of the residual life of pneumatic control valve is of great significance to industrial production. This paper introduces an innovative fault diagnosis and remaining useful life (RUL) prediction method for a pneumatic control valves system. Firstly, the parameters with relatively large correlation coefficients are selected as inputs using Perason’s law. Next, support vector machine (SVM) is used to classify the fault types. Then, convolutional neural network (CNN) is employed to capture local features from the input data, and long short term memory (LSTM) is used to extract long-term dependencies from the features. Finally, fully connected networks are used to predict the RUL. Through experimental verification, the prediction model proposed in this paper has better prediction performance than other proposed models.

articleTitle: Lateral stability based hybrid controller designed of torque control for distributed wheel-driven electric vehicles
abstract: This paper designs a nonlinear real-time optimization sliding mode controller (NRO-SMC) focusing on improving stability according to the characteristics of independent and controllable torque of each motor in distributed in-wheel drive electric vehicles. The proposed NRO-SMC adopts hierarchical control, and the sliding mode algorithm is adopted by the high-level controller to decide the additional yaw moment. The sideslip angle and yaw rate are introduced into the sliding mode surface as the input to realize the simultaneous tracking of them; while a torque distribution controller is established for the low-level controller to allocate additional yaw moment to each in-wheel motor through nonlinear optimization. Finally, the co-simulation is carried out and verified under double lane change conditions on the basis of CarSim and MATLAB/Simulink. Results show that the proposed NRO-SMC reduces the sideslip angle of the vehicle to 23.51 % under the premise of ensuring the expected driving trajectory, yaw rate, and lateral acceleration, thereby improving the lateral stability of the vehicle.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of maglev train suspension system based on data drive
abstract: The performance evaluation of maglev train suspension system is one of the main bases to improve the safety and smoothness of maglev train operation, and also an important guarantee for continuous operation of maglev system. Therefore, it is necessary to evaluate the performance of maglev train suspension system. In order to make a comprehensive evaluation of maglev train suspension system, this paper evaluates the performance of maglev train suspension system based on data drive. Firstly, the evaluation indexes are established, then the indexes weight is determined by exponential scaling method, and the evaluation model is established. Finally, the feasibility of the model is verified by experiments, which can judge whether the performance of the train suspension system meets the requirements, and provides a basis for the maglev train suspension system to improve the system performance.

articleTitle: Prediction of outlet pressure for sulfur dioxide blower based on ARX model and adaptive Kalman filter
abstract: The sulfur dioxide blower refers to a centrifugal blower that transports various gases in the sulfuric acid production process from flue gases. Accurately predicting the outlet pressure of the sulfur dioxide blower is significant for the sulfuric acid production process from flue gases. Due to the complex internal structure of the sulfur dioxide blower, it is difficult to establish a precise mechanism model. In this paper, a novel hybrid algorithm combining Autoregressive exogenous (ARX) model and Sage-Husa adaptive Kalman filter is used to establish the sulfur dioxide blower model and predict its outlet pressure. Where the Akaike Information Criterion (AIC) is used to determine the order of the ARX model, and the least square method is used to determine the ARX model parameters. Considering the high-order ARX model parameter estimation is difficult to calculate, the optimal ARX model is determined in the low-order range, and the Kalman equation of state and observation equation are constructed using this model. By combining the ARX model and the Sage-Husa adaptive Kalman filter, experiment shows that the proposed algorithm obtains better prediction effect than the traditional time series model combined with Kalman filter.

articleTitle: Optical fiber SPR ethanol gas sensor based on perovskite
abstract: The measurement of ethanol gas concentration was achieved by using an optical fiber SPR sensing system combined with the scheme of new gas-sensitive material ZnSnO3 / TiO2. Due to the redox reaction between the material and ethanol gas, the change of ethanol gas concentration changes the material resistance, resulting in the alteration of effective refractive index on the optical fiber surface, which is manifested in the significant deviation of SPR resonance trough of optical fiber. Therefore, the detection of the concentration of ethanol gas at ordinary temperature can be realized by observing the deviation of resonant wavelength. The test results demonstrate that the sensitivity of the optical fiber sensor is 6.92 pm / ppm in the ethanol gas concentration range of 100ppm-1000ppm.

articleTitle: Position Sensorless Control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on Fuzzy PI and New Sliding Mode Observer
abstract: With the gradual improvement of social quality requirements for power supply, the centralized power supply mode changes to the distributed power system. Micro gas turbines are a hot spot for scientific research and market development as mature distributed generation equipment. Permanent magnet synchronous motor plays an essential role in starting of microturbine. There is a chattering problem in the sensorless control system of permanent magnet synchronous motor using the traditional sliding mode observer. This paper proposes the continuous switching function at zero points and a new approach rate. The fuzzy PI control is also used in the speed loop to replace the traditional PI control. The new sliding mode observer can improve rotor speed and position estimation accuracy, weaken chattering, and have fast response speed. Fuzzy PI control can further reduce the motor rotor speed overshoot, speed up the response speed, and have a strong anti-interference capability. The above two improved methods are validated by experiments.

articleTitle: Power Line Extraction Based on Combined Clustering of Line Segments
abstract: Line segment detection based on Hough transform is widely used in Power Line Extraction (PLE). Because power lines have the characteristics of symmetrical edges, there are many problems of multiple detection and poor positioning in PLE using Hough transform and improved line segments methods. In order to solve the above problems, A novel PLE method based on combined clustering of line segments is proposed. First, Image graying, denoising, enhancement and edge detection methods are selected to weaken the effects of complex background around power lines; second, convert the straight line in Cartesian coordinates into points in polar coordinates, determine the power line segments by accumulator; third, determine the number of power lines by DBSCAN algorithm which is insensitive to abnormal points, then cluster the power lines by K-means algorithm, and finally convert the power lines from polar coordinate space to Cartesian coordinate system. Experiments show that the proposed method can automatically extract power lines and effectively solve the problems of multiple detection and poor positioning.

articleTitle: A Random Forest Model Based on Parameter Optimization Using Cuckoo Search Algorithm for Ship Traffic Flow Forecasting
abstract: The forecast of ship traffic flow can effectively improve the ability of channel management. One of the difficulties of forecasting lies in the non-linear characteristics of traffic flow distribution over time. This paper proposes a traffic flow prediction model by combining random forest model (RF) and cuckoo search algorithm (CS). CS selects the optimal parameters for the RF model. Then use the RF model optimized by CS to predict the time series of traffic flow. The proposed model has been examined and the convergence of the cuckoo optimization algorithm has been analyzed by using the statistical data of ship traffic flow in Qingdao Port. The results show that, compared with the BP neural network and the random forest model, the CS-RF model is more accurate in predicting ship traffic flow. This can help the channel management office to estimate the ship flow of a port effectively.

articleTitle: A decentralized robust impedance control method of modular robot manipulators with physical human robot interaction
abstract: In this paper, an impedance control approach is presented for modular robot manipulator (MRM) system with physical human robot interaction (pHRI). Based on joint torque feedback (JTF) technique, the dynamic model of the manipulator systems is described as an integration of joint subsystems associated with the effect of interconnected dynamic coupling (IDC). The radial basis function neural network (RBFNN) has been employed to cope with of unknown human limb model. A dual closed-loop control framework of impedance control and decentralized robust control is proposed to deal with the force/position control problem. Based on Lyapunov theory, the tracking error of the closed-loop robotic system is verified to be ultimately uniformly bounded (UUB). Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: System Modelling and Controller Design of a Variable Structure Two-Wheeled Robot Using Robust Adaptive Dynamic Programming
abstract: In this paper, a variable structure two-wheeled robot is studied. First, we show the system modelling using Appell dynamics. A simplified and decoupled linear model, which describes the dynamic characteristics when the robot’s rotational angle of two forks is fixed, is derived in this paper. Then, a robust controller to reject the disturbances is designed by using a learning algorithm based on robust adaptive dynamic programming methods. Finally, the simulation shows the effectiveness of our controller in stabilizing the robot and disturbance rejection.

articleTitle: Wind Turbine Blade Icing Detection with SCADA Data
abstract: Blade ice accretion endangers the safety of wind turbines located at high altitudes with a humid climate, particularly during winter. Timely detection of ice accretion facilitates appropriate regulation of the wind turbine, including shut down, to ensure safety. This paper provides a detailed analysis of the impact of ice accretion on wind turbine performance and relevant operational parameters. Rotor speed, output power and ambient temperature are selected as variables that can facilitate the detection of blade ice accretion. The XGBoost method is used to construct normal behavior models for output power and rotor speed respectively. A Sequential Probability Ratio Test (SPRT) is introduced to analyze the model prediction residuals and thus identify any abnormal changes to output power and rotor speed. If significant changes are detected when the ambient temperature is below zero, an ice accretion alarm is triggered. Using real blade ice accretion data, a case study demonstrates the proposed blade ice detection method to be effective.

articleTitle: Design of the CAN Bus Control System for the Pipeline Detection Snakelike Robot
abstract: Based on the STM32F103 microcontroller, the communication control system of a snakelike robot for pipeline detection is designed in this paper. Firstly, the application purpose and application environment of the snakelike robot are analyzed in detail, and then the distributed control system of the snakelike robot based on the CAN bus is built. Finally, the motion control of the snakelike robot was initially realized after testing.

articleTitle: Taking Both the Modality and Class information for Visible Infrared Person Re-Identification
abstract: Visible infrared person re-identification (VI Re-ID) is an important and challenging task due to large cross-modality variations between visible and near-infrared images, which suffers from additional cross-modality discrepancy caused by different types of imaging systems. Existing research mainly focuses on expanding the difference between the features to solve the problem. However, there are few studies investigating the reduced differences between the modalities, which is important to this problem. In this paper, we propose a dual-constrained cross-modality (DCCM) loss to enhance the class and modal discrimination of features, and effectively reduce the difference between intra- and inter-modalities. Specifically, the DCCM loss supervises the discriminativeness of network learning features by constraining the distances from the same class and the same modality, the same class and the different modalities, the different classes and the same modality, the different classes and the different modalities. Under the joint supervision of cross-entropy loss and DCCM loss, the network is trained to achieve two important goals, namely class discrimination and modality discrimination. Besides, we propose a two-stream part-level network to learn local features representations of modality invariant. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods on two datasets.

articleTitle: A SLIC based camouflage region selection method for mobile patrol robots
abstract: Patrol robots are often in dangerous situations and may be damaged by criminals. To deal with this problem, a method to protect the robot by camouflage is proposed. It divides scene regions based on color, texture, and spatial features to search for suitable hiding regions. SLIC is employed to pre-divide scene images, in which three different image features are used to describe superpixels. Furthermore, superpixels with similar characteristics are classified as a same category. It can get a region by merging a kind of superpixels. Several scenes are applied to test the proposed method. The experimental result shows that the proposed method can realize camouflage region selection for patrol robots to hide.

articleTitle: Wind Turbine Abnormal Data Identification Based on MKIF Model
abstract: The identification of wind turbine abnormal data is the basis for subsequent wind power prediction and health assessment of wind turbine. This paper analyzes the characteristics of wind turbine abnormal data in detail, and designs the MKIF (Mini batch K Means-Isolation Forest) algorithm to realize the identification of abnormal data of wind turbine. The MKIF algorithm introduces Mini batch K Means clustering into the partition process of the Isolation Forest search tree, and use Silhouette Coefficient to supervise the number and location of the split nodes of the tree. The MKIF anomaly score is defined to describe the degree of isolation of the data, which can effectively identify and eliminate abnormal data and use normal data to establish the main power band. Taking the actual operating data of two wind turbines as an example, the effectiveness of the MKIF abnormal data identification algorithm is verified.

articleTitle: Research on detection method of large diameter pitot tube type differential pressure flowmeter
abstract: To solve the technical problem that the instrument coefficient of the large-diameter pitot tube type differential pressure flowmeter cannot be detected, a flowmeter detection method based on the similarity principle is proposed in this paper. The flow field similar to the original one in large-diameter pipeline is constructed in the small-diameter test pipeline, and the test machine with equal proportion to the original tested flowmeter is made. The instrument coefficient obtained by the testing machine under the small-diameter pipeline is used as the instrument coefficient of the original tested flowmeter. Through theoretical analysis and experimental verification, the instrument coefficient difference between the original flowmeter and the testing machine is only 0.054%. At the same time, through theoretical analysis and experimental research, it is proved that the accuracy of the proposed detection method is affected by the pipeline boundary turbulence. The smaller the pipeline diameter is, the greater the turbulence influence will be, and the lower the detection accuracy is.

Author Keywords: Pitot tube type differential pressure flowmeter

articleTitle: Central Pattern Generators for Locomotion Control in Hexapod Robot Legs
abstract: Aiming at the problem of mutual repulsion caused by the trajectory of the foot end swinging around the respective heel joint as an arc during the forward process of the hexapod robot. Based on the central pattern generator (CPG) control method, leg kinematics are added to become an online foot trajectory generator. First, establish the kinematic model of the hexapod robot leg; Secondly, adopt hopf oscillator motion control network model; Then, use CPG combined with kinematics equations to generate an online foot trajectory generator, realize that the trajectory of the legs on both sides is parallel to each other when they are in the supporting phase. Finally, simulation and experimental research verify the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Smoking Detection and Alarm in Multiple Scenes Based on Deep Learning
abstract: To achieve smoking detection and alarm in multiple scenes, reduce labor costs, and quickly identify smoking violations in public places from the urban electronic monitoring system, a method of smoking detection and alarm in multiple scenes based on deep learning YOLOv5 network model is proposed, and 4391 images of cigarettes and smokers are obtained by writing "Web crawler" program in Python. Divided into 3238 training sets and 1153 test sets, based on YOLOV51, YOLOV4 and YOLOV3 deep learning neural network models, group training experiments were designed to compare the training results. The results show that the recognition accuracy of the model based on the YOLOv51 model can reach 70. 8% on the test dataset, which has the accuracy of the current mainstream deep learning target detection algorithm, but it is superior to other target detection algorithms in terms of recognition speed and file volume. From the experimental results that can be drawn, YOLOv51 both recognition accuracy and recognition speed requirements, in dealing with multi-scene smoking detection and alarm has obvious advantages, and its greatly reduced model size is also suitable for public places monitoring system to rapid deploy, which can meet the actual needs of use well.

articleTitle: Predefined-Time Generalized Nash Equilibrium Seeking for Noncooperative Games of Hybrid Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: This paper investigates the generalized Nash equilibrium (GNE) seeking problem of the noncooperative game. We consider the problem that the participants in the noncooperative game have two different dynamics (the second-order linear dynamics and Euler-Lagrange nonlinear dynamics), and the feasible decision set is subject to the coupling equality constraints, the participant only can access the necessary information of its neighbors. Based on the time base generator (TBG), we propose a distributed GNE seeking algorithms, it can converge to GNE with the predefined time, and the time can be designed in advance by the user without relying on the initial value and any design parameters. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by a practical example.

articleTitle: Adaptive Mask Based Attention Mechanism for Mandarin Speech Recognition
abstract: This paper proposes a novel Transformer model, called ALDSA-Transformer, for extracting local and global information in Mandarin automatic speech recognition (ASR) tasks. In such a model, the adaptive local dense synthesizer attention (ALDSA) is designed to capture the local context correlations. The span of each attention head in ALDSA is parameterized by introducing the adaptive mask function. After training, the adaptive mask function with fixed attention span is applied to the attention matrix for masking the corresponding values. Besides, the ALDSA is integrated with self-attention (SA) to build the ALDSA encoder block. Furthermore, with the stacked encoder blocks, the ALDSA-Transformer encoder is constructed to extract the acoustic features in Mandarin ASR task. Compared with other variants of transformer-based methods, the experimental results show that the proposed method achieves a lower character error rate (CER) of 5.65% with parameter size 23.0M on AISHELL-1 dataset.

articleTitle: ROS-based Collaborative Algorithm Verification Framework for Multi-agent Systems
abstract: In recent years, the multi-agent system (MAS) has developed rapidly due to its broad application prospects. However, most of the current research results are proved to be effective through numerical simulation or indoor ideal conditions. There are few outdoor experiments, and the hardware is not uniform, which makes it difficult to reproduce. A ROS-based MAS collaborative algorithm verification framework is proposed in the paper. Using the UAV model provided by RotorS, it can be quickly deployed to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm. The verification framework not only has the convenience of numerical simulation, but also can simulate various adverse factors in the outdoor environment, so as to simulate the performance of the algorithm in the real world, and its visualization effect is pretty and the construction is simple. In addition, the paper also illustrates the feasibility and effectiveness of the framework through an example.

articleTitle: Finite-time anti-disturbance control for systems with multiple disturbances based on disturbance observer
abstract: The problem of finite-time control is considered for systems with multiple disturbances, which includes the harmonic disturbance and the norm bounded disturbance. the harmonic disturbance is approximated by a disturbance observer. the latter is attenuated by employing H<inf>∞</inf> control method. Based on which, a finite-time composite control strategy is proposed by combining finite-time control. It not only ensures the boundedness of the composite system in finite time, but also improves the anti-disturbance ability. Eventually, a simulation example is used to prove the feasibility of the control strategy.

articleTitle: RUL Prediction Based on Improved LSTM Network Structure
abstract: Using the sparse idea of Highway network to design a sparse denoising LSTM network that suppresses redundant neurons to achieve more accurate residual life (RUL) prediction. Different from the idea that the traditional Highway network is sparse in time direction, this paper transforms the traditional LSTM network by designing sparse gates, and suppresses those neurons that have contributed little to the next layer in the previous layer, and highlights those nerves that contribute more. The role of the element, thereby achieving the goal of sparseness and " denoising " at the same time. When the time series is long, the prediction accuracy of RUL prediction using the sparse denoising LSTM network (Sparse Denoising LSTM, SD-LSTM) is high, and the sparse gate structure can also reduce the computational complexity to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Distance-based Autonomous Docking for UAV-MP in GPS-denied Environment
abstract: In this paper, we study the docking problem between a UAV and a mobile platform (MP) by estimating the relative position through distance information and its own displacement, and design the approaching trajectory for eliminating the need of any global positioning systems or other infrastructures. The main challenges of this problem are to estimate the relative position between the UAV and the MP and design controllers for the navigation trajectory control. Since the MP is not equipped with odometer and its motion changes from time to time, the UAV is iteratively navigated using the estimated relative positions to make it infinitely close to the MP, so that the MP finally enters the field of view of the camera and accomplishes the autonomous docking. A simulation experiment is carried out and the theoretical results are verified.

articleTitle: Improved Bee Colony Algorithm and Its Application in Optimization of Thermal Expansion Coefficient
abstract: The thermal deformation of the electric spindle is one of the key factors affecting the precision of machine tools, and the thermal expansion coefficient is a key parameter that affects the thermal deformation of the electric spindle. The coefficient of thermal expansion is affected by a variety of parameters, showing a strong nonlinear relationship, and there is no precise mathematical model to describe it. In this paper, the artificial bee colony algorithm does not rely on the advantages of precise mathematical model optimization, and the key coefficient in the thermal deformation model of the electric spindle—the thermal expansion coefficient is optimized, and then a thermal deformation model of the electric spindle based on the improved artificial bee colony algorithm is proposed. The simulation experiment results show that the improved bee colony algorithm has improved the optimization accuracy by about 2 times compared with the standard bee colony algorithm, the number of iterations to reach the convergence accuracy is reduced by 10%-16%, and the dynamic optimization capability is strengthened. With the 100MD60Y4 electric spindle as the controlled object, the thermal deformation of the electric spindle at different speeds is studied. Experimental results show that, at a rotational speed of 2000rad I s, for example, based on the amount of thermal experience thermal expansion coefficient and the obtained actually measured thermal deformation of the X, the Y, the Z error in three directions were 0.17m, 0.47m, 1.48μm, the error between the thermal deformation based on the optimized thermal expansion coefficient and the actual measured thermal deformation in the X, Y, and Z directions is 0.02μm, 0.13μm, and 0.56μm, respectively.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral Image Destriping and Denoising Using Stripe and Spectral Low-Rank Matrix Recovery and Graph Laplacian Regularization
abstract: Hyperspectral images are often degraded by various types of noise. It is important to choose appropriate image priors for the underdetermined imaging denoising problems. Graph Laplacian regularizer is one popular prior which can reveal the inherent relationship between signals and exhibits desirable PWS-preserving properties. In this paper, we combine the Graph Singal Processing theory (GSP) with HSI low-rank-based denoising methods. We classify the noise on HSI into three types, and treat the clean image and different types of noise as independent components. The simulated and real-data experiments demonstrate that the proposed denoising methods outperforms many of the mainstream methods in both the quantitative evaluation indexes and visual effects.

articleTitle: Adaptive PID feedback tracking control for 6-DOF collaborative robot
abstract: With the increasing complexity of control systems in industrial process control, traditional controllers are greatly limited in many occasions, so the development of new controller is extremely urgent. This paper combines adaptive feedback control with PID control, and designs a new type of adaptive PID feedback controller. The designed controller is verified by establishing a physical model of the 6-DOF collaborative robot. On the basis of improved adaptive PID feedback control, precise tracking control of multi-DOF cooperative robots is achieved, which improves response speed and eliminates steady-state errors. The designed controller is compared with classical PID control and adaptive control. The steady-state performance, dynamic performance, and anti-interference performance of position control and velocity control are analyzed. The improved adaptive PID feedback control has better control performance. The feasibility and reliability of the adaptive PID feedback controller for collaborative robots are verified.

articleTitle: A Fast Economic Dispatch Method of Power System Based on Constraints Compression Technology
abstract: Considering the numerous constraints in the security-constrained economic dispatch problem of power system, this paper proposes a fast dispatch algorithm. First, the redundant constraints are identified and removed, then the remaining constraints are clustered and representative constraints are constructed with existing analytical methods. Then, the algorithm of inner and outer approximation to the feasible region is proposed by combining the error indicators before. Based on this algorithm, it reduces the computational effort of solving the dispatch problem and achieves a approximate optimal solution. The effectiveness of the fast algorithm are finally verified by numerical simulation of the IEEE-24 system and IEEE-118 system.

articleTitle: Adaptive Event-triggering Mechanism of Networked Control System with Deception Attacks
abstract: This paper studies the networked control systems (NCSs) model with adaptive event-triggering mechanism (AETM) and deception attacks. In order to reduce unnecessary signal transmission and realize the reasonable allocation of network resources, an adaptive event-triggering mechanism is proposed, the threshold of which can be adjusted according to system performance requirements. Based on the model established in this paper, using Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional (LKF) and linear matrix inequalities (LMIs) method, sufficient conditions to ensure the stability of the system are proposed. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Adaptive Tuning Method of Parameters of Active Disturbance Rejection Controller for Nonlinear System
abstract: Since the development of ADRC(Active Disturbance Rejection Control), it has achieved fruitful results in academic research and application fields. However, ADRC has limited its application range due to its multi-parameter adjustment problem and the difficulty of parameters tuning. So it is necessary to study the tuning of its parameters. Online setting method has the advantages of fast setting speed and high precision, but most of the current research is offline setting. This paper analyzes the second-order ADRC system and simplifies its parameters, establishes a variable domain fuzzy controller to adjust the parameters online, and simulates the ordinary second-order nonlinear system as an example. The simulation results show that the variable domain fuzzy control method can realize the online parameter adjustment, has the characteristics of online adaptive adjustment. The control performance of the control system after online adjustment is improved.

articleTitle: Research On Mahjong Game Strategy Combining Hand tiles Optimization and Situation Search
abstract: Mahjong, being a classic imperfect information game, has a large playing space, a lot of hidden information, and complex game rules. It’s a fantastic research platform for artificial intelligence. This paper proposes a two-stage mahjong game strategy: in the early stages of the game, hand tile optimization based on the ShangTing distance and fundamental tile type is used to reduce the Hu distance and increase the Hu probability, and in the later stages of the game, a new type of Monte Carlo tree search algorithm is used to guide Hu selection and acquire more scores based on simulation findings. Finally, repeated comparison studies are used to test the strategy’ efficiency. The agent AgentMT was created using this approach, and it competed with the agent KnighTeam-MI01, which placed fourth in the 15th China computer gaming championship. At the end of the experimental part of the article, AgentMT and KnightTeam-MI01 are designed to play 3 sessions with 1000 games each. The experimental results show that, compared with KnighTeam-MI01, AgentMT is 53.3 points higher in the average score in a single session, 21.9 percent higher in the average time in a single session, and 3 points higher in the highest score in a single game.

articleTitle: Development of a Dual-CPU Equipment Controller Special for Seismic Stations
abstract: This paper introduces the principle and design of a Dual-CPU Equipment Controller, which base on SMS of GSM. The terminal consists of a wireless GSM module (Q24plus+ module produced by WAVECOM company) and a monitor and control unit taking dual- microcomputer (P89s52) as the cores. This control terminal is a terminal device that can be controlled remotely through mobile phone short messages, or network control commands from Ethernet.

articleTitle: Quadrotor Attitude Control Based On Improved ADRC
abstract: Aiming at the non-linear and strong coupling characteristics of quadrotor, an improved active disturbance rejection attitude controller was designed in this paper. Firstly, the nonlinear mathematical model of the quedrotor was established, and then the each link of the traditional active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) was simplified by using the inverse hyperbolic sine function ar sinh. Finally, the control effects of the improved ADRC and the traditional ADRC were simulated and verified under the same simulation conditions. The results showed that, compared with the traditional ADRC, the difficulty of parameter tuning of the improved ADRC had been reduced, and the control accuracy had been improved.

articleTitle: A Statistical Dynamical Algorithm for Gaussian Multi-agent Systems under Hamel’s Formalism
abstract: This paper focuses on a formulation of stochastic dynamics of Gaussian process on the general affine group. The proposed dynamical system could be a candidate model for large-scale UAV swarms. In particular, deterministic differential equations on the Lie algebra for the Gaussian process are derived based on Hamel’s formalism. By adopting the variational integrator technique, possible inaccuracies that are caused by the commonly used numerical integration schemes are eliminated. The resulting geometric integrator is implemented compared with a reference algorithm to validate its conciseness and efficiency in preserving total energy of the conservative Gaussian system.

articleTitle: An Ensemble Energy Consumption Prediction Model for Industrial Serial-Robot
abstract: Industrial robots, as the representative of advanced technologies in multiple fields and disciplines, endow the manufacturing industry with automation and intelligence capabilities. Considering the sustainable manufacturing, it is essential to evaluate and optimize the energy consumption of industrial robots. State of the art research mainly focus on the energy consumption characteristic analysis,including the robot kinematics and dynamics.Parameter identification, the most crucial step, is difficult to implement for industrial circumstance. The traditional modeling methods reveals the non-linear relationship between the energy consumption and robot movements. This study uses the radial basis function neural networks to quantify the non-linear relationship. Moreover, an ensemble model method is implement to guarantee the accuracy of energy prediction. Experiments which demonstrates the effectiveness and accurateness of the proposed model are conducted on SiaSun SR4B industrial robot.

articleTitle: Novel Fuzzy Neural Network Control of Active Power Filter with Super-Twisting Sliding Mode Control
abstract: This paper provides an adaptive Super-Twisting sliding mode control (STSMC) scheme based on a multi-feedback feature selection fuzzy neural network (MFFSFNN), aiming at tracking compensation current quickly and precisely and solving the harmonic current problem in the electrical grid. Because of its designed feedback loops and feature selection layer, it has the characteristics of signal filtering and feedback. Signal filtering helps MFFSFNN deal with external disturbances and model uncertainties with the capability of choosing valuable signals. Signal feedback plays an important role in expanding the learning dimension with the associative memory ability, thus raising approximation accuracy of the target system. Simulation study and comprehensive comparisons are given to demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of performance using the proposed controller.

Author Keywords: Multi-feedback feature selection fuzzy neural network

articleTitle: Event-Triggered Optimal Safety Control for Nonlinear Safety-Critical Systems with Disturbance
abstract: In this paper, the event-triggered optimal safety control method is proposed to solve the zero-sum game problem of nonlinear safety-critical systems with disturbance. First, we transform the safety-critical system with safety constraints into an equivalent system without safety constraints by using the barrier function. Then, for relieving the computation pressure and saving communication cost, the event-triggered mechanism is introduced, and a safe event-triggered condition is presented, meanwhile, the Zeno behavior is excluded. In addition, only a critic neural network (NN) is used to implement the proposed method. During the learning process, the past data and current data are used to relax the persistence of excitation (PE) condition. According to the Lyapunov theory, it can be proved that the states and the weight estimation error of critic NN are uniformly ultimately bounded (UUB). Finally, a simulation example shows the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Threat Assessment of the Maritime Targets Based on Dynamic Bayesian Networks
abstract: In order to efficiently and accurately grasp and predict the state of the maritime target of the enemy, it is necessary to conduct the threat assessment of the maritime target’s state. The current threat assessment methods for maritime targets mainly rely on the commander’s judgment based on human experience, and it is difficult to adapt to the complex and real-time changing requirements of information sources in the war. This paper fully considers battlefield combat factors, selects target features and performs fuzzy processing, using dynamic Bayesian network method to establish a threat assessment model for maritime targets. Then we combine the calculation examples to analyze two types of maritime targets based on dynamic and static Bayesian networks. The target threat assessment methods are compared and analyzed. The results show that the threat assessment based on dynamic Bayesian networks has high accuracy and robustness, which is more suitable for high dynamic and strong confrontation marine actual battlefield environment.

articleTitle: Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Aviation Lithium-ion Battery Based on SVR-MC
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the accuracy of the remaining useful life (RUL) of aviation lithium-ion batteries is not high, this paper proposes a method for predicting the remaining useful life of aviation lithium-ion batteries based on the combination of Support Vector Regression (SVR) and Markov Chain (MC). First, use NASA lithium-ion battery aging data set, design and use SVR network model to predict the RUL of aviation lithium-ion battery. Second, use MC to correct the prediction results of the SVR network model. Finally, the proposed life prediction method based on SVR-MC is tested and verified. The results show that the life prediction method of aviation lithium-ion battery proposed in this paper can achieve the prediction performance of the remaining useful life of aviation lithium-ion battery, has good prediction accuracy, and has good application prospects.

articleTitle: Target Threat Assessment in Air Combat with Incomplete Information
abstract: Situational information obtained in a high confrontation air combat environment is likely to be incomplete, such as data distortion, error, or even missing, which can easily lead to large deviations of partial threat assessment results at certain moments and affect subsequent decision-making. Aiming at this problem, an air combat target threat assessment method based on improved evidential network (EN) is proposed in this paper. Firstly, for the selected attribute variables that are closely related to threat assessment of air combat targets and are easy to obtain, an advantage function calculation method is designed and an evidential network model is built. Then, for the incomplete evidence information, an evidence preprocessing and correction method based on data prediction is proposed, and an evidence belief structure conversion method based on the triangular fuzzy conversion relationship is designed. Finally, the network reasoning is realized by continues-time information fusion. Simulation results show that this method can make full use of the extractable target attribute information and accurately evaluate the threat level of the enemy fighter under random and incomplete data.

articleTitle: Comparison Study of Error Patterns of Intermittent Open and Short Circuit Connection Faults in CAN Network
abstract: Controller area network (CAN) is a widely applied protocol in vehicle communication systems. However, the intermittent connection(IC) faults, which repetitively and randomly occur in the CAN network due loose connections, cable aging and insulation wearing, will worsen the system performance and cause system level failures. Hence, effective detection and accurate diagnosis of the IC fault in CAN network is of great importance for system health management. However, the systematic study of different IC fault types in CAN network has not been thoroughly studied. By simulating the open-circuit IC fault and short-circuit IC fault in CAN network on the industrial testbed, this paper studied the patterns of the errors induced by different IC faults. The feature parameter distribution of the two types of IC faults is studied, and the performance differences of the two types of IC faults on CAN bus are analyzed. The results show different IC faults in CAN network demonstrated differentiable error patterns, which can be used to develop further methodology for fault diagnosis and isolation.

articleTitle: A PID-SMC control method with payload anti-swing for 3D overhead crane systems
abstract: For the overhead crane payload swing problem, an anti-swing controller based on sliding mode theory is designed for the three-dimensional overhead crane in this paper. A sliding mode switching function with a PID form is constructed with a four-order kinetic model, the function with the payload swing angle is introduced into the sliding mode switching function to constitute the new sliding mode controller, and the stability of the system is analyzed using the Lyapunov function. The effectiveness and robustness of the proposed controller are tested with the numerical simulation. The results show that the payload swing angle can be maintained within 5° using the proposed controller.

articleTitle: Stochastic Finite-Time Synchronization of Kuramoto-Oscillator Networks
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of stochastic finite-time(SFT) phase agreement(PA) and frequency synchronization(FS) of Kuramoto model with identical and non-identical oscillators, respectively. The effect of stochastic noisy perturbation on the process of finite-time convergence is investigated due to its ubiquity. Furthermore, this investigation picks the smooth control protocol, which does not contain the signum function anymore. By utilizing the finite-time stochastic stability theory, several criteria are derived successively for ensuring the SFT PA and FS of Kuramoto model, and the upper bound time estimation(UBTE) of synchronization is given. Finally, simulation results not only validate the correction of theoretical analysis, but also indicate that PA is more robust to stochastic disturbance, whereas FS of Kuramoto-oscillator networks is relatively sensitive.

articleTitle: Finite-time synchronization of complex dynamical networks with nonlinear couplings and uncertainties via adaptive fault-tolerant control
abstract: In this paper, the problems of finite-time synchronization control of complex dynamical networks with nonlinear couplings and uncertainties are considered using adaptive fault-tolerant control methods. The failure of complex network system is considered. The closed-loop system is still stable by designing adaptive fault-tolerant control strategy. For the nonlinear coupling function and unknown topology, the unilateral Lipschitz condition and adaptive gain estimation are used. Finally, the feasibility of fault-tolerant control strategy is verified by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Adaptive Optimal Control of UAV Formation Based on Policy Iteration
abstract: In this paper, aiming at the problem of UAV formation control, a method based on policy iteration is proposed to study the optimal control policy of UAV formation. When the system model is unknown, this algorithm transforms the problem into online solving the Algebraic Riccati Equation. Through online iteration, the value function and the control policy can be updated at the same time. Finally, the optimal control policy is obtained and the nonlinear system is converged. Experimental results show that compared with the traditional control policy, the controller improves the stability of the UAV formation. The convergence speed and robustness of the system are also significantly enhanced, and the control performance is more optimized. At last, the simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Semantic Map Construction Method for Robot Target Search
abstract: If a robot uses static semantic maps to search targets in dynamic environments, its performance will be unsatisfactory. To solve this problem, a lightweight environment construction method for robot target search tasks is proposed. This novel semantic map can be updated automatically in a dynamic environment, in which unsupervised region division methods are used to establish the attribution of targets to subregions of the environment. Then, a target search strategy is designed to optimize the expected time. Experimental results demonstrated that this semantic map has an excellent real-time and adaptive ability. It does not need a lot of computing resources and storage like 3D point cloud semantic map. It is also convenient for the robot to update automatically online.

articleTitle: Cow Health Prediction Method Based on Logistic Regression and Decision Tree
abstract: In this paper, the logistic regression and decision tree CART classification methods in statistical methods are used to model the time data of different behaviors of dairy cows and statistically classify the characteristic quantities to predict the health of the dairy cows. The ROC curve tests the performance of the two classification prediction methods. Accuracy and classification efficiency. The results show that the two model classification methods have high accuracy in predicting the influencing factors of dairy cow health, and the two have their own focuses. When combined, more information can be obtained from the characteristic data volume, which can provide reference for dairy cow breeding in accordance with.

Author Keywords: Decision Tree CART and Cow Health

articleTitle: Hierarchical Control Scheme of Direct Yaw Moment Control System Based on Second-Order Sliding Mode Control
abstract: In this paper, the second-order sliding mode controller based on finite state machine is used as the outer-layer controller of hierarchical control for the direct yaw moment control system. The controller significantly weakens the chattering phenomenon caused by the first-order sliding mode controller and improves the robustness of the system. It makes the additional yaw moment calculated by the outer-layer controller more smooth and reduces the chattering of the wheel drive torque. The simulation compares the first-order sliding mode controller and the second-order sliding mode controller. The results show that the controller adopted in this paper significantly weakens the chattering phenomenon.

articleTitle: Sliding Mode Control of Bridge Crane
abstract: Bridge crane is a typical underactuated system, and its controller design needs to meet the problems of load anti swing and accurate positioning. Aiming at this demand, a variable structure sliding mode controller is designed. The controller can realize the rapid positioning of the trolley and prevent the load swing. Because the control force will shake in the control process, the anti chattering method of the controller is also proposed. The simulation results show that the scheme can realize the rapid positioning of the trolley and the anti swing of the load, and has a good control effect.

articleTitle: Adaptive Event-Triggered H∞ Fuzzy Filter Design for Nonlinear Networked Systems Via Asymmetric LKF Approach
abstract: This paper studies the problem of the fuzzy H<inf>∞</inf> filter design for nonlinear networked control systems through event-triggered communication (ETC) scheme. For the reduction of conservativeness, a new asymmetric Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional (LKF) method is introduced in the H<inf>∞</inf> performance analysis of filter error systems, a sufficient condition is obtained to meet the H<inf>∞</inf> performance. Based on the condition, we further obtain a co-design method of the corresponding filter and event-triggering parameters with less conservativeness by a set of linear matrix inequalities. At the end, we provide a numerical example to verify the advantage of the new approaches.

articleTitle: Research of Load Balancing Control Based on Flexible Interconnection
abstract: In order to solve the problem of uneven power load in the internal power distribution network of the enterprise plant, the basic structure model of the multi-channel flexible interconnection system is constructed, and a load balancing scheme of the multi-channel flexible interconnection system is proposed. Using basic indicators such as dynamic load rate and load dispersion, the establishment of load balancing evaluation standards from single-channel to multi-channel is completed. The four-channel flexible interconnection system is designed in combination with the actual distribution network of the plant, based on the established balance evaluation standard, the feasibility and effectiveness of using multi-channel flexible interconnection system for load balancing are verified from simulation and actual engineering. It has certain reference value for improving the economy of enterprise system operation and reducing production cost and energy consumption.

articleTitle: A Grasping Posture Judgment Algorithm Based on Feature Circumscribed Rectangle
abstract: This paper proposes an optimal grasping system based on the circumscribed rectangle of the color feature. Firstly, the binocular camera generates a characteristic circumscribed rectangle according to the color characteristics of the object; Secondly, the disparity map and the triangle formula are combined to obtain the depth information collection of the object; Then, statistical filtering and surface flatness determination methods are applied to select suitable gripper; Finally, according to the normal at the center point of the circumscribed rectangle, the relationship between the Euler angle and the rotation vector is obtained, and then the optimal grasping pose vector is obtained. Experiments show that our method is effective and can be applied to the field of grasping or sorting.

articleTitle: Study on intermittent flow wear test method of water meter with high energy efficiency
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the water temperature is too high during the intermittent flow wear test of water meter and improve the energy efficiency, an intermittent flow wear test method of water meter based on inverse time sequence is proposed in this paper. By dividing the branch waterways of the water meter into two groups with the same total flow, and controlling the on-off state of the valves in each branch waterway, the intermittent flow timing sequences of each branch waterway in the same group are the same, and the phases of the intermittent flow timing sequences of the branch waterways between the two groups are in an inverse relationship, so as to realize that while the intermittent flow is present in each branch waterway, the whole facility presents a continuous flow state, which avoids the conversion of the output energy of the water pump into the internal energy of water due to the obstruction of water flow, and double the energy utilization efficiency and the wear test number of water meters when the water pump outputs the same power.

articleTitle: Robust sliding model predictive control with disturbance compensation in application to AUV pitch-axis motion
abstract: Constraints on the control input and system states as well as uncertain disturbances are the practical challenges in many motion control systems. In this paper, a disturbance observer (DO) with two-step disturbance compensation algorithm is proposed to deal with disturbances and enhance the robustness of the controller, while a discrete sliding mode predictive control (DSMPC) scheme is designed to handle saturation constraints on the control input and system states with the application to an autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV). The DSMPC combines the model predictive control (MPC) with the discrete sliding mode control (DSMC) using linear matrix inequalities approach. The stability of the proposed DSMPC are proved via Lyapunov stability theorem. Finally, simulation results are presented to illustrate the effectiveness of the whole control scheme.

Author Keywords: Inequality constraints and AUV pitch-axis motion control

articleTitle: Research on fault feature extraction of rotating machinery based on adaptive VMD and optimized CYCBD
