abstract: To solve the problem that early fault features of rotating machinery are difficult to extract, an adaptive k-value hierarchical variational mode decomposition (H-VMD) combined with optimized maximum second-order cyclostationarity blind deconvolution (CYCBD) fault feature extraction method is proposed in this paper. Mode decomposition of the vibration signal is performed with H-VMD. and then the noise dominant component is denoised by wavelet threshold denoising (WTD). Furthermore, the improved autocorrelation-weighted correlated kurtosis (ACK) when CYCBD enhances the periodic shock component of the denoised signal is the fitness function of ChOA, and the envelope demodulation analysis of the feature-enhanced signal is performed using the teager energy operator (TEO). Simulation analysis and experimental results show that the interference of background noise can be effectively removed and the periodic shock component of the vibration signal be enhanced by the proposed method, which is a new feature extraction method for the fault diagnosis of rotating machinery.

articleTitle: A Trajectory Planning Method of Autonomous Underwater Vehicles Based on Repulsive Field Model Prediction
abstract: In this paper, a model prediction method based on repulsive force field is proposed for the two-dimensional trajectory planning of Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUV). Firstly, the linear model prediction method is used to solve the point-to-point trajectory planning task in finite time. Then, according to the obstacle avoidance requirements in the planning task, the obstacle avoidance behavior is designed by using the principle of repulsive force field in the artificial potential field. A safe distance is set around obstacles. Every time the next trajectory point is planned, it is necessary to judge whether the AUV enters the range of obstacles with a safe distance. If it enters, the repulsive field obstacle avoidance behavior is started. Finally, through simulation experiments, it is verified that the proposed algorithm can achieve the trajectory planning task of UUVs without collision and meet the requirements of speed controllability in two-dimensional underwater environment.

articleTitle: Robust time-varying Kalman predictor for uncertain singular system with missing measurement and colored noises
abstract: For the linear stochastic singular system with missing measurement, colored noise and uncertain-variance noises, the robust Kalman prediction problem is addressed. Applying the singular value decomposition (SVD) method, the fictitious noise approach, the augmented state approach and difference transformation approach, the original singular system is transformed to new reduced-order standard system only with uncertain-variance fictitious noises. By the augmented state approach and difference transformation approach, the new augmented state space model with correlated white noise is presented. Applying the minimax robust estimation principle, the minmax robust time-varying Kalman predictor is presented. Its robustness is proved by the Lyapunov equation approach in the sense that its actual prediction error variance is guaranteed to have the corresponding minimal upper bound for all admissible uncertainties. A simulation example about circuits system verifies the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed results.

articleTitle: Straight line detection algorithm of truck point cloud based on statistical line chart
abstract: Line feature extraction has always been an important part of point cloud processing. In the task of cement automatic loading, the line feature of truck side point cloud plays an important role in model reconstruction and dimension calculation. This paper introduces a line detection algorithm for truck side edge based on statistical line graph. Firstly, we correct the horizontal posture of the truck based on the geometric characteristics of the truck. The straight lines of front board, rear gate and side gates of the truck after correction are approximately parallel to a coordinate axis. Then, using the edge line detection algorithm of statistical broken line graph proposed in this paper, we draw the coordinate value-density distribution diagram, so as to determine the edge position of the truck side. and finally, calculate the edge straight line of the truck side point cloud. The algorithm proposed in this paper can effectively eliminate the interference of foreign bodies on the truck side and accurately extract the truck side point cloud. The simulation and real experiments verify the robustness and accuracy of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Foreign Object Detection in WPT System Based on Power Spectrum Estimation of Transmitter Current
abstract: During the work of the wireless energy transfer (WPT) system, foreign objects will inevitably enter into the system. The intervention of metal objects and living objects makes the system deviate from the normal operating point and even lead to safety accidents. Therefore, foreign object detection is of great significance. The existing methods of foreign object detection usually require additional sensors, which are costly. However, this paper argues that the WPT system is capable of self-sensing. The system’s signal contains information about foreign objects, so there is no need to add additional sensors for foreign object detection. This paper studied the power spectral density curve of the transmitter current of the WPT system and found that the curve changed significantly when foreign objects entered the system. Accordingly, a foreign object detection system was designed. The method used the system’s own characteristics only, making the system have the dual functions of power transmission and foreign object detection at the same time. The proposed method in this study provides new ideas and inspiration for further developing foreign object detection in the WPT system.

articleTitle: Abnormal Wind Turbine Data Identification Using a Dirichlet Process Gaussian Mixture Model
abstract: A large amount of abnormal data will be generated during the actual wind turbine operation, thus the raw data can’t be directly applied to the subsequent work such as wind turbine power prediction and generation performance evaluation. This paper proposes an abnormal data identification method based on the Dirichlet Process Gaussian Mixture Model (DPGMM) to preprocess the raw data effectively. Firstly, all data points are allocated into corresponding power bins created in the horizontal power direction with a certain interval in the wind speed-power (V-P) coordinate system. And then, the DPGMM model that can adaptively determine the optimal number of Gaussian components is used to cluster the data points in each power bin. At last, combined with the parameters of each Gaussian component confidence ellipse and data points distribution characteristics in V-P coordinate system, the abnormal Gaussian components and their clustering, abnormal data can be accurately identified. Using actual wind turbine SCADA data, the proposed method is demonstrated to be effective.

articleTitle: A Quantitative Analysis and Planning Model for Strategic Management Resource Allocation Demand
abstract: Focusing on the support for strategic management link assessment, this paper presents an exploratory method for the formalized description and quantification of resource allocation demand. While addressing the needs for strategic management capability and quantitative analysis assessment, the methods, techniques and ways adopted in the automata theory are borrowed to analyze the problems. The basic connotations of resource allocation demand are studied with demand analysis and optimization. In this way, a "five-step method" is developed and proposed for resource allocation demand planning. This proposed method can meet the general requirements for scientific resource allocation demand planning. Therefore, it provides an effective way and solution to systematically integrate construction resources, scientifically change the way of allocation, and enhance the efficiency of resource utilization.

articleTitle: Prescribe performance dynamic surface control of a flapping-wing aerial vehicle with unknown input dead-zone
abstract: To perform the position and attitude control of the flapping wing aerial vehicle (FWAV), this article proposes a prescribed performance function based dynamic surface controller (PPDSC) with adaptive neural network (ANN) estimator in presence of unknown input dead-zone. A special radical Lyapunov function consists of a L function is chosen to guarantee the prescribed performance (PP) of the position and attitude trajectory tracking errors for the FWAV. The dynamic surface control (DSC) is a method that utilizing a first-order low pass filter to avoid the phenomenon named explosion of complex of the backstepping method. Meanwhile, the ANN estimator is designed to pay the effect of unknown input dead-zone and disturbance. Then, the stability of the closed-loop FWAV system is proved by utilizing Lyapunov’s direct method. Finally, numerical simulations are given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the above method.

articleTitle: Research on Control Law Design of Fixed Wing Unmanned Aerial Vehicle in Aerobatic Maneuvers
abstract: This paper solves the flight control law design problem of a fixed wing unmanned aerial vehicle(UAV) in aerobatic maneuvers. First, a six degree-of-freedom nonlinear dynamic model was established as the research object. Then, based on the nonlinear dynamic inversion control approach, a height-flight path angle-velocity configuration, a pitch rate-roll rate-throttle control law and an angle of attack-roll rate-throttle configuration were proposed. The structures of flight control law were derived and the mathematical models were established. Then, the control inputs of each phase were calculated based on the kinematic characteristics of two selected maneuvers: S-turn and Split S maneuvers. At last, the complete closed-loop simulations were conducted and the results indicates that the proposed control law configurations as well as the maneuver analysis method were able to maintain the attitudes and trajectories accurately.

articleTitle: Switching Filtering Algorithm with Image Preprocessing and Gesture Tracking
abstract: Denoising has always been a critical technology in the image processing community. Gaussian noise and impulse noise are the most common image noises. A single filtering algorithm cannot suppress these two noise conditions. Besides, existing hybrid flitering methods have high time complexity and are difficult to meet the real-time requirements. For this, we propose a filtering algorithm based on conditional switching, which establishes an adaptive median filtering subsystem and a fast guided filtering subsystem. It can automatically determine the main noise and select a suitable filtering subsystem for image denoising. To prove the effectiveness of our method, the proposed method is apply to a Kinect-based gesture tracking system. Experimental results show that the switching filtering algorithm can fulfill both accuracy and real-time performance requirements.

articleTitle: Maximum Power point Tracking and Prediction of Photovoltaic Cells Under Shadow Based on Improved Fuzzy Neural Network
abstract: An improved BP neural network prediction method model is studied in this paper. The L-M (Levenberg Marquardt) algorithm is optimized by fuzzy algorithm. The BP neural network can greatly improve the convergence speed of the neural network. The fuzzy algorithm can make the neural network avoid falling into the local optimization cycle and improve the accuracy. The simulation results show that the prediction model proposed in this paper is fast and accurate, and can track the maximum power point in real time when the shadow state and the external environment change and has high prediction accuracy comparing with the traditional maximum power point tracking algorithm.

articleTitle: A new BCG-based wearable monitoring system
abstract: Ballistocardiogram (BCG) can realize the detection of cardiac function from mechanical dimensions. A wearable system that can collect real-time BCG signals is designed in this paper. The signals are collected and processed from 7 healthy subjects. An improved PT state machine logic joint algorithm is proposed to locate the J peak, K peak and L peak of signals. The waveform characteristics of the processed signal are basically consistent with the standard signal. The equipment with small volume, low power and convenient operation has broad development prospects in health monitoring and analysis of heart rate variation.

articleTitle: Real-Time Optimization and Application Based on Correlation Integration with Robust Control Solution
abstract: For the traditional real-time optimization algorithm of correlation integration, when the adjustment weighting matrix of tuning variable is not set properly, the value of the objective function may diverge and cannot converge to the optimal value, a correlation integration real-time optimization method based on robust control solution is proposed. First, based on data-driven, the gradient of the system is obtained by correlation integral algorithm. Then, the state space model of the system with gradient as state is obtained by least square identification, and a robust state feedback controller with incremental constraints of tuning variables is designed. Finally, the optimal control law is obtained by solving linear matrix inequality, so that the tuning variables meet the real-time constraints in the optimization process and converge to the optimal working point quickly. The proposed method has been applied to the xylene optimization process and the industrial application results have verified the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method, which provides a new and effective way to solve the real-time optimization problem of complex industrial processes.

articleTitle: Short-term heat load prediction of heat exchange stations based on CEEMDAN-SE-LSTM
abstract: To address the issue of low short-term heat load prediction accuracy due to factors such as the centralized heating system's lagging nature. A prediction approach CEEMDAN-SE-LSTM is proposed that improves the integration of fully integrated empirical modal decomposition with adaptive noise and long and short-term memory neural networks. CEEMDAN decomposes the preprocessed heat load data into smooth modal components, SE reorganizes the modalities with similar entropy values, LSTM predicts each reorganized modality, and the predicted values of all modalities are superimposed as the final prediction output. Finally, the model's accuracy in predicting short-term heat loads is demonstrated using data from a university heat exchange station in Dalian as an example.

articleTitle: Structural balance control of outgoing links for complex dynamic networks with controlled nodes
abstract: From the perspective of large-scale dynamic systems, complex dynamic networks(CDNs) can be considered as coupled by the nodes subsystem(NS) and links subsystem(LS). In this paper, the dynamical model of LS is represented by differential equations about the outgoing links vectors instead of the Riccati matrix differential equations. Since the representation method of vector differential equation has more flexible mathematical properties and geometrical characteristics than the matrix differential equation. In this paper, by designing the controller of NS, with the help of the coupling term for LS, the LS in CDNs asymptotically achieve structural balance. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by the numerical simulation of Hopfield neural network.

articleTitle: Online classification of abnormal patterns in time series during continuous casting process based on optimal shapelet combination
abstract: Aiming at the different abnormal patterns of high resolution time series data in industrial control process, an optimal shapelet combination algorithm based on maximum information gain is proposed to complete the classification of time series. First, genetic algorithm is used to extract the candidate shapelet set with a certain shape from the training set of time series data, and then the optimal shapelet combination is extracted from the training set via the maximum information gain, and the time series data set is transformed into a data matrix. Second, the time series classification is completed via combining the data matrix with the conventional classification methods. The experimental results show that the computational efficiency of the proposed method is improved by more than 7 times based on the standard time series data set in UEA & UCR data warehouse. Finally, it is applied to the online classification of abnormal pattern in time series data of casting speed during continuous casting process. The results show that the classification time of the proposed method is reduced by more than 10 times, reaching within 0.5 seconds, which can meet the real-time requirements of industrial anomaly detection.

articleTitle: PCB Characteristic Impedance Prediction based on an Error Compensated Random Forest Regression Model
abstract: The characteristic impedance is a key factor affecting the quality of signal transmission in PCB (Printed Circuit Board). In order to solve the problem of characteristic impedance prediction during the PCB manufacturing process, a random forest regression model with support vector regression as error compensation is developed. The performance of the presented method is evaluated on the data from real manufacturing process. The obtained results were rather satisfied compared with the traditional prediction model. The R-square is 0.99 and RMSE is 0.12 which would be useful for the real application.

articleTitle: Synchronization of memristive neural networks with leakage and time-varying delays under non-chattering quantized control
abstract: This paper aims to explore the synchronization of memristive neural networks (MNNs), in which two nonidentical delays comprise leakage and time-varying delays. To lessen the communication burden and settle these difficulties caused by parameter mismatch and time delays, an innovative quantized controller without chattering phenomenon is devised. By utilizing the Lyapunov functionals, the interval matrix method and inequality techniques, synchronization criteria of two MNNs are derived. Furthermore, the adaptive law of the quantized controller with less conservative control gains is also designed. Ultimately, two examples are performed to testify the availability of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Study on emergency disposal processes of urban rail transit with Fully Automatic Operation system based on time Petri net
abstract: Recently, the Fully Automatic Operation system has gradually become the mainly used train operation control system in urban rail transit. Its higher operation efficiency have has won more attention and application. However, due to the lack of operation experience of the fully automatic operation system and the conservative safe operation ideas of the operation managers, there is no accurate operation management emergency plan for the fully automatic operation system. Most of the emergency plans follow the way under the non-automatic operation system, resulting in the train emergency efficiency under emergencies not reaching the expected level. Taking a real door fault event as a case, this work analyzes and models the emergency process under this case based on time Petri net, and simulates and calculates different emergency schemes combined with MATLAB, to provide methods and ideas to help find and establish more efficient emergency plans suitable for the operation of fully automatic operation system. The simulation results show that compared with the emergency schemes of manual fault handling, the schemes combined with the automatic fault handling mode of the fully automatic operation system can effectively shorten the emergency time. And even considering that the automatic mode of the system has a higher failure rate, the probability that the emergency time of the automatic processing scheme is shorter than the expected time is greater.

articleTitle: Economic Dispatch of Microgrid with Multiple Energy Storages Based on Affine Decision Rules
abstract: This paper investigates the optimal economic dispatch of microgrid and establishes an efficient scheduling model for microgrid with multiple energy storage devices considering nonanticipativity and all-scenario-feasibility. Nonanticipativity and all-scenario-feasibility require the scheduling decisions could couple any realization scenarios within the uncertainty set, which represents infinite constraints essentially. To deal with this difficulty, in this paper, affine decision rules are introduced to describe the relationship function between the dispatch decisions and uncertainties. Thus, the unknown decision functions in original stochastic programming problem are described by the linear functions, and the model with infinite constraints become solvable with guaranteeing the nonanticipativity and all-scenario-feasibility. Numerical tests are implemented on a real microgrid to verify the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Event-triggered Sliding Mode Control for Piecewise Homogeneous Markovian Jump Systems
abstract: In this paper, the design of event-triggered sliding mode controller for piecewise homogeneous Markovian jump systems is studied. Firstly, the system is transformed into two low-order subsystems by linear transformation and a suitable linear sliding function is proposed. On this basis, an event-triggered mechanism is employed. Then, the sliding mode control law is designed such that the system trajectories can be forced and remained on the specified sliding surface. In addition, a set of new sufficient condition are proposed by using the Lyapunov function method, which ensures the stochastic stability of sliding mode dynamics. Finally, the proposed results are applied to a single link flexible manipulator system to reflect the effectiveness of the results.

articleTitle: Parking Space Sharing System Based On Intelligent Parking Pile
abstract: Aiming at uneven distribution of parking resources and low utilization rate of parking spaces, a shared parking space system is designed based on smart parking stakes. Taking Raspberry Pi as the control system and carries peripherals to collect parking space information in real-time and complete the functions of license plate recognition, parking space positioning, parking stake control, parking space monitoring, and vehicle sensing. Meanwhile, the LoRa network uploads the information of each parking space to the cloud platform through the LoRa gateway to complete real-time data monitoring and equipment control and show to users after filtering by priority algorithm, users also can complete the functions of parking space reservation, payment, and management through the app to use the shared parking space smoothly.

articleTitle: Asymptotic tracking control for hypersonic flight vehicles using exact disturbance observers
abstract: In this paper, the asymptotic tracking control problem of hypersonic flight vehicles (HFVs) is investigated by using exact disturbance observers (EDOs). In most of disturbance observer (DO) based approaches for the control of HFVs, it usually requires that the uncertainties and their time derivatives have a priori constant upper bound, and only obtains a bounded tracking result rather than an asymptotic one. However, assuming the state-related uncertainties have constant priori upper bound might be very restrictive before the system stability is proved. To remove such restrictive assumption and achieve exact disturbance estimation, a novel EDO design methodology is proposed. And based on the EDO, an asymptotic control scheme is developed to achieve exact tracking of the HFV system. The stability of the closed-loop system under the EDO-based control scheme is proved via Lyapunov theory, and the effectiveness is numerically validated.

articleTitle: Improved MLP-Mixer for Cars’ Type Recognition
abstract: With the development of intelligent manufacturing, the automotive industry, which is an important part of national economy, has attracted attention widely once again and the cars’ type recognition is a crucial part for the automotive industry. The accuracy of cars’ type recognition will directly affect the painting and other operations. Therefore, the car’s type recognition requires a high accuracy over 99%. Some papers propose deep learning models for the cars’ type recognition. However, many existing deep learning models have problems such as requirements for massive samples, slow convergence and difficulty in achieving the accuracy over 99%, which makes them have a little application to the industry. This paper takes the cars’ type recognition as the background and adds the prior knowledge to the deep learning model, which introduces LBP into MLP-Mixer to improve the accuracy effectively.

articleTitle: Visual Servoing of AGV Based on Nonlinear Model Predictive Control
abstract: In this paper, a new visual servoing method based on nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) is proposed for the four-Mecanum wheel AGV in the smart warehouse. The AGV is equipped with a top camera for real-time obstacle avoidance and a bottom camera for ground-level AprilTag detection that assists AGV navigation and localization. After that, the NMPC is combined with the kinematics of the Mecanum wheel to establish a position-based visual servoing (PBVS) system for correcting the navigation errors and keeping the AprilTag always staying within the field of view of the bottom camera. Finally, the results of simulation experiments and actual tests verify the efficiency of the nonlinear model predictive controller, and the AGV navigation accuracy can reach millimeter level.

articleTitle: A Human-Machine Safety Distance Detection Method Based on Computer Vision
abstract: With the widespread introduction of the concept of human-machine collaboration, the relationship between humans and robots is getting closer during production, and the safety issue in the process of human-robot collaboration has become the focus of its development. In this paper, we propose a new method for online detection of human-machine safe distance based on computer vision. The purposed method is built based on a depth camera and Robot Operating System(ROS). When the system is working, the depth camera collects RGB-D images, the color information is used for object tracking which utilizes the YOLO R object detector and multi-target tracking algorithm. And the deep information is then used for calculating the three-dimensional coordinates of the target in the camera coordinate system. After extracting the information from the RGB-D image, the distance between human and machine can be estimated online to send control commands to the robot. The proposed method can be applied to the industrial field to detect the relative position of the human body and the industrial robot online.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Twisting Sliding Mode Control for DC-DC Boost Converter Using Nonlinear Disturbance Observer
abstract: In this paper, a twisting sliding mode control (TSMC) method based on nonlinear disturbance observer (NDOB) is proposed for the resistance load disturbance and input voltage change of DC-DC boost converter. First, a nonlinear disturbance observer is designed to estimate the disturbance by using the feedback state information of the system. On this basis, a twisting sliding mode controller is designed to make the output voltage of the system track the given voltage quickly and accurately. Lyapunov stability theorem is used to prove that the designed controller can guarantee the stability of the closed-loop system. Experimental results show that compared with the sliding mode control (SMC) method based on extended state observer (ESO), the proposed control method improves the tracking performance and the robustness to disturbances and uncertainties.

articleTitle: Decoupling Sliding Mode Control of Buck Converters with Consideration of Non-minimum Phase Characteristics
abstract: In this paper, a novel decoupling sliding mode (SM) control approach is proposed for buck converters with arbitrary order to solve their inherent problems of non-minimum phase and the chattering. Based on the concept of relative degree, a new form of sliding surface with hieratical structure is proposed. As a result, the problem of the non-minimum phase is solved and the system is decomposed into two parts, i.e., an input-output subsystem and a zero dynamic subsystem. In order to guarantee the system stability, the corresponding robust control law is proposed on the basis of the Lyapunov theorem. In order to solve the chattering problem, the boundary layer is introduced to achieve the control continuity. Comparative simulation results validate this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Manipulator Control Based on Improved Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithm
abstract: In the scene of random patching in the industrial scene, an algorithm based on a distributed frame of proximal policy optimization (PPO) with Generalized Advantage Estimation (GAE) is proposed in this paper. The visual part is taken from camera, which is considered as state input. A distributed approach (actor-critic) is established to improve the efficiency of sampling. The sampling data are stored in the experience pool. Both punishment and reward strategies are considered in the raised method. The improved PPO algorithm can be verified on Pybullet. We found that it greatly improves effect in terms of convergence steps and actual reward performance.

articleTitle: Fault-tolerant Control Law for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Array Based on Sliding Mode Control
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicle array(UAV array) has become the focus of many researchers as a feasible solution to solve the problem of short endurance and weak load capacity. After investigating the research status and key problems of UAV array at home and abroad, this paper establishes the array dynamics model composed of a new configuration of the quadrotor flying array with the main and auxiliary rotor structure under the triangular prism frame. Based on this model, a sliding mode control method is designed to solve the fault-tolerant control problem of UAV array. In order to further verify the control performance of the proposed control algorithm, typical topology structures were selected as experimental representatives to complete the control simulation design and experiment of the system. The results show that this algorithm can achieve good control effect.

Author Keywords: Sliding Mode Control and Fault-tolerant Control

articleTitle: MMI-type optical fiber acetone gas sensor based on Ni/WO3
abstract: The detection of low concentration of acetone gas based on multimode interference is realized at room temperature by coating Ni/WO<inf>3</inf> on the surface of multimode optical fiber. When the concentration of acetone gas changes, the concentration of free electrons inside the film changes as the Ni/WO<inf>3</inf> film adsorbs acetone gas while undergoing oxidation-reduction reactions. In this way, the refractive index of the film will change, and finally the interference trough of the optical fiber will shift. The concentration of acetone gas can be detected by detecting the offset of the wavelength of the interference wave trough. The experimental results show that the sensitivity of the acetone gas optical fiber sensor in the range of 0-264ppm is as high as 4.79pm/ppm, the response/recovery time is about 55/30s, the cross sensitivity of gas concentration and temperature is 0.479°C/ppm and it has good selectivity.
